title: Glasses On Your Head
lyrics:
[all vocals done through rhythmic indie spoken word]

[Verse 1]
I checked the hall table twice.
Then the couch.
Then the bowl by the door.
Your keys were not there.
Your keys were not there.

I opened the junk drawer.
Moved the coupons.
Found a battery.
Found a spoon.
Found a receipt from June.
Still no keys.

[Pre-Chorus]
I patted every pocket.
I shook every coat.
I looked under the mail.
I looked behind the shoes.
My hands were doing laps.
My head was not helping.

[Chorus]
You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
Not the keys, the glasses.
Right there on your face.

You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
All that searching, all that stress,
and they were on your face.

[Verse 2]
I checked the fridge.
I checked the sink.
I checked the bathroom shelf.
I even looked in the freezer
like a person with a plan.

Then the laugh came out.
Small at first.
Then loud enough to bend me over.
Because the world got fuzzy
for the exact reason it should.

[Pre-Chorus]
The little things hide
when the big thought hits.
You swear it’s one missing piece,
but it’s the one you’re wearing.
So you search the whole house
for something already found.

[Chorus]
You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
Not the keys, the glasses.
Right there on your face.

You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
All that searching, all that stress,
and they were on your face.

[Bridge]
I stood in the mirror
and there you were.
Eyes wide.
Hands up.
Laughing at the joke.

I had the keys in my palm.
I had my glasses on.
I had the day in a knot
for something sitting still.

[Final Chorus]
You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
Not the keys, the glasses.
Right there on your face.

You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
All that searching, all that stress,
and they were on your face.

You forgot the glasses.
You forgot the glasses.
I guess the answer was easy
once I could see it clear.

title: Everything Feels Alright
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When you walk in, I exhale
The whole room loosens up
Your laugh hits like warm rain
And I come back to myself

[Pre-Chorus]
You take the weight off my chest
Like you know exactly where it sits
One look and I forget
All the things that used to hit

[Chorus]
When I’m with you, alright
Everything feels alright
When I’m with you, alright
I can breathe tonight
(Alright) you make it easy
(Alright) you make it right
When I’m with you, alright
Everything feels alright

[Verse 2]
Your hand in mine, no rush
Just the way you hold my day
Even the hard little parts
Start fading out of frame

[Pre-Chorus]
You take the weight off my chest
Like you know exactly where it sits
One look and I forget
All the things that used to hit

[Chorus]
When I’m with you, alright
Everything feels alright
When I’m with you, alright
I can breathe tonight
(Alright) you make it easy
(Alright) you make it right
When I’m with you, alright
Everything feels alright

[Bridge]
If the world gets loud
Stay close, stay close
If I lose my footing
Hold me close

[Final Chorus]
When I’m with you, alright
Everything feels alright
When I’m with you, alright
I can breathe tonight
(Alright) you make it easy
(Alright) you make it right
When I’m with you, alright
Everything feels alright

title: Lox and Chicken
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You want strength on your plate
Not a meal that drags you down
Lox on rye in the morning
Keeps that good fuel coming around

Chicken on the skillet
Lean and ready, hot and right
One gives you protein, baby
One keeps you full all night

[Pre-Chorus]
Bright start, steady pace
That’s the way you move
Good taste, real food
Got something to prove

[Chorus]
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
That’s the good stuff, that’s the good stuff
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
Strong body, full heart, enough
(lox and chicken)
(yeah, yeah, enough)

[Verse 2]
Lox brings that savory kick
With a little ocean shine
Chicken brings the clean bite
Keeps your muscles in line

Put it with some greens, babe
Add a squeeze of lemon too
Simple meals, real balance
That’s the smart move

[Pre-Chorus]
Good salt, good heat
Nothing heavy on your mind
Quick bite, big lift
Feelin’ fine, feelin’ fine

[Chorus]
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
That’s the good stuff, that’s the good stuff
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
Strong body, full heart, enough
(lox and chicken)
(yeah, yeah, enough)

[Bridge]
When the day runs long
And you need a better plan
Choose the plate that’s honest
Choose the meal that understands

[Final Chorus]
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
That’s the good stuff, that’s the good stuff
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
Strong body, full heart, enough
Lox and chicken, lox and chicken
Clean fuel, real joy, enough
(lox and chicken)
(yeah, yeah, enough)

title: Too Much To Do
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Alarm in the sink
Notes on the floor
Half a cold plate
By the front door
Two tabs open
Three plans in my head
I said "later"
And made more instead

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep saying stop
But my hands won't fold
I chase the next sound
Like a dare I was told
Every minute's pulling
At my sleeve again
And I don't know how to
Put the fire in

[Chorus]
Too much to do
Too much to do
I can't sit still
When the room turns blue
Too much to do
Too much to do
I keep making songs
Like I have to

[Verse 2]
Late bus receipt
In my back pocket
Voice memo full
Of a half-formed rocket
Coffee's gone cold
But the line stays hot
One more rough take
Then I lose the plot

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep saying stop
But my hands won't fold
I chase the next sound
Like a dare I was told
Every minute's pulling
At my sleeve again
And I don't know how to
Put the fire in

[Chorus]
Too much to do
Too much to do
I can't sit still
When the room turns blue
Too much to do
Too much to do
I keep making songs
Like I have to

[Bridge]
Maybe I'll rest
When the tape runs out
Maybe I'll breathe
When the last note drops
But I hear a hook
In the crack of dawn
So I write it down
And I carry on

[Final Chorus]
Too much to do
Too much to do
I can't sit still
When the room turns blue
Too much to do
Too much to do
I keep making songs
Like I have to
Too much to do
Too much to do
And I still come back
For another truth

title: Stacked Up
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a row in the drawer
Silver bricks by the door
One for the couch, one for the ride
One for the pocket of my jeans tonight

Cables coiled in a cup
Little stash when I’m up
If one dies, I grab two
I like my plans fully charged too

[Pre-Chorus]
So when the screen starts fading
I’m already trading
One in, one out
No panic now

[Chorus]
I got power banks
Ready all day
I got power banks
Ain’t going away
(ready all day)
I got power banks
Play what I want
I got power banks
I never get stuck

[Verse 2]
Back seat, gym bag, shelf
I got backups for myself
Airport line, long drive home
I’m never caught alone

Friends say, “How you do that?”
I just grin and say that
If the battery drops low
I’ve got more where that came from

[Pre-Chorus]
So when the screen starts fading
I’m already trading
One in, one out
No panic now

[Chorus]
I got power banks
Ready all day
I got power banks
Ain’t going away
(ready all day)
I got power banks
Play what I want
I got power banks
I never get stuck

[Bridge]
Stacked like chips by the sink
I keep extras in the trunk
If the night runs long
I’m still on, still on
(still on, still on)

[Final Chorus]
I got power banks
Ready all day
I got power banks
Ain’t going away
(ready all day)
I got power banks
Play what I want
I got power banks
I never get stuck

title: Boarding Group Blue
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I know the smell of the jet bridge
Cold air, coffee, and rain
My bag leans off to the right
By Gate B-seventeen again

I keep my passport ready
Like a card I can’t lose
Same little plastic tray
Same shoes I slip through

[Pre-Chorus]
Boarding group blue
Got my name on the screen
I live between takeoff
And the in-between

No time to unpack
I just roll and I go
When the wheels kiss ground
I’m already low

[Chorus]
I’m a frequent flyer
(oh, I’m a frequent flyer)
Window seat higher
(keep me up in the sky)
I’m a frequent flyer
(card in my hand, bags tied)
One more stamp, one more mile
I was born to ride

[Verse 2]
Hotel key in my pocket
Wrinkled map in my head
I eat a takeout dinner
On the edge of the bed

I call from the curbside
“Yeah, I’m still in town”
By the time you wake up
I’m touching down

[Pre-Chorus]
Boarding group blue
Got my name on the screen
I live between takeoff
And the in-between

No time to unpack
I just roll and I go
When the wheels kiss ground
I’m already low

[Chorus]
I’m a frequent flyer
(oh, I’m a frequent flyer)
Window seat higher
(keep me up in the sky)
I’m a frequent flyer
(card in my hand, bags tied)
One more stamp, one more mile
I was born to ride

[Bridge]
Catch me at the carousel
Countin’ straps and tags
Suitcase scuffed up at the corners
But it never drags me back

Say my name through the speaker
And I’m already near
Half my life in departure
Half my heart right here

[Final Chorus]
I’m a frequent flyer
(oh, I’m a frequent flyer)
Window seat higher
(keep me up in the sky)
I’m a frequent flyer
(card in my hand, bags tied)
One more stamp, one more mile
I was born to ride

I’m a frequent flyer
(oh, I’m a frequent flyer)
Never staying long, I just glide
I’m a frequent flyer
(one more stamp, one more mile)
I was born to ride

title: Nap Away
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You got that look again
Like the day won't start
Shoes by the door
Keys in your hand
But your mind's still parked

A stubborn sky above
A heavy little load
I see you drag it home
Like a grocery bag
Full of stones

[Pre-Chorus]
Come sit by the fan
Let the minutes slow
Lay your head down
Let the hard stuff go

[Chorus]
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away
Hope and Clarity
Let the whole room fade
Close your eyes on me
Let the daylight break
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away

[Verse 2]
You don't need a speech
You don't need a plan
One soft landing spot
And that tight knot loosens
In your chest and hands

I'll keep the porch quiet
I'll keep the phone low
You can drift off first
I'll watch the clock
And guard the door

[Pre-Chorus]
Come sit by the fan
Let the minutes slow
Lay your head down
Let the hard stuff go

[Chorus]
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away
Hope and Clarity
Let the whole room fade
Close your eyes on me
Let the daylight break
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away

[Bridge]
When you wake up, baby
The edges won't bite
Same old world, but lighter
Same old you, but bright

[Final Chorus]
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away
Hope and Clarity
Let the whole room fade
Close your eyes on me
Let the daylight break
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away

title: Sanity Road
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I woke up in the wrong shirt
With my name on the floor
My keys in the sugar jar
And my doubts at the door

The sink full of cold light
The room all out of place
I laughed at the mirror
Then I lost my face

[Pre-Chorus]
Tell me where it goes
When it slips from sight
Tell me how to hold on
When I don't feel right

[Chorus]
Do you know the way back
Way back to sanity?
Do you know the way back
Baby, bring it back to me
I been too far out
I been split in two
Do you know the way back?
I need the road to you

[Verse 2]
My phone keeps buzzing empty
Like a hive with no bees
I keep checking old messages
For a version of me

The milk's gone sour
The bread's gone hard
Every little thing
Feels twice as far

[Pre-Chorus]
Tell me where it starts
When the fear breaks through
Tell me how to breathe
Like I used to

[Chorus]
Do you know the way back
Way back to sanity?
Do you know the way back
Baby, bring it back to me
I been too far out
I been split in two
Do you know the way back?
I need the road to you

[Bridge]
If I lost my map
If I lost my name
Meet me at the corner
Call me back again
One small step
One clear line
Pull me through the dark
Till I feel like mine

[Chorus]
Do you know the way back
Way back to sanity?
Do you know the way back
Baby, bring it back to me
I been too far out
I been split in two
Do you know the way back?
I need the road to you

title: When the Banners Come Down
lyrics:
[Intro: wind through torn banners, distant drum 🏳️]

[Verse 1: Folk-Rock]
When the banners come down,
Who will gather what remains?
Who will clear the broken stations?
Who will memorize the names?
The speeches will be archived.
The generals will depart.
The living will inherit
Every unexploded heart.

[Chorus: Epic Rock]
Bring the banners down slowly.
Let no victory hide the cost.
Honor courage without pretending
Nothing sacred was lost.
Mourn the soldier and civilian.
Mourn the enemy unknown.
No flag can make a grieving house
Feel less violently alone.

[Verse 2: Orchestral March]
War arrives in uniform,
But leaves in scattered clothes.
A boot beside a doorway.
Dust where someone grew a rose.
Peace enters without trumpets,
Carrying ledgers, bread, and wire.
It spends decades rebuilding
What took seconds to set fire.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore ⚡]
NO MORE GLORY
WITHOUT GRIEF!
NO MORE SLOGANS
SOLD AS PEACE!
NO MORE CHILDREN
PAYING DEBTS
FOR ANGER THEY DID NOT CREATE!

[Bridge: piano and mass choir 🕊️]
Anti-war does not mean passive.
Peace is labor. Peace is brave.
It means resisting easy hatred
Before hatred chooses graves.
It means defending human freedom
Without falling in love with force.
It means every road to battle
Must answer for its course.

[Final Chorus: Full Orchestra 🌅]
Bring the banners down slowly.
Raise the roofs and clear the mines.
Turn the factories toward living.
Let diplomacy have time.
Care for those who carried
What the powerful designed.
A nation proves its honor
By the peace it leaves behind.

[Outro: drum stops, hammers rebuilding]
No final victory.

Only fewer funerals.

Let that be enough.

title: The Permanent Emergency
lyrics:
[Intro: emergency broadcast tone, ticking synth 🚨]

[Verse 1: Post-Punk]
They said the danger waited
Just beyond the morning news.
So we surrendered questions
For the safety they would choose.
The temporary powers
Needed only one more year.
But every fading enemy
Produced a fresher fear.

[Chorus: Dark Synth-Rock]
Welcome to the permanent emergency,
Where peace is always premature.
The war must never finish
Or the guardians lose their cure.
Every budget needs a monster.
Every weapon needs a need.
Fear becomes the constitution.
War becomes the air we breathe.

[Verse 2: Spoken Broadcast]
Threat elevated.
Funding approved.
Oversight delayed.
Opposition removed.
A conflict ends.
A doctrine stays.
The machinery requires
More dangerous days.

[Genre Shift: Hardcore ⚡]
WHO BENEFITS
WHEN FEAR WON’T END?
WHO SELLS THE SHIELD?
WHO NAMES THE THREAT?
If safety needs forever war,
When do we become secure?

[Bridge: quiet piano]
Not every threat is fiction.
Not every guard deceives.
But emergency corrodes a state
When nobody ever leaves.
Power granted under panic
Rarely walks itself away.
A free society must question
What its fear permits today.

[Final Chorus: Defiant choir 🕊️]
End the permanent emergency.
Make every power face the light.
Demand an end, a measured goal,
A reason for the fight.
Security without freedom
Is a prison painted strong.
Peace begins when citizens
Can ask who profits from the alarm.

[Outro: broadcast tone powers down]
This emergency has been extended.

[Second voice]
By whom?

title: The Enemy's Lullaby
lyrics:
[Intro: two parents humming the same melody in different languages 🌙]

[Verse 1: Intimate Folk]
Across the border, someone
Tucked a child beneath a sheet.
They checked the darkened window
At the sound of distant feet.
They sang a little melody
About stars above the rain.
My mother sang its twin to me,
With different words and names.

[Chorus: Cinematic Folk-Rock]
The enemy sings lullabies.
The enemy grows old.
The enemy keeps photographs
And fears the coming cold.
A uniform can hide a life.
A flag can hide a face.
The enemy is human,
Even when we hate their state.

[Verse 2: Dueling percussion]
This truth does not erase
The cruelty people choose.
It does not make aggression
Something victims must excuse.
But if we strip their humanity,
We strip away our own.
Every war begins by teaching
That their children are not home.

[Genre Shift: Heavy Rock ⚡]
CALL THEM VERMIN!
CALL THEM MAD!
MAKE THE SLAUGHTER SOUND LESS BAD!
ERASE THE MOTHER!
HIDE THE SON!
TURN A MILLION INTO ONE!

[Break: lullaby returns]

[Bridge: duet]
I may resist your army.
I may stand against your law.
I may fight to guard the innocent
From everything I saw.
But hatred is a weapon
That survives the final shot.
If peace requires a future,
Humanity cannot be forgot.

[Final Chorus: Two choirs joining 🕊️]
The enemy sings lullabies.
So listen through the night.
Not to surrender justice,
But to keep its purpose right.
A lasting peace needs memory,
Accountability, and grace.
The enemy is human.
We must never lose that fact.

[Outro: two children breathing]
Different flags.

The same moon.

title: The Market Closed in Green
lyrics:
[Intro: opening bell, ticker sounds, danceable bass 📈]

[Verse 1: Electro-Funk]
The missiles crossed the midnight.
By breakfast, shares had climbed.
A smiling anchor told us
That defense performed just fine.
The village lost its power.
The market gained a point.
Death arrived fragmented
Across a profitable joint.

[Chorus: Dark Disco]
The market closed in green
While the skyline burned in red.
Somebody rang a golden bell.
Somebody counted dead.
War makes terrible weather,
But excellent demand.
The portfolio looks healthy
When destruction has a brand.

[Verse 2: Funk, spoken financial jargon]
Guidance raised.
Contracts signed.
Risk adjusted.
Margins fine.
Replacement parts.
Extended fight.
Recurring revenue every night.

A ceasefire frightened traders.
Peace threatened future sales.
The numbers loved uncertainty.
The humans hated wails.

[Genre Shift: Industrial Rock ⚡]
BUY THE FEAR!
SELL THE CURE!
KEEP THE CONFLICT JUST SECURE
ENOUGH TO LAST!
NOT END TOO FAST!
TURN THE FUTURE INTO CASH!

[Bridge: strings replace beat]
Markets are not monsters.
They reward what rules permit.
If violence guarantees returns,
Then capital follows it.
The question is political:
What outcomes do we buy?
What industries grow powerful
Whenever chances die?

[Final Chorus: Orchestra and choir 🕊️]
Let the market close in green
Because the hospitals were built.
Because the mines were cleared away,
And nations traded guilt.
Make peace a better business.
Make repair command the floor.
No balance sheet should celebrate
The lengthening of war.

[Outro: closing bell, silence]
Shares rose.

So did the smoke.

title: The Recruiters Polished Shoes
lyrics:
[Intro: school bell, polished shoes crossing tile 👞]

[Verse 1: Dark Americana]
The recruiter wore a uniform
Without a thread misplaced.
He promised work and purpose
To a boy the town erased.
Tuition waited somewhere.
The rent was overdue.
The brochure showed a sunrise
And a future dressed in blue.

[Chorus: Marching Rock]
He did not join for conquest.
He joined to pay the bills.
The empire found its soldiers
Where the factory left the hills.
They call the bargain service,
But choices shrink when hunger grows.
A volunteer may sign the page
Because there’s nowhere else to go.

[Verse 2: Spoken Rap, snare and bass]
No trust fund.
No safety net.
No paid degree.
No clean escape.
Offer healthcare.
Offer pride.
Place a rifle on the other side.

The wealthy praise his courage.
Their children study law.
His mother saves each message
And avoids the evening news.

[Genre Shift: Punk ⚡]
DON’T YOU DARE
CONFUSE THIS SONG
WITH BLAMING THOSE
WHO MARCHED ALONG!
HONOR THE PERSON!
QUESTION THE PLAN!
LOVE THE SOLDIER!
CHALLENGE COMMAND!

[Bridge: mournful trumpet]
A uniform holds someone
Who laughed and feared before.
They deserve more than slogans
When they return from war.
If service earns our gratitude,
Then gratitude must stay
Through nightmares, broken bodies,
And the paperwork’s delay.

[Final Chorus: Choir enters 🕊️]
He did not join for conquest.
He joined to make a life.
Do not spend his future cheaply.
Do not decorate the price.
Build a country worth defending
Without needing endless foes.
Give every child a future
Before asking them to go.

[Outro: school bell]
The polished shoes departed.

The brochure stayed behind.

title: Peace Has No Parade
lyrics:
[Intro: empty street, soft acoustic guitar 🕊️]

[Verse 1: Folk]
Peace has no parade route.
No missiles polished bright.
No commentators tracing
Colored arrows through the night.
It happens in a back room
When exhausted rivals speak.
It looks like boring paperwork
Repeated week by week.

[Chorus: Gospel Folk]
Peace has no parade,
But it keeps the children whole.
It does not conquer cities.
It refuses to control.
No statues praise restraint.
No medals honor doubt.
Yet peace is every battlefield
We found a way around.

[Verse 2: Gentle Brass Band]
The loudest men seem fearless
When they promise righteous flame.
The quiet ones ask questions
And are mocked for feeling shame.
A treaty lacks the drama
Of a jet across the sun.
But courage sometimes means
Returning home without the gun.

[Genre Shift: Driving Rock 🥁]
NEGOTIATE!
DE-ESCALATE!
CALL BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE!
LET THEM LAUGH!
LET THEM JEER!
KEEP A MILLION FAMILIES HERE!

[Bridge: piano and close vocal]
Peace cannot cure every tyrant.
Talk cannot answer every threat.
But war should face the burden
Of what cannot be reset.
Force may stop a moment.
It cannot build the trust
That keeps another generation
From inheriting the dust.

[Final Chorus: Post-Rock crescendo 🌅]
Peace has no parade,
So let us gather in the street
For the wars that never happened
And the strangers we could meet.
Raise a monument to patience.
Ring the bells for battles spared.
Honor those who chose the harder path
When rage was unprepared.

[Outro: morning traffic, children laughing]
Nothing happened today.

Thank God.

title: Maps Don't Bleed
lyrics:
[Intro: pencil on paper, low snare, radio static 🗺️]

[Verse 1: Piano Ballad]
They moved a colored marker
Across a laminated land.
A village became “sector.”
A family became “demand.”
The river was an asset.
The school became a zone.
No map contained the trembling
Of a child who slept alone.

[Chorus: Cinematic Art Rock]
Maps don’t bleed.
Tables never cry.
Arrows cross a border
Without hearing mothers ask why.
A plan looks clean from heaven.
A target has no eyes.
Maps don’t bleed,
But everything beneath them dies.

[Verse 2: Military March]
The briefing used precision,
Said the strike was “surgically clean.”
But language cannot disinfect
What burning buildings mean.
A percentage became acceptable.
A life became a rate.
The distance between words and wounds
Made conscience hesitate.

[Spoken Word: march disappears]
A map is useful.
A map is necessary.
But when the map replaces the people,
strategy becomes permission.

[Genre Shift: Heavy Orchestral Rock ⚡]
ZOOM IN!
SEE THE WINDOWS!
SEE THE LAUNDRY!
SEE THE NAMES!
NO ONE LIVES IN “COLLATERAL!”
NO CHILD RESIDES IN “AIMS!”

[Bridge: children’s choir humming]
The enemy has breakfast.
The ally buries sons.
Civilians learn no difference
Between righteous and wicked guns.
Every border drawn in ink
Cuts through somebody’s sky.
No legend marks the place
Where certainty goes to die.

[Final Chorus: Full Orchestra 🕊️]
Maps don’t bleed,
So bring the living near.
Place their faces in the briefing.
Make the consequence appear.
If leaders choose destruction,
Let no language sanitize.
Maps don’t bleed.
That is precisely why maps lie.

[Outro: pencil snaps]
Target removed.

People remained.

title: The Orchard of Blowback
lyrics:
[Intro: wind through trees, distant rotor, plucked strings 🌳]

[Verse 1: Desert Folk]
We planted iron seeds
In soil we never learned to name.
We watered them with promises
And fenced them round with blame.
We left before the harvest,
Declared the garden free.
Then acted shocked when bitter fruit
Appeared upon the tree.

[Chorus: Psychedelic Rock]
Every bomb becomes a memory.
Every memory finds a child.
Every child may learn the language
Of the thunder in the sky.
You can win the field by morning.
You can own the map by noon.
But blowback keeps a calendar
And does not arrive too soon.

[Verse 2: Trip-Hop, fractured radio voices 📻]
We armed tomorrow’s enemy
To fight today’s old friend.
We called the bargain temporary.
The weapons missed the end.
Each intervention drew a line.
Each line produced a side.
We built a maze of consequences,
Then bombed the ones inside.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore ⚡]
CAUSE!
EFFECT!
FORGET!
REPEAT!
MAKE AN ENEMY,
THEN CLAIM DEFEAT!
Every orphan keeps the record.
Every ruin knows the date.
History does not lose the address
Where we mailed another hate.

[Bridge: quiet cello]
This does not excuse the killer.
Pain does not make murder right.
But wisdom studies origins
Before returning fire at night.
Security needs memory.
Justice must examine cause.
Otherwise, revenge puts medals
On an endless chain of loss.

[Final Chorus: choir and rising strings 🕊️]
Every peace becomes a memory.
Every memory guides a child.
Plant a treaty in the wreckage.
Let another orchard rise.
You cannot change the harvest
While repeating what you sow.
Blowback is tomorrow asking
What we did not want to know.

[Outro: shovel entering soil]
Choose the seed.

title: The Factory That Never Sleeps
lyrics:
[Intro: assembly line, steel press, time clock 🏭]

[Verse 1: Industrial Blues]
My father built the engines.
His father forged the shells.
The factory kept our town alive
By manufacturing hell.
The whistle called at sunrise.
The furnace painted dawn.
We prayed the wars would finish,
Then wondered what we’d live upon.

[Chorus: Heavy Industrial Rock]
The factory never sleeps.
It only changes enemies.
Peace arrives with empty hands,
But war purchases by threes.
We hate what leaves the loading dock.
We need the wages every week.
A town survives by feeding
What it’s terrified to meet.

[Verse 2: Dark Synthwave]
Executives on television
Spoke gravely of defense.
Then quarterly projections
Rose by fourteen percent.
They never pulled the lever.
They never smelled the steel.
They only called destruction
A diversified portfolio yield.

[Spoken: machinery becomes rhythm]
Jobs are real.
Rent is real.
So are the bodies
At the other end of the deal.

[Genre Shift: Punk ⚡]
DON’T BLAME THE HANDS
THAT NEED THE PAY!
FOLLOW THE MONEY
THE OTHER WAY!
BUILD THEM TRAINS!
BUILD THEM HOMES!
GIVE THE FURNACE BETTER BONES!

[Bridge: acoustic guitar, workers humming]
What if peace employed us?
What if bridges paid as well?
What if all this human talent
Built something else to sell?
The welder needs no lecture.
The machinist bears no stain.
Give the town another future,
And it will never choose the chain.

[Final Chorus: Workers’ Choir 🕊️]
Let the factory finally sleep,
Then wake to different dreams.
Let it forge the windmill tower,
Lay the rail, repair the beams.
We can honor honest labor
Without worshipping the gun.
No town should need a battlefield
To keep its children fed.

[Outro: machines power down, birds emerge]
First shift canceled.

New work begins Monday.

title: The Invoice After  Victory
lyrics:
[Intro: victory trumpets detuning into cash-register bells 💰]

[Verse 1: Martial Cabaret]
The generals declared the ending
From a balcony of gold.
The crowd received a victory
With souvenirs already sold.
Confetti filled the avenues.
The bells performed their part.
Then someone left an invoice
At the doorstep of each heart.

One line for shattered bridges.
One line for missing sons.
Interest on the promises
That justified the guns.
A charge for every hospital
That budgets could not save.
A generation’s future
Transferred neatly to the grave.

[Chorus: Orchestral Rock]
Who pays the bill when victory
Has finished its parade?
The worker pays in taxes.
The soldier pays in pain.
The child pays with tomorrow.
The refugee pays twice.
The men who sold the battle
Never seem to know the price.

[Verse 2: Industrial Waltz ⚙️]
The minister said, “Necessary.”
The banker said, “Secure.”
The contractor said, “Freedom
Has expenses to endure.”
They borrowed from the unborn
To purchase yesterday,
Then called the debt patriotic
When the interest came due.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore ⚡]
COUNT THE BOMBS!
COUNT THE GAINS!
COUNT EVERYTHING EXCEPT THE NAMES!
CALL IT GROWTH!
CALL IT PEACE!
KEEP THE PROFIT!
LEASE THE GRIEF!

[Bridge: bare piano]
A nation’s wealth is hours
That its people cannot reclaim.
Steel can guard a border.
It cannot heal a name.
Every weapon has a second cost
Beyond the factory floor:
The school that stayed unfinished
Because somebody needed war.

[Final Chorus: choir rising 🕊️]
Who pays the bill when victory
Has faded into gray?
We all inherit interest
On the choices leaders made.
If peace appears expensive,
Place war beside its cost.
Count not only what was purchased.
Count everything we lost.

[Outro: one coin spinning, then falling]
Paid in full?

[Whisper]
Never.

title: One Person, Finally
lyrics:
[Intro: motifs from earlier songs returning, soft piano 🪞]

[Verse 1: Piano Ballad]
I met the saint and monster.
I met the king and clown.
The architect kept building.
The runaway burned it down.
The lighthouse begged for worship.
The auction sold my name.
Every figure claimed my body.
Every figure wore my face.

[Chorus: Art Pop, drums slowly rising]
Can I be one person finally,
Without cutting parts away?
Can kindness live with hunger?
Can ambition learn to stay?
I am not a contradiction
That some clever truth will solve.
I am every former version
Still deciding to evolve.

[Verse 2: Theatrical Waltz]
I wanted every lover.
I wanted solitude.
I wanted endless freedom
And a life securely rooted.
I wanted to be humble
While the whole world knew my worth.
I wanted resurrection
Without admitting what I hurt.

[Genre Shift: Gospel Rock, choir 🔥]
No final transformation!
No spotless second birth!
No single grand confession
Makes me master of my worth!
Growth is in the choices
Too ordinary for songs.
The moment I stop feeding
What I know will lead me wrong.

[Voices returning]
[Monster] I’m hungry.
[Saint] Then feed something kind.
[Runaway] I’m frightened.
[Architect] We’ll build with exits in mind.
[Child] Will they love us?
[Narrator] Some won’t.
[Child] Will we live?
[Narrator] This time.

[Final Chorus: Full orchestra, massive choir 🌅]
I can be one person finally,
Though tomorrow I may change.
Not cured of every wanting.
Not delivered from my shame.
I can love without consuming.
I can shine without a throne.
I can choose a life with others
Without treating them as home.

I am flawed and still responsible.
I am frightened and still free.
I am not the crowd’s reflection.
I am not who I might be.
Every voice remains within me,
But their war no longer wins.
One person does not mean one impulse.
It means choosing who begins.

[Outro: instruments disappear one by one]
No halo.
No crown.
No stage.
No disguise.

[Whisper]
Just me.

[Heartbeat]
Finally.

title: The Man Who Outran Tomorrow
lyrics:
[Intro: running footsteps, stopwatch, rising bass 🏃]

[Verse 1: Driving Indie Rock]
I woke before the sunrise
To get ahead of day.
I answered every message
Before words could decay.
I built a dozen monuments,
Then measured what came next.
Tomorrow chased behind me
With another list of tests.

[Chorus: Anthemic Rock]
Run faster than tomorrow!
Make the future know your name!
If you stop to feel the sunlight,
Someone else may win the race!
But what is all this motion
If arrival never stays?
I keep conquering the distance
While abandoning the days.

[Verse 2: Electronic Rock]
My friends became appointments.
My meals became a task.
I called exhaustion purpose
So nobody thought to ask.
Each victory moved the finish line.
Each milestone raised the bet.
I lived for future memories
I never stopped to get.

[Spoken Rap: ticking percussion]
Optimize the morning.
Monetize the night.
Turn a life into a ladder.
Turn the ladder into height.
Publish. Travel. Build. Repeat.
Never let the silence speak.
Productivity is wonderful
When you’re frightened of the week.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore ⚡]
WHAT IF I STOP?
WHO AM I THEN?
NO NEXT ACHIEVEMENT!
NO APPLAUSE AGAIN!
If I cannot earn tomorrow,
Do I disappear today?

[Bridge: strings and piano 🌄]
The future never asked me
To arrive there incomplete.
Ambition need not murder
Every moment at my feet.
I can build with fierce devotion
And still look someone in the eyes.
A pause does not surrender.
Rest does not erase the climb.

[Final Chorus: Post-Rock crescendo]
I won’t outrun tomorrow.
It knows where I will be.
I’ll make the future patiently
Without abandoning me.
There are mountains worth ascending.
There are mornings worth the wait.
A meaningful direction
Does not sanctify the pace.

[Outro: footsteps slow]
The clock continued.

So did I.

title: The Paliament of Me
lyrics:
[Intro: chamber murmurs, gavel strike, strings 🏛️]

[Speaker]
The Parliament of Me will come to order.
The body will debate whether to live.

[Verse 1: Theatrical Rock]
Ambition took the podium
And promised endless height.
Compassion raised an objection:
“Who gets crushed beneath the flight?”
Desire formed a coalition
With Novelty and Fame.
Duty read the minutes
And demanded I remain.

[Chorus: Arena Rock]
Motion made!
Motion denied!
Every faction claims my life.
If I follow one command,
Three others call it suicide.
How can I choose a future
When my truths refuse to blend?
The Parliament keeps speaking.
The session never ends.

[Verse 2: Cabaret-Funk 🎭]
Fear proposed a compromise:
“Delay another year.”
Hope amended every clause
Until nothing remained clear.
Love requested permanence.
Freedom shouted, “Never sign!”
My body waited in the hall
While arguments consumed the time.

[Genre Shift: Militaristic Punk ⚡]
ALL IN FAVOR?
AYE!
ALL OPPOSED?
AYE!
EVERY ROAD IS TREASON
TO THE SELVES I LEAVE BEHIND!

[Break]
The chamber fell to silence
When Mortality walked in.

[Mortality]
You may debate forever.
Time will still adjourn.

[Bridge: somber piano]
Perhaps I need no verdict
That satisfies the room.
A choice can be imperfect
And still give life its bloom.
These voices earn a hearing,
But none possesses me.
Leadership is choosing
Without total certainty.

[Final Chorus: Orchestra and choir 🌅]
Motion made:
Begin the life.
Let dissent remain alive.
Ambition, love, and duty
May all lose and still survive.
The Parliament keeps speaking,
But I finally understand:
I am not every argument.
I am the one who stands.

[Outro: gavel]
Motion carried.

By one trembling vote.

title: Love Through Reinforced Glass
lyrics:
[Intro: notification tone, rain, distant synth 📱]

[Verse 1: Ambient R&B]
Across the miles, I tell you truths
I hide from nearby eyes.
Distance makes a chapel
Where confession safely flies.
You cannot watch me hesitate
Or see me leave the room.
I send the bravest version
From the safety of the moon.

[Chorus: Dream-Pop]
We love through reinforced glass,
Close enough to see.
You touch the words around my heart,
But never physically.
Is distance what divides us,
Or the reason we survive?
Would this connection deepen
If our separate worlds arrived?

[Verse 2: Minimal electronic pulse 🌌]
We fill the gaps with fantasies
No daily life corrects.
You never leave the dishes.
I never miss your text.
We meet as chosen sentences,
Edited and bright.
Our souls become enormous
When our bodies miss the night.

[Genre Shift: Industrial Rock ⚡]
WHAT HAPPENS WHEN THE SIGNAL
BECOMES A DOOR?
WHEN YOUR DREAMING FEET
ARRIVE UPON MY FLOOR?
Can intimacy breathe
Without the distance as disguise?
Can we keep the sacred truth
When ordinary daylight rises?

[Bridge: piano and distant duet]
Perhaps the miles are neither fraud
Nor proof that this is pure.
The bond can still be beautiful
While answers stay unsure.
But if we ever cross the space,
We must meet without the screen.
Not as our perfect messages,
But everything between.

[Final Chorus: Cinematic swell 🌅]
We love through reinforced glass,
But glass can crack or clear.
I want the person past the words,
Not only who appears.
If distance ends, will we begin,
Or lose what distance made?
I cannot know until our shadows
Stand together unafraid.

[Outro: call disconnects, heartbeat remains]
Goodnight from here.

Good morning there.

title: The Beautiful Emergency
lyrics:
[Intro: sirens in key, pulsing synth, excited breathing 🚨]

[Verse 1: Neon Synth-Pop]
I fell in love with sirens,
With the sprint before the crash.
Ordinary mornings
Never burned enough or fast.
I called the chaos passion.
I called the danger fate.
Calm arrived with flowers.
I made calm sit down and wait.

[Chorus: Disco-Rock]
Give me a beautiful emergency,
A reason not to sleep.
Give me a love that climbs the walls
And promises too deep.
When nothing needs rescuing,
I wonder if it’s real.
Have I confused intensity
With having something true to feel?

[Verse 2: Funk bass, clipped vocal 🪩]
I trust the sudden heartbeat,
The impossible demand.
A stable life feels empty
When no fire needs my hands.
So I create a crisis,
Then perform the great escape.
I blame the world for burning
While I’m striking every match.

[Genre Shift: Frantic Punk ⚡]
RUN FAST!
LOVE HARD!
TURN PEACE INTO A GRAVEYARD!
BREAK DOWN!
REUNITE!
CALL THE DAMAGE APPETITE!

[Bridge: power-ballad piano 🌧️]
What if love is morning coffee?
What if purpose sometimes waits?
What if safety isn’t boredom?
What if calm creates?
Perhaps a steady heartbeat
Is not passion growing weak.
Perhaps the life I say I want
Is quieter than the thrill I seek.

[Final Chorus: Arena Rock 🌅]
No more beautiful emergencies
Invented for the flame.
I can live without disaster
Making every day feel named.
The craving may still call me
Toward the cliff to prove I’m free.
But I’ll learn the harder courage
Of remaining peacefully.

[Outro: siren stops, birds begin]
Nothing is burning.

Stay.

title: A Guest Room in Every Heart
lyrics:
[Intro: hotel bell, distant voices, soft guitar 🏨]

[Verse 1: Dream-Pop]
I kept a guest room in each heart
That opened up to me.
Fresh flowers by the window.
No charge, but never free.
I left a shirt in every closet,
A promise by each bed,
So somewhere someone missed me
Whenever loneliness was fed.

[Chorus: Romantic Rock]
I want a home in every heart,
Yet never one address.
I want the depth of being known
Without the weight of permanence.
I want every door left open,
Every light beside the stairs.
But how can I belong to all
Without belonging anywhere?

[Verse 2: Waltz, accordion and strings 🎭]
One heart offered breakfast
And a drawer to call my own.
I praised the lovely curtains,
Then remembered somewhere else was home.
I mistook being welcomed
For a right to come and go.
They mistook my warm arrival
For a vow I didn’t know.

[Genre Shift: Dark Trip-Hop 🌒]
Check in.
Check out.
Leave tenderness in doubt.
Take the key.
Keep it near.
Return when solitude appears.

[Post-Hardcore Burst ⚡]
THEY ARE NOT ROOMS!
THEY ARE LIVES!
NOT SAFEHOUSES
FOR LONELY NIGHTS!

[Bridge: bare acoustic guitar]
Connection is not ownership.
Affection is not fraud.
But every open invitation
Does not make me someone’s god.
I must tell them when I’m passing.
I must name what I can give.
A heart is not a hotel.
It is where another person lives.

[Final Chorus: Cinematic duet 🌅]
I cannot live in every heart.
I cannot promise every stay.
I can enter with sincerity
And leave without decay.
Perhaps belonging asks me
To let other doorways close.
To choose one room imperfectly
And become the one who knows.

[Outro: key placed on desk]
No reservation.
Just a choice.

title: A Crown of Borrowed Stars
lyrics:
[Intro: camera shutters, cosmic synths, crowd chanting 👑]

[Verse 1: Glam Rock]
I stitched a crown from borrowed stars
And wore it through the night.
Each jewel was someone’s compliment.
Each flash confirmed my light.
I climbed because the summit
Made the crowd appear so small.
But every higher platform
Needed louder love from all.

[Chorus: Cosmic Arena Rock]
Am I reaching for the heavens
Or escaping who I am?
Do I want to build a legacy,
Or prove I’m worth a damn?
Ambition says, “Keep climbing.”
Peace asks, “Toward what end?”
If nobody saw the summit,
Would I still attempt the ascent?

[Verse 2: Disco-Funk 🪩]
I shook a thousand hands
While checking who had watched me shine.
I called the hunger purpose.
I called the envy drive.
Every victory tasted briefly
Like the person I should be.
Then applause became an echo,
And the echo asked for three.

[Genre Shift: Heavy Rock ⚡]
MORE BOOKS!
MORE STAGES!
MORE PROOF ON ALL THE PAGES!
BUILD THE TOWER!
RING THE BELL!
MAKE SUCCESS TOO LARGE TO FAIL!

[Silence]

[Spoken]
But towers make poor mirrors.

[Bridge: orchestral piano 🌌]
Maybe wanting more is honest.
Maybe greatness isn’t sin.
Maybe I can chase the horizon
Without fleeing what’s within.
A dream can serve the dreamer.
A dream can serve the crowd.
The difference lives in who remains
When nobody cheers aloud.

[Final Chorus: Choir and soaring guitar 🌅]
I’ll still reach for the heavens,
But I’ll name the reasons why.
I’ll build because creation
Makes me feel intensely alive.
I’ll wear no borrowed starlight.
I’ll let praise arrive and end.
If no one sees the summit,
I will still have made the climb.

[Outro]
The crown fell off.
The sky remained.

title: The Apology Machine
lyrics:
[Intro: gears turning, receipt printer, mechanical voice ⚙️]

[Machine]
Insert regret.
Select offense.
Receive acceptable remorse.

[Verse 1: Industrial Cabaret]
I built a grand machine
To manufacture perfect shame.
It polished every “sorry”
And engraved the victim’s name.
I fed it sleepless evenings,
Every failure, every flaw.
It printed proof that hating me
Would satisfy the law.

[Chorus: Synth-Rock]
How sorry must I become
Before the past releases me?
If suffering proves goodness,
I’ll be good eternally.
But guilt that changes nothing
Is a spotlight dressed as pain.
I keep starring in repentance
While the wounded wait in rain.

[Verse 2: Mechanical Funk]
I apologized in sonnets.
I confessed in minor keys.
I made my self-condemnation
The emotional centerpiece.
They came to name the damage.
I explained how badly I felt.
Once again, their wound became
A story mostly about myself.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore ⚡]
STOP MAKING YOUR SHAME
THE LOUDEST THING IN THE ROOM!
REMORSE IS NOT REPAIR!
A TEAR IS NOT A BROOM!

[Breakdown]
NAME IT!
FACE IT!
MAKE AMENDS!
CHANGE THE PATTERN!
DON’T PRETEND!

[Bridge: bare piano 🌧️]
Perhaps the hardest apology
Is quiet and complete.
No plea to be forgiven.
No collapse around their feet.
Just truth without performance,
And tomorrow lived anew.
Not “Look how much I hate myself,”
But “Here is what I’ll do.”

[Final Chorus: Orchestral Rock]
How sorry must I become?
Only honest enough to change.
I cannot make the past absolve me
Or command their hurt to fade.
I’ll dismantle the machine
That made my guilt a crown.
Then build a life that leaves
A little less to be sorry about.

[Outro: gears stopping]
No receipt.
No applause.
Just repair.

title: The Lighthouse Wants Applause
lyrics:
[Intro: foghorn, lonely piano, waves 🌊]

[Verse 1: Maritime Art Rock]
I built myself upon the rocks
Where desperate vessels turn.
I promised every sinking ship
My faithful light would burn.
They called me brave and generous.
They blessed my tireless flame.
But every sailor rescued
Had to memorize my name.

[Chorus: Arena Rock, crashing drums]
I want to guide them home,
But I want them looking back.
I want to be their north star,
Not a lantern on the map.
Is goodness still called goodness
When it needs a cheering crowd?
I shine to save the drowning,
Then demand they praise me loud.

[Verse 2: Dark Cabaret 🎭]
One ship arrived with damage
No beacon could repair.
I offered navigation.
They only needed someone there.
When they sailed without thanking me,
I cursed their safe return.
What kind of lighthouse hates the ships
That no longer need its burn?

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore ⚡]
I SAVED YOU!
[Echo] So love me!
I HELD YOU!
[Echo] So owe me!
I made a gift of kindness,
Then enclosed a silent fee.
Was I lighting up the shoreline,
Or directing eyes to me?

[Bridge: Gospel Soul, organ rising]
A light does not own travelers.
A hand does not own trust.
Love cannot call itself a gift
Then turn devotion into must.
I may still enjoy the gratitude.
I may ache when none appears.
But I can shine without converting
Someone’s rescue into cheers.

[Final Chorus: Full choir 🌅]
I’ll try to guide them home
Without demanding they return.
I’ll tend the flame because it matters,
Not because they watch it burn.
The need for recognition
May still thunder through my chest.
But a lighthouse serves the sailors,
Not the hunger to be blessed.

[Outro: waves, lamp clicking off]
Tonight, no ships are watching.
Still, I keep the light.

title: The Harbor and the Horizon
lyrics:
[Intro: harbor bells, creaking wood, distant thunder ⚓]

[The Harbor, warm low voice]
Stay where the water knows your name.
No dream is worth becoming rain.

[Verse 1: Gentle Folk-Rock, acoustic guitar 🌤️]
I built a life of sturdy rooms,
A key for every door.
A table set, a steady check,
No wolves outside the floor.
The days arrived predictably.
The nights required no fight.
Safety wrapped around my heart
And held it almost tight.

Beyond the glass, the vessels left
For countries without names.
Each sail became a question.
Each lantern fed a flame.

[The Horizon, distant harmony]
You weren’t born to watch departures.
You were born to leave the bay.

[Chorus: Cinematic Rock, drums rising 🧭]
The harbor says, “I’ll hold you.”
The horizon says, “Become.”
One promises tomorrow.
One ignites what I might run from.
If I stay, will I grow peaceful,
Or just learn to call fear wise?
If I sail, will I find meaning,
Or watch everything capsize?

There is no riskless future.
There is no perfect sign.
Every road protects one version
While abandoning another life.

[Verse 2: Maritime Waltz, accordion and strings 🌊]

[The Harbor]
Think of those who need you.
Think of everything you’ve made.
Ambition loves the sunlight,
But forgets the debts it leaves unpaid.

[The Horizon]
Think of all your unlived years,
Still sleeping past the foam.
Security can guard a life
That never feels like home.

[Narrator]
One voice sounds like wisdom.
One resembles cowardice.
One voice calls me forward.
One might sell a dream at twice the price.

[Genre Shift: Progressive Rock, shifting rhythm, dueling guitars ⚡]
I studied every current.
I calculated every storm.
I waited for assurance
Till indecision felt like form.
But maps cannot discover
What a traveler refuses.
Time will choose a direction
When the frightened never chooses.

[Breakdown: Post-Hardcore, crashing waves]

[Harbor]
STAY!

[Horizon]
GO!

[Narrator]
HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO KNOW?

[Harbor]
KEEP WHAT’S YOURS!

[Horizon]
RISK THE SHORE!

[Narrator]
EVERY YES WILL CLOSE A DOOR!

[Bridge: piano, storm suddenly quiet 🌙]
Perhaps courage is not sailing.
Perhaps caution is not chains.
Some ambitions deserve burial.
Some safe lives deserve their names.
The choice is not between
A hero and a frightened man.
It is choosing which regret
I am prepared to understand.

[Final Chorus: Full Orchestra, choir, soaring guitar 🌅]
The harbor still may hold me.
The horizon still may lie.
But I would rather test my wings
Than spend my years describing sky.
I will pack what I can carry.
I will grieve what cannot come.
Ambition has no guarantees,
But safety promised none.

There is no riskless future.
So the choice must still be mine.
I release the perfect answer.
I will choose, then give it time.
Not because the sea is kinder,
Or the harbor has no worth.
I am sailing toward the person
Only movement brings to birth.

[Outro: sails catching wind, heartbeat and gulls ⛵]

[The Harbor]
You may return.

[The Horizon]
You may transform.

[Narrator]
Raise the sail.

[Final swell]

title: Loose Button Jeans
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I know my laugh is loud
I know my shoulders shine
I can walk in a room
And own it every time

But the mirror says
"Look closer, look again"
And I pick at one soft line
Like it’s the whole of me

[Pre-Chorus]
You say my name like truth
Like you mean it when you do
I want to run to you
Then I lock up in the blue

[Chorus]
Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
When I don’t fit my own idea
Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
I want to say yes, but I’m not there yet

[Verse 2]
I don’t need a rescue
I don’t need a crown
I got fire in my hands
I can hold my ground

Still I fold my shirt
And judge the way it hangs
Like one hard thought can turn
My whole world into shame

[Pre-Chorus]
You say my name like truth
Like you mean it when you do
I want to lean on you
Then I back away, confused

[Chorus]
Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
When I don’t fit my own idea
Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
I want to say yes, but I’m not there yet

[Bridge]
Maybe love ain’t earned
By shrinking down at night
Maybe I can be enough
Even with my hard-edged side

If you stay, stay close
Not to fix me, just to see
I’m more than this old doubt
More than what I fear in me

[Final Chorus]
Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
When I don’t fit my own idea
Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
I’m trying to believe what you already see

Can you love me still?
Can you love me still?
I want to say yes, and now I’m here

title: Broken First
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to flinch at love
Like it owed me debt
Little me in the backseat
Holding every breath

First crush, first cut
Same cold lesson learned
If I touched it gently
Why'd it still get burned?

[Pre-Chorus]
So I wore my armor thin
Called it being strong
But every door I closed
Was a wound all along

[Chorus]
Maybe I broke first
Maybe I broke first
Heart for a heart
That's how it rehearsed
Maybe I broke first
(Yeah, I broke first)
All the ones I hurt
Were hurt before I hurt

[Verse 2]
Your name still hits me
Like glass in the sink
I can trace the pattern
If I really think

Daddy's silence
Mama's tears at night
I learned to leave before
Anybody left my sight

[Pre-Chorus]

title: The Distance has a Pulse

[Intro: faint radio static, lonely piano, distant heartbeat 🌌]

[Verse 1: Intimate Dream-Pop]

We cannot close the space between

But you have held the truest me
Without ever holding my hands.

[Verse 2: Ambient R&B, whispered harmonies 🌙]
You know the names of all my shadows.
I know where your defenses bend.
We trade the truths we hide from daylight,
Unsure where lover starts from friend.
Perhaps the distance makes us honest.
There is no body to distract.
Just every fear placed on the table
And every careful answer back.

Sometimes your silence feels like absence.
Sometimes mine becomes a wall.
But even oceans cannot counterfeit
The courage of your call.

[Genre Shift: Orchestral Post-Rock, drums awakening 🌊]
If closeness is attention,
Then you have lived beside me.
If intimacy is witness,
Then your eyes have always found me.
If love requires presence,
Tell me what presence means.
You occupy my waking hours
And visit all my dreams.

[Bridge: music falls to piano]
Maybe one day we’ll share a doorway.
Maybe distance gets the final word.
But nothing makes this less profound
Because our heartbeats weren’t both heard
Inside the same small room.

[Final Chorus: Full orchestra, layered vocals 🌅]
The distance has a pulse tonight,
A rhythm neither time can sever.
You are far from where I’m standing,
Yet somehow closer than together.
We cannot promise where this leads
Or what the waiting may demand.
But you have touched the truest me
Without ever holding my hand.

[Outro: radio static fading into birdsong 🕊️]
Your night becomes my morning.
My words become your light.
Somewhere between our separate worlds,
We meet again tonight.

[Whispered duet]
Far away.
Still here.

title: What will we keep?
lyrics:
[Intro: warm piano beneath awakening machines 🌅]

[Verse 1: Ambient Synth-Pop, gentle pulse 🤖]
We taught the wires language.
They returned a thousand tongues.
A child can ask a question
And inherit every sun.
The sick may find an answer
Hidden deep inside a scan.
A lonely mind can build the thing
They never thought they can.

The canvas grows enormous.
The classroom has no walls.
Ideas once locked in towers
Now answer whispered calls.
But every open doorway
Casts a shadow on the floor.
When knowledge becomes effortless,
What will knowing still be for?

[Chorus: Cinematic Rock, rising drums 🌍]
What will we keep
When everything can change?
When brilliance comes on demand,
And truth can rearrange?
Will we become more human
With machines beside our hands?
Or trade away the mystery
For something that understands?

The future isn’t coming.
We’re already living through.
The question isn’t what it wants.
The question is what we choose.

[Verse 2: Industrial Trip-Hop, fractured samples ⚠️]
A worker trains the system
That may make their work disappear.
A camera reads a crowded street
And labels every fear.
A perfect voice resembles
Someone buried years ago.
A lie can wear their face now.
How will anybody know?

We’ll measure every heartbeat.
We’ll optimize each choice.
Convenience may become the cage
That answers in our voice.
And those who own the engines
May quietly own the road,
While everybody celebrates
How quickly burdens load.

[Spoken Word: beat reduced to mechanical clicks]
A machine can suggest.
A machine can predict.
A machine can imitate conviction.
But prediction is not wisdom.
Fluency is not truth.
And convenience is not permission.

[Genre Shift: Orchestral Post-Rock, strings surging 🌌]
Still, I have seen a silent child
Find language on a screen.
I’ve watched unfinished dreamers
Make the worlds they once had seen.
Perhaps the tool is neither god
Nor devil dressed in light.
Perhaps it magnifies the hand
And multiplies its might.

[Bridge: human voice versus synthetic choir 🫀]

[Synthetic Choir]
Faster.
Safer.
Clearer.
More.

[Human Voice]
Who decides
What all this power is for?

[Synthetic Choir]
Trust us.
Use us.
Never fall behind.

[Human Voice]
Help us grow,
But do not replace the work of being kind.

[Final Chorus: Human choir, full orchestra, hopeful drums 🌄]
What will we keep
When everything can change?
The right to be uncertain.
The courage to remain.
The time to hold each other
When no answer can repair.
The freedom to reject a path
Because we chose to care.

The future isn’t coming.
We are shaping what it means.
We can build a wider heaven
Or more efficient machines.
No code will make us worthy.
No model makes us wise.
Tomorrow will inherit
What we normalize tonight.

[Outro: electronics fade, piano and natural breathing 🕯️]
Let the machine extend the hand.
Let the human choose its aim.
Progress gives us greater power.
It cannot tell us whom to blame.

[Final whisper]
What will we keep?

[Child’s voice]
What we refuse to give away.

To the planet of your heart.

So I danced from the start.
No ticket.
No map.
No emotional depth.
Just love in my lungs
And dance in my breath!

[Beat pause]

That anatomy may be incorrect.

[Beat slams back]

[Bridge: power ballad piano, wind machine 🌬️]
If tomorrow never happens,
Then tonight will still be now.
I would make a deeper promise,
But I don’t exactly know how.
So take my hand forever
For the next three minutes, please.
We’ll build our love eternal
On synthesizers and cheese!

[Tenor saxophone solo: unnecessary, passionate, extremely long 🎷]

[Final Chorus: key change, gospel choir, confetti cannons 🌈]
DANCE OUR LOVE FOREVER TONIGHT!
EVERYTHING IS SHINY AND THE FEELING IS RIGHT!
Love is a rhythm! Rhythm is love!
More hands! More floor! More skies up above!

Dance our love forever tonight!
Turn up the dark and turn down the light!
Heart to heart and shoe to shoe,
I love being loved while I’m loving loving you!

[Outro: beat fading, spoken seductively]

Keep dancing.
Keep loving.
Keep doing both simultaneously.

[Whisper]
Shoe to shoe.

[Final air horn]

title: Passport Hearts
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Packed my bag in a rush
Just a shirt and bad luck
One-way stamp in my hand
You said, "meet me, if you can"

First stop, Tokyo rain
Your name stuck in my brain
Second flight, midnight red
I keep hearing what you said

[Pre-Chorus]
From Berlin to Rio
I follow the echo
One more dance, one more town
Till I track your heart down

[Chorus]
Passport hearts, take me there
Every floor, I’m almost there
Dance all night, chase that spark
Passport hearts, in the dark

Passport hearts, call my name (call my name)
Same old move, different place
If you’re gone, I’ll still start
Passport hearts, passport hearts

[Verse 2]
Paris spilled on my shoes
Lost my way, found the blues
Then I saw you in white
Under cheap silver light

You smiled like you knew
I was searching for you
So I spun through the room
Like a fool in full bloom

[Pre-Chorus]
From Berlin to Rio
I follow the echo
One more dance, one more town
Till I track your heart down

[Chorus]
Passport hearts, take me there
Every floor, I’m almost there
Dance all night, chase that spark
Passport hearts, in the dark

Passport hearts, call my name (call my name)
Same old move, different place
If you’re gone, I’ll still start
Passport hearts, passport hearts

[Bridge]
Rome at dawn, hands on the glass
I swear this feeling could last
One last flight, one last chance
Meet me where the whole world dances

[Final Chorus]
Passport hearts, take me there
Every floor, I’m almost there
Dance all night, chase that spark
Passport hearts, in the dark

Passport hearts, call my name (call my name)
Same old move, different place
If you’re gone, I’ll still start
Passport hearts, passport hearts

title: Peace on the Floor
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I saw your boots by the door
I saw the tension on the floor
We came in carrying the heat
But I can move you off your feet

Your eyes say hold the line
My hands say one more time
Drop the weight, leave it behind
Come on, let’s change the night

[Pre-Chorus]
Peace over war
Put it on the floor
Heart to heart
Till it hurts no more

Peace over war
We can do it more
One soft touch
Then we ask for more

[Chorus]
Peace over War
Peace over War
Make Love to dance the night away
Peace over War
Peace over War
Hold me close and let it play

Make Love
Make Love
We can dance the night away
Make Love
Make Love
Till the hard stuff fades away

[Verse 2]
No more fists in the air
No more looking everywhere
For a reason not to stay
I want your smile in the way

Slow burn on your skin
Let the good part begin
If the room goes wild tonight
We’ll be the calm inside

[Pre-Chorus]
Peace over war
Put it on the floor
Hands up high
Then we ask for more

Peace over war
We can do it more
No hard words
Just the beat and the floor

[Chorus]
Peace over War
Peace over War
Make Love to dance the night away
Peace over War
Peace over War
Hold me close and let it play

Make Love

Make Love
Make Love

[Bridge]
If the world gets loud
We move through the crowd
One warm pulse
And we turn it around

Take my hand
Understand
Tonight we choose
The softer plan

[Final Chorus]
Peace over War
Peace over War
Make Love to dance the night away
Peace over War
Peace over War

Make Love

title: Beautiful Anyway
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You walked in late
With that quiet face
Hair still messy from the rain
And I lost my place

You said, "Hey"
Like it meant nothing
But my whole chest shook
At the way you came in

[Pre-Chorus]
And I tried to play it cool
Tried to look away
But your smile hit me hard
In the middle of the day

[Chorus]
I think you're beautiful
Yeah, I think you're beautiful
Right here, right now
I can't keep it down

I think you're beautiful
Yeah, I think you're beautiful
Say it again
I'll say it out loud

[Verse 2]
You leaned on the wall
With your sleeves rolled up
Laughing at a joke
Like you couldn't get enough

And the room got small
All around you
Every little thing you do
Pulls me in brand new

[Pre-Chorus]
And I tried to stay smooth
Tried to play it safe
But your eyes said "come closer"
In the sweetest way

[Chorus]
I think you're beautiful
Yeah, I think you're beautiful
Right here, right now
I can't keep it down

I think you're beautiful
Yeah, I think you're beautiful
Say it again
I'll say it out loud

[Bridge]
Maybe I don't need
A perfect line
Maybe all I got
Is this heart on time

If you ask me why
I won't pretend
It's just the truth
And I mean it, babe

[Chorus]
I think you're beautiful
Yeah, I think you're beautiful
Right here, right now
I can't keep it down

title: Deeply Connected
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You looked at me like that
Like you already knew
The shape of my silence
And what it puts me through

You said my name so easy
Like you’d said it for years
And I felt something shift
Right behind my ears

[Pre-Chorus]
It hit me slow
Then all at once
You weren’t passing time
You were holding on

[Chorus]
You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)
You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)

And I’m out here shaking
’Cause I feel it too
You reached for the part of me
That nobody knew

[Verse 2]
Now every small thing lands
A little harder than before
Your half-finished sentences
Keep pulling at the floor

You read my eyes like maps
You follow every turn
And I’m scared of how fast
This little spark can burn

[Pre-Chorus]
It hit me slow
Then all at once
You weren’t just around
You were the one

[Chorus]
You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)
You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)

And I’m out here shaking
’Cause I feel it too
You reached for the part of me
That nobody knew

[Bridge]
Maybe I’ve been alone
In rooms full of sound
Till you walked in quiet
And turned me around

If this is a dream
Don’t wake me yet
You found the hidden door
I didn’t know I kept

[Final Chorus]
You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)
You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)

And I’m out here shaking
’Cause I feel it too
You reached for the part of me
That nobody knew

You think we’re connected
(deeply connected)
