title: A Very Polite Apocalypse
lyrics:
[Intro: teacups clinking, cheerful strings, distant thunder ☕]

[Verse 1: Chamber Pop, plucked strings, immaculate vocal 🌤️]
The morning sky was splitting,
But I complimented June.
A meteor crossed breakfast.
I said, “Lovely weather, soon.”
The pavement started trembling.
The ocean climbed the stairs.
I held the door for everyone
And asked about their heirs.

My fury lived downstairs
Inside a boiler painted pink.
I fed it disappointments
I was much too kind to speak.
Each insult raised the pressure.
Every “fine” secured the lid.
Nobody likes an angry man,
So nobody knew what I did.

[Chorus: Upbeat Cabaret Rock, brass bursts 🎭]
It’s a very polite apocalypse!
Please form an orderly line!
The world is ending beautifully,
And honestly, I’m fine!
Don’t trouble yourself with my collapse.
Your comfort is my goal.
I’ll smile while every unsaid word
Detonates inside my soul!

It’s a very polite apocalypse!
No need to make a scene!
I’ve swallowed every fire
To keep the atmosphere serene!
If speaking ruins dinner,
Then I’ll quietly combust.
Please pass the sugar, darling,
While civilization turns to dust!

[Verse 2: Cocktail Jazz, brushed drums, nervous piano 🍸]
The moon fell through the chimney.
I apologized for soot.
A horseman asked for directions.
I admired his tailored suit.
My friends said, “You seem distant.”
I said, “Nothing’s wrong at all,”
While four emotional horsemen
Played croquet inside the hall.

[Genre Shift: Vaudeville Waltz, tempo accelerating 🎪]
Resentment brought the matches.
Avoidance poured the gin.
Obligation locked the windows.
Good Manners tucked us in.
The boiler started whistling
In a pleasantly major key.
I raised my cup and toasted
To how easygoing I could be.

[Breakdown: Frantic Punk, sirens, smashing china ⚡]
I’M FINE!
I’M FINE!
I’M ABSOLUTELY—
[Explosion]

I HATE THIS!
I’M TIRED!
I NEVER ONCE AGREED!
I CALLED MY SILENCE KINDNESS
WHILE IT MUTATED INTO NEED!

[Music stops, debris falling]

[Spoken]
Pardon me.
That was uncharacteristic.

[Bridge: Mournful Piano into Gospel Choir 🌧️]
Anger is not cruelty.
A boundary is not war.
Truth does not become a weapon
Just because it shuts a door.
Peace maintained through self-erasure
Is a brightly painted tomb.
Perhaps one honest thunderclap
Could clear the pressure from the room.

[Final Chorus: Symphonic Rock, choir, triumphant horns 🌅]
It was a very polite apocalypse,
But now I’ll make a scene!
The world survived my honesty.
The air is strangely clean.
I’ll tell you when you hurt me.
I’ll say when I’ve had enough.
I can speak without attacking.
I can disagree with love.

No more polite apocalypse!
No smiling through the flame!
I’ll own the storm inside me
Without drowning you in blame.
Set the table back together.
Leave the cracks where they can show.
If resentment ends the universe,
Then truth may help it grow.

[Outro: birds, teacup placed down, soft piano]

[Guest]
More tea?

[Narrator]
No, thank you.

[Choir, ecstatic whisper]
HE SAID NO!

title: The Auction of my Better Qualities
lyrics:
[Intro: gavel strikes, murmuring aristocrats, harpsichord 🔨]

[Auctioneer]
Welcome, esteemed admirers!
Everything must go!
He’ll become whatever you desire
If your affection bids below!

[Verse 1: Baroque Pop, strings and handclaps 🎩]
First upon the velvet block,
My patience, barely used.
Perfect for a restless heart
That needs to be excused.
Next, my sense of humor,
Guaranteed to hide distress.
Who’ll offer one approving laugh?
Sold to the woman in the dress!

My honesty comes tarnished,
But it polishes up well.
My boundaries are missing.
That should help the item sell.
My sleep arrives in seven lots.
My dignity makes eight.
My future goes to anyone
Who promises they’ll stay.

[Chorus: Explosive Dance-Rock, brass and choir 💰]
Going once! Going twice!
How much love will buy my life?
Take my time! Take my name!
Turn my kindness into fame!
If I keep what makes me whole,
Will anybody raise their hand?
I’m selling all my better parts
To become a better man!

Going once! Going twice!
Every virtue has a price!
I’ll be everything you wanted.
Just applaud when I’m complete.
What good is being true to me
If nobody takes a seat?

[Verse 2: Electro-Swing, walking bass, auction chant 🎺]
A gentleman bought confidence.
A critic purchased pride.
A lonely heart took tenderness
And left the box outside.
Ambition sold for headlines.
Desire sold for touch.
I started feeling weightless.
They said I asked too much.

[Auctioneer, accelerating]
Who wants his evenings?
Who wants his voice?
Who’ll take responsibility
For every private choice?
His anger? Unsold!
His fear? Withdrawn!
His charming little personality?
Already gone!

[Genre Shift: Glam Punk, distorted guitars ⚡]
BID! BID!
MAKE ME WORTH IT!
LOVE’S A MARKET!
I’LL REVERSE IT!
BUY MY SMILE!
LEASE MY SOUL!
EVERY SALE MAKES ME LESS WHOLE!

[Bridge: lonely music box, empty hall 🕯️]
When the chandeliers went dark,
I searched the dusty floor.
A tag remained where I had stood:
“No owner anymore.”
I’d mistaken being wanted
For possessing any worth.
Now strangers owned the evidence
That I had walked the earth.

[Final Chorus: Orchestral Rock, choir, rising key 🌟]
Going once! Going twice!
I withdraw myself tonight!
Keep your coins and expectations.
Keep the person you designed.
I will gather what remains of me,
Though some cannot return.
A self is not a masterpiece
That admiration earns.

Going once! Going twice!
Let the auction meet its end.
I would rather leave unfinished
Than be purchased as a friend.
Close the books and clear the ballroom.
Let the final gavel fall.
I may not be worth everything,
But I’m no longer up for sale.

[Outro: gavel strike, one quiet coin rolling]

[Auctioneer, softly]
No bids accepted.

[Narrator]
Not even love.

title: My Ego Bought a Circus
lyrics:
[Intro: circus organ, crowd roaring, whip crack 🎪]

[Ringmaster]
Ladies and gentlemen!
For one night only!
A man who can turn insecurity
Into thunderous applause!

[Verse 1: Electro-Swing, brass, finger snaps 🎩]
My ego bought a circus
With the money from my doubt.
It hired every version of me
I couldn’t live without.
The Charmer sold affection.
The Genius swallowed flame.
The Martyr broke his spine
So everybody learned my name.

I wore a crimson tailcoat.
I welcomed every guest.
“Observe how much they love me!
Ignore the shaking in my chest!”
The tent was stitched from compliments.
The ropes were promises.
Admission cost devotion
And a standing ovation, please.

[Chorus: Glam Rock, huge guitars, audience chant 👑]
Welcome to the greatest me on Earth!
Watch me manufacture worth!
If you cheer, I’m resurrected.
If you leave, I’m dirt!
I’m the ringmaster, lion,
Tightrope, cannon, clown.
I built myself a kingdom
Where applause can’t let me down!

My ego bought a circus.
My fear performs each night.
Everybody sees the glitter.
Nobody sees the bite.
I bow beneath the spotlight
As the crowd becomes a blur.
Do they love the man beneath it,
Or the spectacle he was?

[Verse 2: Vaudeville Cabaret, crooked piano 🤡]
The Acrobat named Confidence
Could balance any lie.
The Fortune Teller promised
I was born to touch the sky.
A lovely volunteer
Placed her trusting heart inside.
I made it disappear,
Then blamed the trick when she cried.

[Genre Shift: Dark Funk, snarling bass, whispered crowd 🪞]
More praise beneath the big top.
More eyes upon the throne.
The louder that they loved me,
The less I felt alone.
But silence stalked the aisles
Like a patient undertaker.
Every cheer became an echo.
Every triumph needed greater.

[Breakdown: Explosive Punk, collapsing tent ⚡]
DANCE, CLOWN!
SMILE, KING!
MAKE THEM FEEL
LIKE EVERYTHING!
TAKE THEIR HOPE!
RETURN CONFETTI!
CALL IT LOVE
WHEN YOU’RE NOT READY!

[Bridge: music box, childlike vocal 🌙]
When I was small, I learned
That being dazzling kept them near.
So I fed the little circus
Every loneliness and fear.
Now the child sells the tickets.
The monster runs the show.
And the man beneath the makeup
Doesn’t know where else to go.

[Final Chorus: Gospel-Rock, choir, blazing horns 🔥]
Welcome to the final night on Earth!
No more manufacturing worth!
Let the lion lose his costume.
Let the clown admit the hurt.
I’m the ringmaster and captive,
The applause and empty sound.
Perhaps I’m still somebody
When the tent comes crashing down.

My ego bought a circus.
I signed away the grounds.
But tonight I’ll meet the silence
Without summoning the crowds.
No cannon. No illusion.
No rehearsed humility.
If one person stays beyond the show,
They’ll finally stay for me.

[Outro: empty tent, folding chairs, soft piano 🎟️]

[Ringmaster, quietly]
Ladies and gentlemen,
The performance is over.

[Child’s voice]
Can we still go home?

[Final chord]

title: The Ministry of Yes
lyrics:
[Intro: typewriters, harpsichord, officious brass 📜]

[Announcer]
Welcome to the Ministry of Yes,
Where every wish is granted
And every clerk is stressed!

[Verse 1: Baroque Pop, pizzicato strings, playful vocal 🎩]
At nine, a friend requested
I repair his broken pride.
At ten, a stranger needed
Someone constantly beside.
At noon, I signed a document
To never disappoint.
By two, I’d promised seven hearts
I’d never leave the joint.

My desk became a mountain.
My smile became a stamp.
I approved each application
Like a cheerful little scamp.
“No problem” was my motto.
“Of course” became my crest.
Every citizen adored me
At the Ministry of Yes!

[Chorus: Dance-Rock, stomps, brass explosions 🎺]
Yes to your crisis!
Yes to your plan!
Yes, I’ll be your savior,
Your lover, clown, and handyman!
I’m terribly important!
I’m universally blessed!
Please ignore the smoke alarms
At the Ministry of Yes!

If I say no, will you still love me?
If I say yes, will I survive?
I keep everybody’s hopes alive
To prove that I’m alive!
So file another heartache.
I’ll address it like the rest.
There are no closing hours
At the Ministry of Yes!

[Verse 2: Ska Cabaret, bouncing horns, rapid delivery 🕺]
The Minister of Boundaries
Was promptly shown the door.
The Secretary of Sleep
Collapsed unconscious on the floor.
The Treasurer announced
That all emotional funds were spent.
I promoted my exhaustion
To a noble sacrament.

[Genre Shift: Circus Waltz, warped calliope 🎪]
A woman brought forever
In a folder tied with lace.
I signed without reviewing
And assigned her half my space.
A man requested worship.
I approved it with a grin.
The queue stretched to the coastline.
I kept inviting people in!

[Breakdown: Frantic Punk, shredded paperwork ⚡]
STAMP IT!
SIGN IT!
NEVER READ IT!
FILL THE NEED
BEFORE THEY NEED IT!
GIVE YOUR TIME!
SURRENDER REST!
EVERYBODY LOVES THE BEST!

[Sudden silence]

[Small voice]
Do you?

[Bridge: Lonely Piano into Gospel Choir 🌧️]
If kindness is compulsory,
Is kindness what remains?
If every gift buys gratitude,
Is love another chain?
But questions need approval,
And my form was incomplete.
So I buried it beneath
All those demands I rushed to meet.

[Final Chorus: Massive Baroque Rock, choir, key change 🌟]
Yes to your wedding!
Yes to your war!
Yes, I’ll hold the ceiling
Though I can’t stand anymore!
I’m needed! I’m beloved!
I’m magnificently stressed!
Raise the golden banner
Of the Ministry of Yes!

If I say no, will you still love me?
The answer waits outside.
I reach to turn the OPEN sign,
Then leave it lit with pride.
Come tomorrow morning,
Bring your worst and wear your best.
I’ll be waiting at the counter
Of the Ministry of—

[Power failure, typewriter bell]

[Whispered]
Yes?

title: The Trial of a Thousand Faces
lyrics:
[Intro: courtroom murmurs, gavel strike, pipe organ ⚖️]

[The Judge]
The court will hear the case
Of Everybody versus You.
Bring forward every face he wore.
Let each one tell the truth.

[Verse 1: Gothic Rock, low choir, marching toms 🎭]
First came the perfect gentleman,
Polite and freshly pressed.
He always knew what others needed,
Never what he wanted best.
Then entered the comedian,
Still laughing through the strain.
He turned each wound into a joke
So no one saw the pain.

The hero wore a crimson cape,
Prepared to rescue all.
The scholar carried answers
So he’d never look too small.
A lover dressed in borrowed dreams
Swore every match was fate.
A thousand versions filled the room.
The real one arrived late.

[Chorus: Arena Rock, narrator surrounded by voices 🌪️]
Which face is mine
When every mask can speak?
Am I endlessly adaptable
Or terrified and weak?
I became what every room required,
Then vanished when it cleared.
If everybody loved my faces,
Was it me they ever cheered?

[Witness I: THE HERO]
[Genre Shift: Triumphant Glam Funk, brass and swagger 🦸]
I saved them when they stumbled!
I carried every load!

[Witness II: THE MARTYR]
[Music darkens, distorted bass 🩸]
Then made them feel indebted
For each mile of their road.

[Witness III: THE JESTER]
[Genre Shift: Manic Punk Cabaret, frantic piano 🃏]
I kept the whole room laughing!
Never let the silence start!

[Witness IV: THE CHILD]
[Music stops, fragile whisper]
Because silence lets them notice
There is terror in my heart.

[Chorus: Post-Hardcore, screamed backing vocals ⚡]
Which face is mine?
WHO GETS TO CHOOSE?
If I tear away the costumes,
Is there anything to lose?
One begs, “Admire me!”
One cries, “Don’t leave!”
One says, “Become whatever
They are willing to believe!”

I’ve worn a thousand faces.
Each protected something small.
But armor worn forever
Is another prison wall.

[Bridge: Dark Synth-Pop, heartbeat bass, mirror cracks 🪞]

[The Prosecutor]
You manipulated kindness.

[The Defense]
He only wished to cope.

[The Prosecutor]
He sold them tailored versions.

[The Defense]
He gave them needed hope.

[Judge]
Both arguments are honest.
Both arguments evade.
He harmed and helped through every mask.
Now bring the one beneath the masquerade.

[Final Movement: Gospel Rock, organ, massive choir 🔥]

[Narrator]
I am jealous! I am generous!
I am frightened! I am vain!
I have danced for your approval!
I have hidden from your pain!
Every face contained a fragment.
Every mask was partly true.
But I’ll no longer call it loving
To become a lie for you!

[Final Chorus: Orchestral crescendo, choir, key change 🌅]
This face is mine,
Though unfinished and unclear.
It may disappoint the courtroom.
It may cost the crowd its cheer.
I can enter without rescuing.
I can speak without a role.
I can let somebody dislike me
Without bargaining my soul.

[Outro: gavel raised, music falls silent]

[Judge]
How does the defendant plead?

[Narrator]
Human.

[Gavel strike, choir whispers]
Accepted.

title: Blueprints for a Burning House
lyrics:
[Intro: pencil scratching, ticking clock, solitary piano 🏚️]

[The Architect]
I drew a home with open windows,
A table set for two.
Every line became a promise
I was terrified to do.

[Verse 1: Cinematic Art Rock, strings slowly rising 📐]
I measured every doorway.
I chose where light would fall.
I built a life of careful plans,
Then hung our names upon the wall.
You carried in your memories.
I promised they were safe.
But permanence began to feel
Like concrete setting at my waist.

[The Runaway, whispered]
What if every home becomes a cage?

[Genre Shift: Villainous Cabaret, crooked piano 🎩]

[The Runaway]
Leave before they know you.
Run before you’re known.
Freedom tastes much sweeter
When nobody calls you home.
There’s always one more highway,
One more unexplored desire.
Why wait until they lock the door?
Just introduce the fire.

[Chorus: Explosive Emo Rock, dual vocals 🔥]
I build! I burn!
I promise! I return!
I plant a garden with both hands,
Then fear the roots beneath.
I beg somebody, “Stay with me,”
Then panic when they breathe.
How many homes must turn to smoke
Before I understand?
The match inside the Runaway
Belongs to the Architect’s hand.

[Verse 2: Folk Rock, acoustic guitar, mournful cello 🌧️]
You found me in the wreckage,
Holding blueprints to my chest.
I said, “The timing failed us.”
You said, “You never did your best.”
I blamed the walls for closing in,
The weather and the years.
But every exit bore my name.
Each room was soaked in fears.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore, crushing guitars ⚡]

[Architect]
I WANTED SOMETHING LASTING!

[Runaway]
YOU WANTED AN ESCAPE!

[Architect]
I BUILT US SOMETHING BEAUTIFUL!

[Runaway]
THEN FOUND ANOTHER SHAPE!

[Both]
ONE HAND LAYS THE FOUNDATION!
ONE HAND POURS THE FUEL!
I CALL MYSELF A PRISONER
OF EVERY BROKEN RULE!

[Breakdown: hammer strikes become war drums]
BUILD IT!
BURN IT!
MOURN IT!
LEARN IT!
DRAW ANOTHER PERFECT PLAN!
BECOME ANOTHER VANISHING MAN!

[Bridge: Symphonic Waltz, choir entering 🕯️]
Perhaps commitment is not prison.
Perhaps freedom is not flight.
Perhaps staying through discomfort
Does not mean surrendering life.
A home is not a finished thing.
Its walls will bend and scar.
Love is choosing renovation
When escape appears less hard.

[Final Chorus: Full Orchestra, soaring guitar, choir 🌅]
I built. I burned.
But something has been learned.
I cannot promise permanence
Or swear I’ll never fear.
I can set aside the matches
When the walls begin to near.
The Runaway may warn me,
But he will not command.
I’ll build with doors left open,
And remain because I can.

[Outro: piano motif, sound of pencil returning ✏️]
No perfect house.
No flawless plan.
Just one unfinished room
And two uncertain hands.

[The Runaway]
There’s still a road.

[The Architect]
There’s also somewhere worth returning.

title: Four Hands on the Compass
lyrics:
[Intro: ticking clock, four footsteps approaching from different directions 🧭]

[Narrator, whispered]
Four hands upon the compass.
Four voices know my name.
Each one promises salvation.
Each one pulls a different way.

[Figure I: DESIRE]
[Genre Shift: Seductive Disco, pulsing bass, breathy vocal 🔥]
Come where the lights are liquid.
Come taste what you have missed.
Tomorrow is a rumor.
Tonight is on your lips.
You’ve spent your life behaving,
Watching pleasure pass you by.
Take everything that wants you.
Let restraint and reason die.

[Figure II: NARCISSISM]
[Genre Shift: Theatrical Glam Rock, swaggering guitar 👑]
Look at what you’ve built here.
Look how they chant your name.
You weren’t born for shadows.
You were engineered for fame.
Every room deserves you.
Every eye should turn and see.
Why waste your gifts on equals
When the world needs your supremacy?

[Chorus: Explosive Emo Rock, narrator against overlapping voices ⚡]
Which voice is mine?
Which road is true?
Am I what I promise
Or merely what I do?
One says, “Take.”
One says, “Rise.”
One holds my heart.
One guards my life.
Four hands upon the compass,
And they’re tearing it apart.
How do I choose a direction
When each direction owns my heart?

[Figure III: LOVE]
[Genre Shift: Warm Gospel Soul, organ, tender choir 💗]
Stay beside the wounded.
Make a shelter of your chest.
Love is not a trophy.
It is how the lost find rest.
Let another person’s heartbeat
Matter equally to yours.
Hold them without owning them.
Keep open all your doors.

[Figure IV: DUTY]
[Genre Shift: Military Orchestral Rock, snare drums, stern low vocal 🛡️]
Close the doors. Stand steady.
There are promises to keep.
People built their lives around you.
You don’t get to disappear.
Desire is a wildfire.
Praise is smoke above the flame.
Do the work that must be finished.
Honor every given name.

[Chorus: Arena Rock, faster tempo, competing chants 🌪️]
Which voice is mine?
Which one must lose?
Does freedom mean surrender
To whatever I may choose?
Desire says, “Live!”
Pride says, “Be seen!”
Love says, “Give!”
Duty says, “Keep clean!”
Four hands upon the compass,
Four kingdoms want my soul.
If I silence any one of them,
Will I ever become whole?

[Break: four genres collide, chaotic counterpoint]

[Desire, whispered]
You only live once.

[Narcissism, shouted]
Make sure they remember!

[Love, sung]
Do not break them.

[Duty, commanded]
Hold the line!

[Narrator]
STOP!

[Sudden silence, single piano note]

[Bridge: Dark Cabaret Waltz, narrator alone 🎭]
If I follow only Desire,
I leave ashes in my wake.
If I kneel before Narcissus,
Every kindness becomes fake.
If I drown myself in Loving,
I may vanish in the flood.
If I worship only Duty,
I turn breathing into blood.

Perhaps none deserve the kingdom.
Perhaps none should wear the crown.
Perhaps wisdom is the table
Where I make them all sit down.

[Final Movement: Symphonic Post-Hardcore, four voices trading lines 🌌]

[Desire]
Give me a night!

[Narcissism]
Give me the stage!

[Love]
Give them your kindness!

[Duty]
Give structure your days!

[Narrator]
I hear every promise!
I recognize each lie!
You are pieces of my living,
But no single piece is I!

[Final Chorus: Massive choir, half-time drums, rising key 🔥]
These voices are mine,
But they are not my command.
I can feel every hunger
Without feeding every hand.
I can shine without worship.
I can love without chains.
I can honor my promises
Without murdering change.

Four hands upon the compass,
But the compass belongs to me.
I may tremble choosing northward,
But at least I’ll choose it freely.
No voice gets forever.
No figure stands above.
I am Desire.
I am Duty.
I am vanity and love.

[Outro: compass ticking, unresolved piano chord 🌒]

[Four voices, surrounding]
Choose.

[Narrator, quietly]
I am choosing.

[Final heartbeat]

title: The Saint and the Starving Man
lyrics:
[Intro: funeral-march snare, distant piano, children’s choir 🥁]

[The Saint, softly]
Come, all you wounded.
I have room for everyone.
Bring every broken piece.
We’ll build another sun.

[Verse 1: Theatrical Emo Rock, clean guitar building 🕊️]
I learned to wear compassion
Like a uniform of white.
I carried every stranger
Through their longest, darkest night.
I promised love was endless.
I declared my heart was free.
Every hopeful face reflected
Who I desperately wanted to be.

[Pre-Chorus: marching band swells, distorted whispers]
But something underneath me
Counted every grateful stare.
Something starving in the cellar
Smiled whenever love was there.

[Chorus: Explosive Arena Punk, stacked vocals 🔥]
There’s a saint inside my mirror,
There’s a hunger underneath.
One offers you salvation.
One is sharpening its teeth.
I swear I want to heal you.
I swear my love is true.
But every time you need me,
I need something back from you.

I’ll be your light!
[Dark voice: Make them adore you!]
I’ll guard your heart!
[Dark voice: Until they bore you!]
Two hands upon the same embrace,
One gives while one devours.
I bring the world a garden,
Then demand they praise the flowers.

[Verse 2: Villainous Cabaret, crooked piano, pizzicato strings 🎭]

[The Hunger]
I prey upon the hopeful,
Those who ache to be complete.
I learn their secret language,
Then place heaven at their feet.
I whisper, “You are different.”
I make destiny appear.
Then drink their admiration
Until intimacy turns fear.

Their love becomes my medicine.
Their trust becomes my stage.
I call my appetite compassion.
I call my panic rage.
When one heart sees behind me,
I find another pair of eyes.
Nothing feeds insecurity
Like being someone’s paradise.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore, screamed dual vocals ⚡]

[The Saint]
GET OUT OF ME!

[The Hunger]
I BUILT YOUR THRONE!

[The Saint]
I GAVE THEM LOVE!

[The Hunger]
TO NOT FEEL ALONE!

[Both]
WE SHARE THE HAND!
WE SHARE THE SKIN!
YOU CALL IT GRACE!
I LET THEM IN!

[Breakdown: crushing guitars, marching snare]
LOVE THEM!
USE THEM!
SAVE THEM!
LOSE THEM!
MAKE THEM HOPE!
THEN MAKE THEM PROVE
THEY’LL BLEED TO KEEP
THE LOVE YOU MOVE!

[Silence, one heartbeat]

[The Saint, trembling]
Was any kindness honest
If I needed their applause?

[The Hunger, whispering]
Does poison become harmless
When it dreams of being gauze?

[Bridge: Gothic Waltz into Symphonic Rock 🕯️]
I am neither perfect angel
Nor the devil I condemn.
I am every selfish motive
Hidden in a noble hymn.
The monster is not foreign.
He did not steal my name.
I fed him every lonely night,
Then dressed him up as shame.

[Choir rises]
Look at what you wanted!
Look at what it cost!
Every heart that found your heaven,
Every heart your heaven lost!

[Final Chorus: Full Rock Opera, orchestra, massive choir 🌑]
There’s a saint inside my mirror,
There’s a hunger I must name.
Both are mine to carry.
Neither gets to rule the same.
I cannot call it loving
If their hope becomes my food.
I cannot claim salvation
While I leave their faith consumed.

I’ll still bring light!
[Choir: Without demanding worship!]
I’ll still give love!
[Choir: Without claiming ownership!]
The starving voice may follow,
But it will not choose my part.
I’ll stop feeding my reflection
With the breaking of a heart.

[Outro: lone marching drum fading into piano 🥀]
Come, all you wounded.
I cannot be your sun.
But I can walk beside you
Without needing to become one.

[Final dual whisper]
[The Saint] I want to love them.
[The Hunger] I want them to love me.
[Both] Now I know the difference.

[Final Chorus]
Two glass wolves

One says beg for grace

title: Love without a Lock
lyrics:
[Intro: sunrise synths, marching drums, distant choir 🌅]
Open every window!
Throw away the keys!
There is more than enough of me
For everyone I meet!

[Verse 1: Upbeat Stadium Pop, handclaps, bright guitars ☀️]
If you arrive with rainclouds,
I’ll paint your weather blue.
If everybody leaves you,
I’ll be everybody too.
I’ll answer every midnight call
And promise I won’t tire.
I’ll keep a thousand freezing hearts
Beside my single fire.

No need to earn affection.
No limit, lock, or gate.
I’ll greet the world with open arms,
No matter how it takes.
My calendar is crowded,
But I’ll find another day.
My cup is nearly empty,
So there’s less to give away!

Bring me every burden!
Bring me every scar!
I don’t need to know you
To adore you as you are!

[Chorus: Explosive Arena Rock, huge harmonies 🌍]
I’ve got love for everybody!
Every stranger, every friend!
I’ll begin a hundred promises
And swear they’ll never end!
No boundaries, no caution,
No heart left in the dark!
I’ll give away the whole of me
And never miss a part!

I’ve got love for everybody!
Let it flood across the land!
There is no such thing as “too much”
When a heart is in your hands!
Come closer, all you lonely souls.
There’s room inside my chest!
I’ll give each one forever
And give tomorrow all the rest!

[Genre Shift: Disco House, four-on-the-floor, glittering strings 🪩]
Love to the left!
Love to the right!
Love to the beautiful stranger tonight!
Doors are unlocked!
Curtains are gone!
I’ll make you feel eternal,
Then keep dancing toward the dawn!

[Verse 2: Ska-Pop, bouncing brass, playful vocal 🎺]
I’ll learn your favorite stories.
I’ll memorize your dreams.
I’ll tell you we were destined
Before knowing what that means.
I’ll make you feel selected
From the billions passing through,
Because everyone is special,
And especially, so are you!

[Horn break: joyful trumpet solo]

My hands are overflowing,
But I’ll never let one drop.
My heart has no capacity.
My giving has no stop.
Exhaustion is just evidence
That love is being done!
And if I burn completely,
I’ll be brighter than the sun!

[Genre Shift: Symphonic Power Rock, galloping drums, soaring guitar ⚔️]
Raise every wounded spirit!
Sound every golden bell!
If I can make you love me,
Then surely you are well!
I’ll cross each fragile border.
I’ll charge through every wall.
What could ever go wrong
When I am loving one and all?

[Bridge: half-time Gospel, organ, ecstatic choir 🙌]
More love!
[Choir: More love!]
More hands!
[Choir: More hands!]
More hearts depending on my plans!

No silence!
[Choir: No silence!]
No rest!
[Choir: No rest!]
An open heart is always best!

[Final Chorus: full orchestra, choir, double key change 🌈]
I’ve got love for everybody!
Every stranger gets a key!
Every heart may build a home
Inside the deepest part of me!
I’ll never disappoint you.
I’ll never need escape.
Love given without measure
Cannot possibly be waste!

I’ve got love for everybody!
Watch me scatter it like light!
I will keep the whole world warm
Through every endless night!
Come one, come all, come endlessly.
I’m everything you need!
The garden keeps on growing,
So I’ll give away the seed!

[Outro: triumphant choir, confetti cannons 🎉]
Open every window!
Throw away the keys!
There is more than enough of me!
More than enough of me!
More than enough—

[Music cuts abruptly]

[One quiet heartbeat]

title: A Halo Made of Teeth
lyrics:
[Intro: cracked music box, distant applause, whispered vocal 🕯️]
They call me an angel.
They never met me in love.

[Verse 1: Noir Jazz, upright bass, smoky piano 🥀]
I remember every birthday.
I ask how your mother’s been.
I carry strangers through the storm
And wear the kindest grin.
I make the lonely feel important.
I make the frightened feel believed.
I have mastered being heaven
For everyone I’ll never need.

They praise my patient nature.
They say my heart is gold.
But angels look convincing
When the lighting is controlled.
Nobody sees the feathers
Scattered underneath my bed,
Or hears the names of those who loved me
Still revolving in my head.

[Pre-Chorus: Dark Art Pop, pulse accelerating 🫀]
I never wanted bodies.
I wanted to be chosen.
Another heart said, “You are everything,”
Another door swung open.

[Chorus: Seductive Disco, glittering synths, sinister bass 🪩]
Look at my halo,
Polished and bright.
I’m everyone’s angel
Until they love me at night.
I give them forever
To feel it begin,
Then hunger for somebody
Who hasn’t loved me yet to let me in.

Look at my halo.
Look underneath.
Every golden circle
Is a halo made of teeth.
I never mean to ruin them.
I only need the proof.
Then I feast upon devotion
And go searching for the truth.

[Verse 2: Minimal Trip-Hop, fractured vocal echoes 🌒]
I know exactly what to say
When someone starts to fall.
I build a private universe
And make them feel like all
The roads that broke behind us
Were designed to make us meet.
Then intimacy ripens,
And I panic at the sweetness.

I call my distance freedom.
I call my damage fate.
I leave before their questions
Turn the mirror toward my face.
Yet every heart remembers
What my appetite forgets.
I survive on fresh beginnings.
They inherit all the debts.

[Genre Shift: Industrial Post-Hardcore, alarms, crushing guitars ⚠️]
I AM THE MONSTER
I KEPT EXPLAINING AWAY!
NOT BORN IN A FIRE,
BUT BUILT DAY AFTER DAY!
One broken promise,
One beautiful lie,
One “I need space”
While another waits nearby!

[Breakdown: mechanical heartbeat, screamed backing vocals]
LOVE ME!
DON’T KNOW ME!
NEED ME!
DON’T HOLD ME!
CROWN ME!
CONSOLE ME!
LEAVE BEFORE YOU OWN ME!

[Music collapses into silence]

[Spoken, trembling]
I was not confused every time.
Sometimes I knew.
Sometimes I chose myself
And called the wreckage truth.

[Bridge: Gothic Gospel, organ and dissonant choir ⛪]
Acceptance is not innocence.
A name does not absolve.
Calling myself a monster
Doesn’t mean I cannot evolve.
I cannot heal their wounds
By performing my regret.
But I can stop creating
New ghosts I won’t forget.

[Choir, slowly harmonizing]
Take off the halo.
Put down the disguise.
Mercy without honesty
Is cruelty dressed in white.

[Final Chorus: Cinematic Art Rock, massive drums, choir 🔥]
Here is my halo.
Here are the teeth.
Here are all the tender hearts
That fell beneath.
I was everyone’s angel,
But their beautiful disease.
They loved me without limits.
I loved being what they needed me to be.

I accept the monster,
But I will not build its throne.
I’ll learn to bear the silence
When I’m unwanted and alone.
If love arrives tomorrow,
I won’t consume it to feel whole.
I’ll offer it a human,
Not an angel with a hole.

[Outro: bare piano, music box slowing 🕊️]
No horns.
No wings.
No audience to deceive.
Just the monster and the mirror,
And the choice of what I feed.

[Final whisper]
They called me an angel.
Now I will try to become a person.

title: A Terrible God
lyrics:
[Intro: detuned piano, ticking clock, intimate vocal 🎭]
I tried to be a mirror
For every passing face,
Shifting into shapes
That might deserve a little grace.

[Verse 1: Dark Cabaret, upright bass, brushed drums 🕯️]
I became the clever one whenever laughter called,
The strong one at the funeral who never cracked at all.
The saint for those who needed faith,
The sinner for the crowd,
Always tailoring my heartbeat
To what company allowed.

I promised more than I could give,
Then hated being bound.
I begged them all to need me,
Then resented staying around.
Every person held a portrait
Of the person I should be,
Until a thousand perfect strangers
Made a stranger out of me.

[Pre-Chorus: strings tightening, heartbeat kick 💓]
If I become what everyone wants,
What happens when they leave?
Who am I without an audience
Deciding what to believe?

[Chorus: Alternative Rock, wide guitars, raw vocal 🌧️]
I can’t be everything to everyone.
I can’t be shelter, storm, and sun.
Some will call me selfish.
Some will say I’ve lost my way.
I’ll disappoint the people
Who expected me to stay.

I can’t be everything to everyone.
There is no perfect version left to become.
I’m difficult and damaged.
I’m impatient, proud, and scared.
But flawed does not mean empty,
And imperfect does not mean I never cared.

[Verse 2: Minimal Trip-Hop, distorted whispers 🌒]
I interrupt. I disappear.
I make the room about my fear.
I hold a grudge, avoid the truth,
Then dress regret in clever suits.
I crave attention, guard my time,
Confuse ambition with a climb
Above the ones I claim to love,
Then wonder why they’ve had enough.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore, crashing drums, screamed doubles ⚡]
I AM NOT THE HERO
IN EVERY STORY TOLD!
SOMETIMES I AM THE WOUND,
SOMETIMES I AM THE COLD!
I cannot rewrite memory
By naming what I meant.
Good intentions never refund
What somebody else has spent!

[Break: amp feedback, ragged breathing]

[Spoken softly]
I did some harm.
I missed the signs.
I was not always kind.

[Bridge: Gospel Soul, organ rising, imperfect choir 🔥]
But shame is not repentance.
And guilt repairs no doors.
I can face the mess I’ve made
Without collapsing on the floor.
I can offer an apology
That asks for no applause.
I can change my next decision
Without hiding from the cause.

[Choir]
Not flawless, still worthy.
Not blameless, still growing.
Not everything.
Still something.
Still here.

[Final Chorus: Soul-Rock crescendo, brass and choir 🌅]
I won’t be everything to everyone.
I’ll be one unfinished person when the day is done.
Some will never understand me.
Some are right to walk away.
Love does not require them
To forgive me or to stay.

I won’t be everything to everyone.
That impossible performance is finally done.
I’m jealous, vain, defensive.
I’m compassionate and true.
I am terribly imperfect,
And I’m trying to do better than I used to do.

[Outro: acoustic guitar, room noise, unpolished vocal 🪞]
No halo.
No disguise.
No grand redemption scene.
Just a flawed and breathing person
Learning what acceptance means.

[Final whispered line]
I am not everyone’s answer.
I am finally my own question.

title: My Nerdy Little Museum
lyrics:
[Intro: 8-bit startup melody, coin sound, pixelated voice 👾]
Player one ready?
Inventory full.
Fashion questionable.
Confidence legendary.

[Verse 1: Chiptune Pop, bouncing bass 🎮]
Paintings on the wall of heroes made of light,
Plumbers fighting turtles, knights who own the night.
Princesses and pilots, monsters drawn with care,
Every frame declares that ordinary lives are square.

Shelves of tiny figures standing row by row,
Artifacts from places only nerdy people know.
Cartridges and comics, maps of distant lands,
Little plastic destinies held safely in my hands.

[Pre-Chorus: synthesizer climbing through octaves ✨]
Some people buy antiques,
Some people purchase gold.
I collect the stories
That prevented growing old.

[Chorus: Electro-Swing, brass blasts, finger snaps 🎩]
Welcome to my nerdy little museum!
Every strange obsession gets a pedestal to stand.
Bow ties, bright suspenders,
Pixel heroes on my sweaters,
All the evidence of wonder you can hold inside your hands.

Welcome to my nerdy little museum!
No admission, but enthusiasm’s required.
I don’t hide what brings me joy.
I display every toy.
Being boring is expensive.
Being nerdy keeps me wired!

[Genre Shift: Ska-Punk, rapid guitar upstrokes, wild horns 🕹️]
I’ve got shirts with fighting robots,
Socks with dragons breathing flames,
Belts with tiny spaceships
From legally distinct arcade games!
Suspenders made for Tuesdays,
A bow tie for each quest,
When the invitation says “formal,”
I arrive as final boss best-dressed!

[Breakdown: tabletop percussion, dice rolling 🎲]
D-twenty for decisions.
D-twelve for heavy blows.
D-eight for sudden danger.
D-four attacks your toes.

[Music stops]

But behold my rarest treasure,
The die with only sides of two.
It’s basically a coin,
But twice as nerdy when you roll it like you do!

[Crowd chant]
ONE! TWO!
ONE! TWO!
CRITICAL MEDIOCRITY!

[Genre Shift: Power Metal, galloping drums, operatic choir ⚔️]
Raise the banners! Guard the shelves!
We found our tribe by being ourselves!
No shame survives this battle cry:
LET YOUR GEEK FLAG FLY!

My fandom is my armor!
My joy becomes my blade!
No sneering little comment
Makes the magic start to fade.
I conquered social judgment.
I leveled past disguise.
There’s freedom in announcing
What makes fire fill your eyes!

[Bridge: Dreamy Synthwave, nostalgic arcade ambience 🌌]
These things are more than objects.
They mark where I have been.
A game that made me hopeful,
A world that let me in.
Each hero on a canvas,
Each faded graphic tee,
Is proof imagination
Helped me learn to become me.

[Final Chorus: Theatrical Glam Rock, huge choir, key change 🚀]
Welcome to my nerdy little museum!
Every odd collection gets a spotlight and a song.
Paint your walls with legends.
Wear your favorite fiction.
Life is far too brief to fear where all your joys belong.

Welcome to my nerdy little museum!
Let the dice and dragons glitter in the light.
With my bow tie straight,
I accept my fate:
I’m spectacularly nerdy,
And I’m rolling with delight!

[Outro: victorious 8-bit fanfare, treasure chest opens 🏆]
Inventory full.
Heart even fuller.
Achievement unlocked:
UNAPOLOGETICALLY NERDY.

[Arcade voice]
Continue?

[Whispered]
Always.

title: Crowded Room, Empty Chair
lyrics:
[Intro: lonely piano, room tone, distant laughter 🌒]
I learned to read a room before I learned myself,
Changing every color like a book upon a shelf.
One smile from a stranger is a match against the cold,
But the flame dies quickly when there’s no one left to hold.

[Verse 1: Art Pop, restrained drums, warm baritone 🎭]
I want the waiter to remember my name,
The critic to adore me, the enemy ashamed.
I want every passing face to turn and testify,
That I was worth the moment that I occupied.

I collect approval like receipts inside a drawer,
Proof that I was wanted, then I go and ask for more.
Every little compliment evaporates by dawn,
So I chase another voice before the first is gone.

[Pre-Chorus: rising strings, heartbeat percussion 💓]
Love me in the daylight,
Love me when I leave.
Tell me I’m important
So I know what to believe.

[Genre Shift: explosive Disco-Funk, bright horns, stacked vocals 🪩]
Everybody love me!
Come and fill the floor!
Every pair of open arms
Just makes me need one more.
Everybody see me!
Keep me shining bright!
I’m the center of the party,
Still disappearing every night.

[Break: music abruptly stops, one breath]

[Verse 2: Ambient piano, close whispered vocal 🌧️]
But alone, the walls don’t ask me to perform.
Silence lays beside me, strangely quiet, strangely warm.
No applause to measure, no affection left to win,
Only all the rooms I never dared to enter in.

I can hear my own thoughts walking barefoot through the dark.
Some are cruel and hungry. Some still carry little sparks.
Here, I’m not impressive. Here, I’m not ignored.
I am simply breathing, and it doesn’t feel like war.

[Chorus: Dream Pop, weightless synths, soft choir 🌌]
Leave me alone,
But promise you’ll return.
I need the quiet,
I need the crowd to yearn.
I lock the door,
Then listen for the sound
Of someone coming closer
To the peace I finally found.

[Genre Shift: Post-Hardcore, distorted guitars, screamed backing vocals ⚡]
WHY CAN’T ONE HEART BE ENOUGH?
WHY DOES LOVE KEEP LEAKING OUT?
I DRINK THE OCEAN DRY,
THEN CURSE THE ENDLESS DROUGHT!

[Lead vocal: cracked, melodic]
If everyone embraced me,
Would I finally feel whole?
Or would a million hands still fail
To touch the hidden hole?

[Bridge: Gospel-Soul, organ and handclaps building 🔥]
Maybe love is not a vote.
Maybe worth is not a score.
Maybe I can bless the guests
Without becoming their encore.
Maybe solitude’s a mirror,
Not a sentence or defeat.
Maybe I can sit beside myself
And not surrender my seat.

[Final Chorus: Art Rock crescendo, choir meets distorted guitars 🌠]
I don’t need everybody,
Though I’ll ache as if I do.
I can treasure being noticed
Without begging it from you.
I’ll join the crowded evening,
Then come home and dim the light.
Learning I can love the silence
Without vanishing from sight.

[Outro: instruments fall away one by one, solitary piano 🕯️]
Leave me alone,
But don’t forget my name.
I’m learning love is shelter,
Not an audience or fame.
And if nobody is watching,
I am here.
I am here.
I am here.

[Final sound: piano key, long room reverb, quiet exhale]

title: How Much I Love
lyrics:
[marching drums + piano]
[Verse 1]
I walk out, hear the roar
Feel it hit my chest
Rows of faces, open hands
Pull me into yes
Your voices fill the room

I was made for this bright feeling

Sneakers on the black floor

Turn the world to grace

title: Packed Calendar
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I feel better when I'm booked
When the calendar is bruised
When my hands stay in motion
I don't let the hours choose

A quiet room gets heavy

So I fill up every corner

Keep me moving
Keep me moving

Keep me moving

Keep me moving

Keep me moving

Keep me moving

lyrics:

title: Second Stair Creak
lyrics:
[Verse 1]

[Pre-Chorus]

Then I don’t

[Chorus]
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?

Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?

[Verse 2]
My back wakes up sore
