Let it rest
Just a minute or two

Because patience
Is technically
An ingredient too

[Final Chorus: bigger]

DON’T PRESS THE BURGER!
LET THE JUICES STAY

HARD SEAR FIRST
THEN FLIP AWAY

Toast the bun
Melt the cheese
Pickles
Onions
Sauce with ease

Keep it simple
Keep it bold

Juicy center
Crust like gold

[Gang Vocals]
BEEF!
SALT!
HEAT!
REST!

[Lead]
That’s the burger
That’s the test

[Outro: grill sizzle fading]

[Spoken]
Eighty-twenty.

Hot pan.

One flip.

Don’t press it.

[Pause]

Unless you’re making smash burgers.

[Backing Vocals]
Different song!

[Final guitar hit]

title: SALMON AT SEVEN
lyrics:
[Intro: kitchen percussion, chopping rhythm]

[Spoken]
All right.
Dinner in twenty minutes.
No drama.

[Verse 1]

Take that salmon
Pat it dry
Set it on the board
Skin-side nearby

Little olive oil
Salt goes down
Black pepper falling
All around

Garlic powder
Paprika too
Maybe some lemon zest
If that’s your move

[Backing Vocals]
Season it!
Season it!

[Lead]
Don’t drown the fish
Just make it sing

[Pre-Chorus]

Heat the oven
Four-two-five
Give that fillet
Room to thrive

Line the tray
Set it down
Now we’re getting
Dinner-bound

[Chorus]

SALMON AT FOUR-TWENTY-FIVE
TWELVE TO FIFTEEN
KEEP IT ALIVE

LEMON ON TOP
BUTTER IF YOU PLEASE
FLAKE WITH A FORK
AND SERVE WITH EASE

Don’t cook it dry
Don’t let it fight
Pull it when the center
Looks just right

[Verse 2]

While it cooks
Make something bright

Rice or potatoes
Greens on the side

Broccoli roasting
Right beside
Little salt
Little oil
Let it ride

Mix some butter
Garlic
Lemon juice

Parsley if you’ve got it
No excuse

[Backing Vocals]
Whisk it!
Drizzle it!

[Lead]
Now we’re getting somewhere

[Bridge: beat drops, spoken rhythm]

Check the thickest part

Opaque on the outside
Moist in the middle

If you use a thermometer
One-forty-five Fahrenheit
Is the USDA-safe target

[Backing Vocals]
Don’t guess!
Don’t stress!

[Lead]
And remember
Carryover heat
Is real

[Final Chorus]

SALMON AT FOUR-TWENTY-FIVE
TWELVE TO FIFTEEN
KEEP IT ALIVE

LEMON ON TOP
BUTTER IF YOU PLEASE
GARLIC AND HERBS
AND SOMETHING GREEN

Rest it a minute
Plate it up clean

Dinner just happened
Like a beautiful dream

[Outro: light guitar, plate clink]

[Spoken]
Salmon.
Lemon.
Garlic.
Butter.

That’s dinner.

[Final hit]

title: WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END?
lyrics:
[Intro: lone piano, slow handclaps]

[Spoken]
I know what I want.

[Pause]

The question is…

Do I want too much?

[Verse 1: confident groove]

I like the mirror when it likes me back
I like the feeling of staying on track
I like the room when I know my worth
Like I finally learned what I came here for

I worked for the voice
I worked for the nerve
I learned not to beg
For what I deserve

But somewhere between
“I know I can”
And “I deserve the world”

[Backing Vocals]
Where’s the line?
Where’s the line?

[Pre-Chorus]

Is it confidence
When I stand up tall?

Is it pride
When I want it all?

Is it hunger
When I chase the flame?

Or narcissism
When everything becomes my name?

[Chorus: huge guitars]

WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END
AND THE MIRROR BEGIN?

WHEN DOES WANTING MORE LIFE
BECOME NEEDING TO WIN?

I want the bigger room
The brighter light
The road that makes me feel alive

But if I burn down everything I love
Just to prove I can survive—

[Backing Choir]
Was it ambition?
Was it pride?

[Lead]
Or was I feeding something
That can never be satisfied?

[Verse 2: faster delivery]

I tell myself
“You only get one”

So why not chase
Every version of the sun?

More cities
More love
More stories
More names

More chances to become
Someone I haven’t been

[Backing Vocals]
More!
More!
More!

[Lead]
That’s the word that scares me most

Because “more” can build a future
Or turn your whole life into smoke

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t want small
Just to look good

I don’t want shame
Where confidence stood

But if every ceiling
Must be broken through

What happens to the people
Standing underneath it too?

[Chorus]

WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END
AND THE MIRROR BEGIN?

WHEN DOES SELF-BELIEF
TURN INTO NEEDING TO WIN?

I want to make
I want to grow
I want to see how far I go

But if nobody beside me
Can survive the speed I choose

What exactly did I gain
If everybody else I love
I lose?

[Bridge: piano only, intimate]

[Soft Vocal]

Maybe narcissism
Doesn’t always look like vanity

Maybe sometimes
It looks like destiny

Like believing
Your hunger is so important
Everyone else should absorb the cost

[Strings rise]

Maybe pride says
“I matter”

And something darker says

“I matter most”

[Pause]

And maybe the difference
Isn’t wanting more

Maybe it’s whether
Other people still exist
When I walk through the door

[Drums build]

[Verse 3: restrained, reflective]

I want a life that feels enormous
Without making others feel small

I want to trust my own desire
Without believing it outranks them all

I want to love myself
Without becoming
The only person I can see

I want ambition
Without destruction

I want freedom
With responsibility

[Final Chorus: key change]

WHERE DOES CONFIDENCE END?

MAYBE I HAVE TO ASK AGAIN

Every time the room gets brighter
Every time I start to win

Does this make me more alive?

Does this make me more alone?

Am I building something beautiful?

Or worshipping my own throne?

[Choir]
Confidence!

[Lead]
Know your worth

[Choir]
Pride!

[Lead]
Honor what you’ve earned

[Choir]
Ambition!

[Lead]
Reach for something more

[Choir]
But remember—

[Lead]
Other hearts
Are not the floor

[Final Refrain: music strips back]

I don’t want to fear my hunger

I don’t want to worship it

I want enough pride to chase a life
That actually feels like mine

And enough humility

To know
When wanting more

Has crossed the line

[Outro: piano, faint mirror-like synth]

[Spoken]
I still want more.

[Pause]

I just want to know
what I’m willing
to destroy for it.

[Final unresolved chord]

title: NOWHERE AND EVERYWHERE
lyrics:
[Intro: lone piano, distant train ambience]

[Spoken, low]
I always stay
until leaving hurts everyone.

[Pause]

Including me.

[Verse 1: intimate, restrained]

I learn the walls
I learn the names
I learn the rituals and little games

I make a home
I mean it too
That’s the cruelest part of what I do

I don’t arrive with one foot gone
I plant the roots
I carry on

Then somewhere deep beneath the floor
I hear another road
Behind another door

[Backing Vocals]
Stay
Go
Stay
Go

[Lead]
I wish my heart
Would choose one word

[Pre-Chorus: drums rising]

By the time I know
I need to leave

There are people
Who learned to believe

That I was permanent
That I was home

And I hate the way
My truth arrives so slow

[Chorus: huge guitars]

I BELONG NOWHERE
I BELONG EVERYWHERE

Every city feels like mine
Until I need another air

Every love becomes a universe
Every road becomes a prayer

I give my whole heart
Then discover

It was never built
To stay just there

[Verse 2: driving rhythm]

I’ve worn careers like favorite coats
Built identities from careful notes

“This is who I am”
“This is where I’ll be”

Then six months later
There’s another me

Another subject
Another town
Another reason to tear it down

Not from boredom
Not from spite

I just keep seeing
Too many possible lives

[Backing Vocals]
This one!
That one!
Both!
Again!

[Lead]
How do you commit
When every door says “When?”

[Pre-Chorus]

And the worst part is
I love them all

The people
The places
The rise and fall

So every pivot leaves a scar
Because I never leave
Before things matter

[Chorus]

I BELONG NOWHERE
I BELONG EVERYWHERE

Every person leaves a room in me
Every life leaves something there

I want roots
I want wings
I want contradictory things

I give my whole heart
Then discover

I can’t promise
One forever thing

[Bridge: drums drop, piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe I stayed too long
Trying to become
Someone who could stay

Maybe I confused
Consistency
With virtue

Maybe leaving earlier
Would have hurt less

[Pause]

But I didn’t know.

[String swell]

I keep thinking
The next life will fit

The next city
The next love
The next version of it

Then the horizon starts singing again

[Drums build]

And God help me

I still want to listen

[Final Chorus: key change]

I BELONG NOWHERE
I BELONG EVERYWHERE

I AM HOME IN EVERY MOMENT
UNTIL THE MOMENT NEEDS REPAIR

I will break hearts
Including mine

Trying to outrun
A straightened line

Maybe I was never built
For one road

One name

One life

One design

[Choir]
Nowhere!
Everywhere!

[Lead]
I don’t know
If that’s freedom
Or a flaw

[Choir]
Nowhere!
Everywhere!

[Lead]
I only know
I feel the pull
Before I know the cost

[Final Refrain: music strips back]

If I love you
Please believe me

If I leave you
Please believe me too

Both can be true
And that’s the wound

I can mean forever
In the moment

And still become
Someone new

[Outro: train sound slowly approaching]

[Soft Vocal]
I wish I knew
How to choose one path

[Pause]

But every road
Still looks like home

[Final unresolved chord]

title: EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Spoken, almost whispering]
How do you leave
something that helped build you?

[Pause]

How do you call it over
when it still matters?

[Verse 1: intimate vocal]

We built years into these walls
Memories hanging in the halls
Every season knows our names
Every room remembers change

There were mornings full of laughter
There were nights we barely made
There were promises we carried
There were pieces that we saved

And none of it was wasted
None of it was small
That’s what makes this ending
Feel impossible at all

[Pre-Chorus: strings enter]

Because I still care
Because I still know
Exactly what I’m losing
When I finally let it go

[Chorus: full band blooms]

EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
EVEN THE THINGS I LOVE

Even the life I fought to keep
Even the hands I once dreamed of

I wish happiness
Had called me somewhere near

But it’s calling from a place
That means I cannot stay here

So I am breaking my own heart
To give tomorrow room to start

[Verse 2: steady drums]

I know every little rhythm
Every habit, every sign
I know where the floorboards creak
I know the shape of borrowed time

There is comfort in the known
Even when the known grows wrong
There is terror in admitting
You no longer fit the song

[Backing Vocals]
Stay
Stay
Stay

[Lead]
But staying out of history
Is not the same as staying free

[Pre-Chorus]

I can honor what we were
Without becoming what we were

I can love the road behind me
And still choose another turn

[Chorus]

EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
EVEN THE THINGS I LOVE

Even the life I fought to keep
Even the hands I once dreamed of

I wish happiness
Had called me somewhere near

But it’s calling from a place
That means I cannot stay here

So I am breaking my own heart
To give tomorrow room to start

[Bridge: drums drop, piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
There is no villain here

No easy reason
No clean divide

Just the quiet realization
That I disappeared somewhere inside

[Strings rise]

And I miss the person
I might still become

I miss the unknown
I miss the sun

I miss the feeling
That my life is mine

[Pause]

And I can’t keep sacrificing
The future
To protect the past from time

[Build: toms and swelling guitar]

[Lead]
So take the photographs
Take the years
Take the gratitude and tears

Take the version of me
Who loved this life
With everything sincere

[Final Chorus: key change]

EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE
AND GOD, IT HURTS TO KNOW

That sometimes loving something deeply
Still means knowing when to go

I am not leaving
Because the meaning disappeared

I’m leaving because happiness
Finally became louder than my fear

I will grieve
I will shake
I will wonder if this was a mistake

But I would rather start again
Than slowly vanish where I stayed

[Final Refrain: instruments pull back]

Here’s to every year that mattered
Every memory I keep

Here’s to every promise
That I meant when it was spoken deep

Here’s to starting over
Without pretending nothing came before

I can close a meaningful chapter
And still love
What it was for

[Outro: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
This mattered.

[Pause]

You mattered.

[Long pause]

And now…

I have to matter too.

[Final unresolved chord]

title: THE BEAUTIFUL PROBLEM
lyrics:
[Intro: bright piano, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
What an absurd complication
Too many people that I care
Too many invitations
Too much laughter everywhere

I could complain about the calendar
Or curse the lack of clones
But maybe having too much love
Is not the worst of unknowns

[Chorus]
WHAT A BEAUTIFUL PROBLEM TO HAVE
MORE PEOPLE THAN TIME

More hugs than weekends
More hearts crossing mine

Yes, it’s messy
Yes, it’s tiring
Yes, I sometimes lose the plot

But once I feared I’d be alone

And look at all I’ve got

[Verse 2]
Someone wants a dinner
Someone wants a walk
Someone has a crisis
Someone just wants to talk

And somewhere in the chaos
I need a night for me

Love became so plentiful
I’m learning how to breathe

[Bridge]
Gratitude doesn’t cancel limits
Joy doesn’t cancel strain
Something can be overwhelming
And beautiful the same

[Final Chorus]
WHAT A BEAUTIFUL PROBLEM TO HAVE
TOO MUCH LOVE TO FIT THE WEEK

I’ll learn boundaries
I’ll learn balance
I’ll learn when to rest and speak

I won’t curse the crowded heart
For every complicated part

[Outro]
Too many people to love.

[Soft laugh]

Lucky me.

title: I CAN’T BE EVERYWHERE
lyrics:
[Intro: distorted guitar, frantic notification sounds]

[Spoken]
Three messages.
Two dinners.
One body.

Great.

[Verse 1]
Everybody wants a little
And I want to give it all
But my battery is blinking
And I’m missing every call

I have run from room to room
Trying not to disappoint
Till I finally disappeared
At every single meeting point

[Chorus: explosive]
I CAN’T BE EVERYWHERE!
I CAN’T BE EVERYTHING!

Loving you does not require
That I answer every ring

I will show up
I will care
I will tell you when I’m bare

But I refuse to break myself
To prove that I am there

[Bridge: half-time]
If my love requires destruction
Then we’ve misunderstood the deal
I want connection built on honesty
Not exhaustion dressed as real

[Final Chorus]
I CAN’T BE EVERYWHERE
BUT WHEN I’M THERE I’LL REALLY BE

No ghost behind a smiling face
No empty imitation me

[Outro]
One body.
One life.
Still plenty of love.

title: YOU ARE NOT BEING REPLACED
lyrics:
[Intro: soft heartbeat, warm synth]

[Verse 1]
I saw your eyes go distant
When another person came
Like somewhere deep inside you
A quiet alarm became

“If they matter
Do I matter?
If they’re new
Am I now old?”

Come here
Let me answer
Before the fear gets hold

[Chorus]
YOU ARE NOT BEING REPLACED
NO ONE STOLE YOUR PLACE

Love is not a single chair
Where only one can stay

New connection
New affection
Doesn’t rewrite yesterday

You are not being replaced
I’m simply learning more ways to care

[Bridge]
I can’t promise nothing changes
Every living thing must move
But change is not deletion
Growth is not removal too

[Final Chorus]
YOU ARE NOT BEING REPLACED
YOU DON’T HAVE TO WIN

No one needs to lose their meaning
For another love to begin

[Outro]
You are still here.
So am I.

title: MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
lyrics:
[Intro: filtered synth pulse, distant club ambience]

[Whispered Vocals]
No labels.
No limits.
Just light.

[Beat drops]

[Verse 1: sleek, restrained]

I came alive beneath the neon
Where nobody asked me to explain
Why one spark can lead to another
Why every color hits a different vein

Some people dance in straight lines
Some people circle around
I like the way the whole room changes
When every kind of beauty comes down

[Backing Vocals]
Left side
Right side
All night

[Lead]
Why choose one star
When the whole sky’s bright?

[Pre-Chorus: synths rising]

No cages
No claims
No little boxes around our names

Just honesty
Heat
And room to breathe

If the feeling’s real
Why make it leave?

[Chorus: huge, euphoric]

MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
CAN BURN IN THE NIGHT

MORE THAN ONE HEART
CAN MAKE THE WORLD FEEL RIGHT

No one gets smaller
No one disappears

We make more room
We make it clear

There’s enough wonder
Enough desire

Enough space
For more than one fire

[Post-Chorus: festival drop]

[Chopped Vocals]
More
Than
One

More
Than
One

[Verse 2: deeper bass, playful delivery]

I like the mystery in strangers
The way a new soul bends the air
The different ways that people shimmer
When you stop deciding who belongs where

Maybe love was never narrow
Maybe we just drew it so
Maybe hearts were built like cities
With a thousand streets to know

[Backing Vocals]
Come close
Step back
Come near

[Lead]
Freedom sounds better
When nobody owns the fear

[Pre-Chorus]

No hierarchy written in stone
No one has to stand alone

Different rhythm
Different flame

Nothing beautiful
Has to look the same

[Chorus]

MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
CAN BURN IN THE NIGHT

MORE THAN ONE HEART
CAN MAKE THE WORLD FEEL RIGHT

No one gets smaller
No one disappears

We make more room
We make it clear

There’s enough wonder
Enough desire

Enough space
For more than one fire

[Bridge: drums cut, airy synth]

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe the secret
Was never choosing less

Maybe it’s learning
How to care without possession

How to stay honest
Without closing every door

How to let connection
Become something more

[Build: kick returns gradually]

[Choir]
More room
More truth
More life
More you

[Lead]
And somehow
More me too

[Final Chorus: massive]

MORE THAN ONE LIGHT
CAN BURN IN THE NIGHT

MORE THAN ONE HEART
CAN MAKE THE WORLD FEEL RIGHT

Let every color
Enter the frame

Let every connection
Keep its own name

No one gets smaller
No one loses fire

We just keep widening
The shape of desire

[Final Drop]

[All Vocals]
MORE THAN ONE LIGHT!

[Chopped Vocals]
More than one
More than one
More than one

[Outro: pulsing synth fading]

[Whispered Vocal]
No labels.
No limits.

[Pause]

Just light.

[Final bass hit]

title: DIFFERENT LOVE, SAME WEIGHT
lyrics:
[Intro: alternating piano and guitar themes]

[Verse 1]
With you I talk till morning
With them I dance till two
Someone else brings quiet comfort
No one loves exactly like you

One bond feels like lightning
One feels like coming home
Another feels like wandering
Where I’ve never gone alone

[Chorus]
DIFFERENT LOVE
SAME WEIGHT

NOT EVERY HEART
HAS TO LOOK THE SAME

Different rhythm
Different language
Different doorway
Different flame

Don’t compare the shape of closeness
Don’t confuse variety with fate

Different love
Same weight

[Bridge]
A violin is not a trumpet
Still they both can fill the air
Why demand identical music
Just to prove the song is fair?

[Final Chorus]
DIFFERENT LOVE
SAME WEIGHT

LET EACH CONNECTION HAVE ITS NAME

No ranking
No imitation
No requirement to be the same

[Outro]
Different
doesn’t mean less.

title: THE PEOPLE I HAVEN’T MET YET
lyrics:
[Intro: shimmering synth, train wheels]

[Verse 1]
Somewhere there’s a stranger laughing
At a joke I haven’t heard
Someone has a favorite story
Still completely without words

Someone walking through a city
Has no idea I exist
And perhaps a year from now
I’ll know the shape of how they kiss

[Chorus]
HERE’S TO THE PEOPLE I HAVEN’T MET YET
THE WORLDS I HAVEN’T SEEN

The conversations waiting
In the spaces in between

I love the hearts already near me
But life keeps opening the gate

How can I pretend my story’s finished
When connection still awaits?

[Bridge]
It doesn’t make today’s love smaller
To admit tomorrow’s unknown
The heart can honor where it’s living
While remaining free to grow

[Final Chorus]
HERE’S TO THE PEOPLE I HAVEN’T MET YET
AND EVERYONE I LOVE TODAY

May no new light erase an old one
May they simply find their place

[Outro]
Somewhere
another hello is coming.

title: I NEED TO BELONG TO MYSELF TOO
lyrics:
[Intro: piano, deep breath]

[Verse 1]
I saved my nights for everybody
Kept my mornings open wide
If somebody needed something
I would move myself aside

Then one day I met the silence
And it asked me where I’d been
I had made room for every person
Except the one beneath my skin

[Chorus]
I NEED TO BELONG TO MYSELF TOO
NOT ONLY TO THE ONES I LOVE

I need hours nobody owns
A little sky nobody touches

I can give you all my kindness
Without surrendering my name

I need to be somebody
When nobody calls my name

[Bridge]
Self-love isn’t subtraction
It isn’t taking yours away
It’s remembering I’m a person
I must also choose each day

[Final Chorus]
I NEED TO BELONG TO MYSELF TOO
SO I HAVE SOME SELF TO GIVE

I don’t want to love by vanishing
I want both of us to live

[Outro]
Tonight
I’m keeping me.

title: A THOUSAND GOODBYES EVERY DAY
lyrics:
[Intro: train ambience, acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
Every morning starts with choosing
Every choice excludes a road
Breakfast here means missing someone
Rest means setting down the load

Dinner with one person
Means another waits at home
Every yes contains a tiny no
No matter where I roam

[Chorus]
A THOUSAND GOODBYES EVERY DAY
NONE OF THEM FOREVER

Every life we choose to enter
Means leaving some together

I hate the doors that close behind me
Even knowing they’ll reopen soon

There are only so many places
One heart can be by noon

[Bridge]
Maybe loving many people
Means becoming good at leaving
Not disappearing
Not abandoning
Just trusting in returning

[Final Chorus]
A THOUSAND GOODBYES EVERY DAY
AND A THOUSAND HELLOS TOO

Maybe absence isn’t ending
Maybe distance can be true

[Outro]
See you later
is still a kind of love.

title: PLEASE DON’T COUNT THE HOURS
lyrics:
[Intro: clock ticks, mellow bass]

[Verse 1]
You saw them twice
I saw you once
And suddenly the math begins

Who got Saturday
Who got Sunday
Who got messages at ten?

But affection isn’t payroll
And attention isn’t proof
Sometimes one hour holds more closeness
Than a week beneath one roof

[Chorus]
PLEASE DON’T COUNT THE HOURS
DON’T TURN LOVE INTO A SCORE

You are not the minutes given
You are something so much more

Some weeks bend
Some seasons change
Some connections need more care

Don’t mistake uneven time
For uneven love that’s there

[Bridge]
Measure me by honesty
By whether I return
By whether I still know your fears
And what makes your spirit burn

[Final Chorus]
PLEASE DON’T COUNT THE HOURS
COUNT THE MOMENTS THAT ARE TRUE

I don’t want a spreadsheet
Standing between my heart and you

[Outro]
Time is uneven.
Love doesn’t have to be.

title: THE GUILT OF GOING HOME
lyrics:
[Intro: rain, soft piano]

[Verse 1]
You asked if I could stay a while
I wanted to say yes
But something in my tired bones
Was begging me for rest

So I kissed your head
Closed the door
Walked alone beneath the glow

And every step toward my own bed
Felt like choosing you less somehow

[Chorus]
WHY DOES GOING HOME FEEL GUILTY
WHEN I KNOW I NEED THE SPACE?

Why does caring for myself
Feel like abandoning your face?

I can love you
Miss you
Need you
Still need solitude tonight

Going home is not rejection
Rest is not goodbye

[Bridge]
Maybe I was taught that loving
Means remaining till you’re gone
But a heart can leave the room
And keep the tenderness turned on

[Final Chorus]
I’M GOING HOME WITHOUT APOLOGY
THOUGH I STILL MAY FEEL IT sting

I can choose myself this evening
Without undoing anything

[Outro]
Goodnight.
Not goodbye.

title: LOVE HAS NO LIMIT, I DO
lyrics:
[Intro: synth pulse, soft strings]

[Verse 1]
My heart keeps stretching wider
Like it never found an edge
Every person leaves a color
Every promise leaves a thread

But my body counts the hours
My mind eventually says stop
Love may pour forever
But the vessel has a top

[Chorus]
LOVE HAS NO LIMIT
I DO

That’s the painful little truth

I can care beyond exhaustion
But exhaustion still comes through

I can want to hold the whole world
Still need sleep at half past two

Love has no limit
I do

[Bridge]
And limits aren’t betrayal
They’re the shape of being alive
If I burn myself to prove my love
What exactly survives?

[Final Chorus]
LOVE HAS NO LIMIT
I DO

So I’ll give what I can give true

Not infinity
Not perfection
Just an honest piece of you-know-who

[Outro]
My limits don’t measure my love.

title: EVERYONE DESERVES THE FULL VERSION
lyrics:
[Intro: lonely piano]

[Verse 1]
You deserve the version laughing
Not the one that’s barely there
Not the eyes behind a screen
Saying, “Sorry, yes, I care”

You deserve my curiosity
My patience and my spark
Not whatever little fragment
I can scrape out after dark

[Chorus]
EVERYONE DESERVES THE FULL VERSION
NOT THE LEFTOVERS OF ME

But I cannot stay completely full
For everyone I see

I keep giving
Keep dividing
Till the signal starts to fade

Then I hate the half-attention
That exhaustion makes me trade

[Bridge: drums drop]
Maybe love means disappointing
Someone now and then
So I can rest enough
To meet them fully
When I come again

[Final Chorus]
YOU DESERVE THE FULL VERSION
SO SOMETIMES I MUST GO

I would rather miss an evening
Than arrive with nothing whole

[Outro]
Let me recharge.
Then let me really see you.

title: I DON’T WANT TO LOVE YOU EFFICIENTLY
lyrics:
[Intro: metronome, piano stabs]

[Spoken]
Tuesday, 7:30.
Forty-five minutes for intimacy.

Absolutely not.

[Verse 1]
I don’t want to schedule wonder
Between errands and a call
I want conversations stretching
Till we don’t know time at all

I don’t want optimized affection
Color-coded on a screen
I want messy, useless evenings
Where you tell me what you mean

[Chorus]
I DON’T WANT TO LOVE YOU EFFICIENTLY
I WANT TO WASTE SOME TIME

Lose an hour to your story
Lose another to your mind

Real connection has no shortcut
Depth refuses to be neat

If loving you costs hours
Then those hours aren’t defeat

[Verse 2]
But there are others that I cherish
And a body needs to rest
So I keep fighting with the calendar
While trying to give my best

[Bridge]
Maybe presence cannot scale
Maybe that’s what makes it rare
Not love itself
But being fully
Undistractedly there

[Final Chorus]
I DON’T WANT TO LOVE YOU EFFICIENTLY
DON’T TURN MY HEART TO MATH

I’d rather give you one real evening
Than ten distracted halves

[Outro]
No optimization.
Just stay.

title: A HOUSE WITH TOO MANY ROOMS
lyrics:
[Intro: piano, creaking door]

[Verse 1]
My heart became a house somehow
And every person built a room
One filled up with summer mornings
One still smells of cheap perfume

There are rooms for long conversations
Rooms for dancing after two
Rooms I never knew I needed
Until one belonged to you

[Pre-Chorus]
But there’s only one of me
Walking every hall

[Chorus]
I BUILT A HOUSE WITH TOO MANY ROOMS
AND I LOVE EVERY LIGHT

But I cannot sit beside each window
Every single night

If your room goes quiet
Please don’t think I’ve gone

I’m somewhere down another hallway
Trying to keep the whole house warm

[Bridge: orchestral swell]
Maybe love keeps adding stories
Maybe that’s the beautiful curse
More doors open
More hearts enter
One caretaker doing their worst

[Final Chorus]
A HOUSE WITH TOO MANY ROOMS
STILL HAS ONE FRONT DOOR

I may leave your lamp unattended
But I never love you less for more

[Outro]
Leave the light on.
I’ll come back through.

title: NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SECOND
lyrics:
[Intro: soft guitar, heartbeat kick]

[Verse 1]
I see the question in your eyes
When somebody else walks in
“Did I lose a little ground?
Did another story win?”

But love is not a podium
There is no silver place
Different hands can hold me differently
Without erasing any face

[Chorus]
NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SECOND
NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SMALL

I don’t want my love for someone
To make you question yours at all

Different doesn’t mean diminished
New does not replace

Every bond can have its own weight
Its own rhythm, room, and shape

[Verse 2]
You may get my quiet mornings
They may get my midnight drive
Someone else gets endless laughter
All of it is still alive

[Bridge: strings rise]
I cannot make every connection
Look identical and true
But I can make one promise:
I will never measure you

[Final Chorus]
NO ONE SHOULD FEEL SECOND
LOVE IS NOT A RACE

You don’t need to beat another heart
To keep your sacred place

[Outro, soft]
You are not less
Because I love more.

title: THE CALENDAR IS THE ENEMY
lyrics:
[Intro: ticking clock, warm piano]

[Spoken]
My heart keeps saying yes.
My calendar has other ideas.

[Verse 1]
I could spend a lifetime learning
Every way you laugh and ache
Then another heart comes shining
With another world to make

Nobody’s stealing anything
Nobody loved me wrong
There are simply twenty-four small hours
And the wanting is too strong

[Pre-Chorus]
Love says, “Stay”
Time says, “Go”
How can both be true?

[Chorus: soaring]
THE CALENDAR IS THE ENEMY
NOT YOU, NOT THEM, NOT ME

I’ve got oceans worth of feeling
And one body trying to be

Everywhere that love is calling
Every place I want to stay

My heart keeps making promises
My hours cannot pay

[Bridge: drums drop]
If I could split myself in pieces
I’d send one to every door
But I’d rather give you something real
Than pretend that I have more

[Final Chorus]
THE CALENDAR IS THE ENEMY
LOVE WAS NEVER SCARCE

Only mornings
Only evenings
Only miles between our hearts

[Outro]
I don’t love you less
I just ran out of day.

title: ONLY ONE OF ME
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Spoken, quietly]
I wish I could show up
for everyone
exactly when they need me.

[Pause]

But there is only one of me.

[Verse 1]

I want to know the shape of every heart
The hidden place where all the stories start

I want to sit beside the quiet pain
Learn every joy
Remember every name

I want to love in ways that feel complete
Not passing warmth
But something deep

To make each person feel
Seen and known

Not one more face
Among a crowd alone

[Pre-Chorus]

And that would all be beautiful

If time did not exist

If every hour could split itself
Into another kiss

[Chorus: strings swell]

I WANT TO GIVE EVERYONE
THE LOVE THEY DESERVE

THE KIND THAT STAYS
THE KIND THAT LEARNS

I want to hold each fragile truth
And never make a heart feel used

But there are only so many nights
Only so much energy

So much love inside this body

And only one of me

[Verse 2: light drums enter]

Someone needs a conversation
Someone needs a hand

Someone wants a quiet evening
Someone wants me where they stand

Someone misses how I listened
Someone wonders if I’ve changed

And every unanswered message
Feels like affection rearranged

[Backing Vocals]
Do I matter?
Are you there?
Did I lose
My little share?

[Lead]
No, no
That’s the hardest part

Love can grow without a limit
But attention has a start

And an end

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t want to make a ranking
I don’t want to keep a score

I don’t want one person’s closeness
To make another feel ignored

But every yes is time from somewhere
Every promise takes a piece

And sometimes loving everyone
Means learning when to leave

[Chorus]

I WANT TO GIVE EVERYONE
THE LOVE THEY DESERVE

THE KIND THAT STAYS
THE KIND THAT LEARNS

I want to know your deepest dreams
And every hidden in-between

But there are only so many mornings
Only so much I can be

So much love inside this body

And only one of me

[Bridge: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]

Maybe love is not
Being endlessly available

Maybe love is honesty
Before exhaustion turns invisible

Maybe saying
“I cannot tonight”

Can still mean
“You matter to me”

Maybe care does not become less true
Because I need to breathe

[Strings rise]

I want to give from something living

Not from emptiness and fear

I want my presence to feel chosen

Not like someone disappearing here

[Final Chorus: huge]

I STILL WANT TO GIVE EVERYONE
THE LOVE THEY DESERVE

THE KIND THAT SEES
THE KIND THAT SERVES

I want you held
I want you known
I want no heart to feel alone

But I have only one pair of hands
Only one place I can be

A thousand rooms inside my heart

And only one of me

[Choir]
One of me
One of me

[Lead]
So if I need a little distance

[Choir]
It isn’t less

[Lead]
If I miss a night or answer late

[Choir]
It isn’t less

[Lead]
I am learning love can still be deep

Without giving every breath

[Final Refrain]

I cannot be
Everything
To everyone
I see

But I can love you honestly

With the part of life
That’s mine to give

And maybe that is not a failure

Maybe that’s the way
Love gets to live

[Outro: piano and soft choir]

[Whispered Vocal]
So many people to love

[Pause]

Only one of me

[Final unresolved chord]

title: NOT TODAY, FEET
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, room ambience]

[Spoken]
Yesterday we walked everywhere.

Today…

[Pause]

Absolutely not.

[Verse 1: sleepy groove]

My feet have filed a formal claim
My knees refuse to play the game
My calves are sending warning signs
My back has unionized

Yesterday was mile on mile
Still somehow worth it all the while
But morning came and every bone
Said, “Please just leave us all alone”

[Backing Vocals]
Sit down
Lie back
Put those shoes away

[Lead]
The world can keep on moving
I am staying here today

[Chorus: warm guitars enter]

NOT TODAY, FEET
YOU’VE DONE ENOUGH

Yesterday we asked you
For entirely too much

Let the muscles loosen
Let the heartbeat slow

There is nowhere that important
We absolutely have to go

Rest the body
Clear the head
Find a pillow
Find a bed

Yesterday we chased the world

Today we let it come instead

[Verse 2: playful bass]

The couch has never looked so fine
This blanket understands my mind
A glass of water by my side
And zero plans involving strides

No step counter judging me
No scenic route I need to see
If something’s more than ten feet out

[Backing Vocals]
Delivery!

[Lead]
That’s what modern life is about

[Pre-Chorus]

Rest isn’t quitting
Rest isn’t waste

Sometimes recovery
Is exactly the pace

The body kept the promise
Yesterday from dawn till night

So today I’ll return the favor
And treat the poor thing right

[Chorus]

NOT TODAY, FEET
YOU’VE DONE ENOUGH

Yesterday we asked you
For entirely too much

Let the muscles loosen
Let the heartbeat slow

There is nowhere that important
We absolutely have to go

[Bridge: drums drop, dreamy guitar]

[Soft Vocal]

Every adventure leaves a little bill

A sore ankle
A stiff hip
A body asking us to sit still

And maybe listening
Is part of being alive

You can’t keep running beautifully
If you never stop the drive

[Instrumental: gentle guitar flourish]

[Final Chorus: fuller harmonies]

NOT TODAY, FEET
TAKE THE DAY OFF

No heroic journeys
No pretending we’re not soft

Stretch a little
Breathe it in
Let recovery begin

Tomorrow we can wander

But today…

[Music cuts]

We’re staying in.

[Outro: piano only]

[Spoken]
Feet?

[Backing Vocals]
Yes?

[Lead]
Thank you for your service.

[Soft laughter]

[Final chord]

title: I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
lyrics:
[Intro: piano stabs, finger snaps, low bass]

[Spoken]
I don’t just want your name.

I want to know
what keeps you awake.

[Drum hit]

[Verse 1: fast, playful]

I want the story
Behind the smile
The thing you wanted
When you were a child

The song you play
When nobody’s near
The dream you hide
When the room can hear

I want the joke
That makes you fold
The scar you never
Quite retold

I don’t just want
A pretty face

[Backing Vocals]
Then what do you want?

[Lead]
I want the map
Behind the place

[Pre-Chorus]

Every person is a locked-up room
With another little universe inside

And I keep falling for the moment
When somebody finally
Opens it wide

[Chorus: huge guitars]

I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
WHAT MOVES YOUR SOUL

WHAT MAKES YOU LOSE YOUR MIND
WHAT MAKES YOU WHOLE

I want the spark
I want the truth

I want that midnight
“What made you you?”

And when I find it
God, I want it again

That impossible second

When two strangers
Stop being strangers

[Verse 2: bouncing piano]

I love the first confession
After two more drinks

The sudden little silence
Before somebody thinks

“Should I really tell you this?”

[Backing Vocals]
Tell him!

[Lead]
Yes, please.

I want your contradictions
Your terrible opinions

The part of you
That doesn’t fit
In neat little descriptions

One heart
Then another
Another world unfolds

I keep collecting
Tiny truths

Not trophies

[Music cuts]

Souls.

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe I need many mirrors
To see all the ways
A person can be

Maybe every real connection
Unlocks another
Version of me

[Chorus]

I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
WHAT MOVES YOUR SOUL

WHAT MAKES YOU RUN
WHAT MAKES YOU LOSE CONTROL

I want the fear
Behind the charm

The reason you still
Guard your heart

And when I find it
God, I want it again

That beautiful collision

When two people
Become real

[Bridge: piano only, intimate]

[Soft Vocal]
It’s not about numbers.

It’s not about winning.

It’s the hunger
To understand.

[Strings enter]

How many entire worlds
Walk past us every day?

How many people
Could change us

If we stayed long enough
To ask?

[Drums build]

I don’t want affection
Without discovery

I don’t want romance
Without curiosity

I want to meet the person
Behind the performance

Again

And again

And again

[Final Chorus: key change]

I NEED TO KNOW YOUR FIRE
LET ME SEE THE CORE

THE THING YOU NEVER
SHOW ANYBODY ANYMORE

Tell me your wonder
Tell me your shame

Tell me what happens
When nobody’s saying your name

I want the spark
I want the depth

I want the moment
We forget what’s left

And if tomorrow
Another soul shines through

I want to know
What makes them
Them too

[Outro: piano, handclaps]

[Lead]
Maybe love is partly
Learning how to see

[Backing Vocals]
See what?

[Lead]
The whole strange universe
Inside somebody

[Pause]

Then falling in love
With discovery

[Final piano crash]

title: DON’T GIVE ME A KEY
lyrics:
[Intro: sharp piano stabs, finger snaps]

[Spoken]
You should probably know this
before you clear a drawer.

[Drum hit]

[Verse 1: fast, playful]

I like the spark
I like the chase
I like the look before we name the place

I like your clothes
On my bedroom floor
I just get nervous when you say
“Forevermore”

[Backing Vocals]
Uh-oh!

[Lead]
You say, “Stay”
I hear, “Build a fence”

You say, “Us”
I start losing common sense

It’s not that I don’t feel it
God, I feel it way too much

I just panic when affection
Starts discussing joint accounts

[Pre-Chorus: drums building]

Don’t mistake my running
For an empty heart

Sometimes I leave
Because I care enough
To fear the part—

[Chorus: huge guitars]

DON’T GIVE ME A KEY
I MIGHT LOVE YOU AND LEAVE

I’M GREAT AT THE FIRE
I’M BAD AT THE EVE

I can promise you tonight
I can mean every word

But ask me where we’ll be in five years

[Music cuts]

And suddenly I haven’t heard

[Backing Vocals]
Run! Run! Run!

[Lead]
I want the love
I fear the cage

I’m still learning
How to stay

[Verse 2: bouncing piano and bass]

I know the drill
I’ve seen the scene

Two toothbrushes
And a matching washing machine

Sunday brunch
A little dog
A shared account
And matching monologues

[Brass flourish]

And maybe that’s beautiful
Maybe I’m strange

But every time things settle
I start craving a change

I love being chosen
That’s the terrible twist

The second I feel owned
I start checking the exits

[Pre-Chorus]

I don’t want less feeling
I want room to breathe

Can you hold me
Without asking me
To promise I won’t leave?

[Chorus]

DON’T GIVE ME A KEY
I MIGHT LOVE YOU AND LEAVE

I’M GREAT AT THE FIRE
I’M BAD AT THE EVE

I can promise you honesty
I can promise I care

But if love means disappearing
Into somebody else’s chair—

[Backing Vocals]
No! No! No!

[Lead]
I need a door
I need a name

That still belongs to me

[Bridge: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
Maybe commitment
Isn’t chains

Maybe staying
Isn’t losing

Maybe choosing you tomorrow
Means tomorrow
I keep choosing

[Strings rise]

Not because I have to

Not because I swore

But because every morning
I still want to
Open your door

[Drums explode back in]

[Final Chorus]

SO MAYBE GIVE ME A KEY
BUT DON’T THROW OUT MY SHOES

LET ME STAY BECAUSE I WANT TO
NOT BECAUSE I CAN’T REFUSE

I may always need a window
I may always fear the wall

But maybe love is not a prison

[Choir]
IF THERE’S ROOM TO MOVE AT ALL!

[Outro: piano and handclaps]

[Lead]
I’m hard to settle

[Backing Vocals]
We noticed!

[Lead]
Hard to own

[Backing Vocals]
Good!

[Lead]
But maybe I can learn
To make a home

Without becoming
One.

[Final piano crash]

title: Shake It Off Tonight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Heavy words on my back
Dragging heels on the floor
Got that cloud in my chest
And I don't want it no more

I'm stepping out the dark
With my hands in the air
One move, then another
Like the hurt wasn't there

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin me around
Till it falls apart
Spare me now
I don't need the start

[Chorus]
Dance it away, dance it away
Dance it away tonight
(away tonight)
Dance it away, dance it away
Leave all the weight outside
(outside)

Dance it away, dance it away
Watch the bad news fade
(fade away)
Dance it away, dance it away
Till my heart feels made

[Verse 2]
I was stuck in the corners
With my jaw set tight
Now I'm cutting through the room
In my black and white

Every step says bye
To the noise in my head
Every turn says I
Get to live again

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin me around
Till it falls apart
Spare me now
I don't need the start

[Chorus]
Dance it away, dance it away
Dance it away tonight
(away tonight)
Dance it away, dance it away
Leave all the weight outside
(outside)

Dance it away, dance it away
Watch the bad news fade
(fade away)
Dance it away, dance it away
Till my heart feels made

[Bridge]
If it comes back again
I'll be back on the floor
Two feet, one prayer
And a little bit more

[Final Chorus]
Dance it away, dance it away
Dance it away tonight
(away tonight)
Dance it away, dance it away
Leave all the weight outside
(outside)

Dance it away, dance it away
Watch the bad news fade
(fade away)
Dance it away, dance it away
Till my heart feels made

title: WE WILL ALWAYS RISE
lyrics:
[Intro: feedback squeal, snare count-in]

[Gang Shout]
ONE! TWO! THREE! FOUR!

[Verse 1: fast distorted guitars]

We have hit the pavement hard
Worn the bruises, kept the scars
Heard the voices say we’re done
Still we wake to face the sun

Every setback
Every fall
Every night against the wall

Made us louder
Made us wise
Made us learn—

[Gang Vocals]
WE ALWAYS RISE!

[Pre-Chorus: drums double-time]

Let the doors slam
Let the lights go black

We know how to lose
And still come back

[Chorus: huge gang vocals]

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

THROUGH THE FIRE
THROUGH THE FIGHT

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

WHEN THE WORLD SAYS
“NOT TONIGHT”

Knock us down
We’ll hit the ground
Then stand before the dust can settle

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

[Verse 2]

Plans collapse
Friends disappear
Dreams get buried under fear

Sometimes winning means surviving
Sometimes breathing means defying

We don’t need a perfect road
We just carry what we know

Every failure leaves behind
Another reason we can climb

[Gang Vocals]
GET UP!
GET UP!

[Lead]
There is no shame
In falling down

[Gang]
GET UP!
GET UP!

[Lead]
Just don’t build a home
Upon the ground

[Chorus]

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

THROUGH THE FIRE
THROUGH THE FIGHT

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

WHEN THE WORLD SAYS
“NOT TONIGHT”

Break the plan
Change the route
Lose your voice
Then scream it out

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

[Bridge: half-time, bass and drums]

[Lead, shouted]

Here’s to every broken promise
Every door that wouldn’t move

Every person who kept going
With absolutely nothing left to prove

Here’s to crawling
Here’s to healing
Here’s to starting from behind

You don’t need to be unbroken

[Pause]

You just need to keep the climb

[Drum fill]

[Breakdown: gang chant]

RISE!

[Gang]
AGAIN!

RISE!

[Gang]
AGAIN!

RISE!

[Gang]
AGAIN!

[Lead]
As many times
As it takes!

[Final Chorus: double-time, massive]

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

WITH THE SCARS
WITH THE YEARS

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

THROUGH THE DOUBT
THROUGH THE FEAR

Let tomorrow bring the storm
We’ve been rebuilding all along

WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

[Final Refrain]

No crown!
No throne!
No guarantee!

Just blood!
Just breath!
Just history!

We lose!
We learn!
We improvise!

[All Vocals]
AND WE WILL ALWAYS RISE!

[Outro: guitars ringing]

[Gang Vocals]
ALWAYS RISE!
ALWAYS RISE!
ALWAYS RISE!

[Final crash]

title: Velvet Afterglow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came in late
In a satin haze
With a smile like fire
On a Friday blaze

My hands shook once
When you said my name
And the room went soft
Like a slow dance game

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, I was gone
Before I knew
One touch, one look
And the whole world moved

[Chorus]
New love, new gold
You were mine to hold
New love, new gold
Then the night grew cold
We burned so bright
In a velvet tide
New love, new gold
Then you let it go

[Verse 2]
We learned your road
And my favorite tune
Shared a sugar kiss
In the back booth moon

Your coat by the door
My ring on a chain
Little perfect things
That still say your name

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh, I was gone
Before I knew
One touch, one look
And the whole world moved

[Chorus]
New love, new gold
You were mine to hold
New love, new gold
Then the night grew cold
We burned so bright
In a velvet tide
New love, new gold
Then you let it go

[Bridge]
Now the mirror keeps
What your hands released
That first sweet spark
And the final freeze

I still hear you laugh
In the club that night
How a heart can bloom
Then lose its light

[Final Chorus]
New love, new gold
You were mine to hold
New love, new gold
Then the night grew cold
We burned so bright
In a velvet tide
New love, new gold
Then you let it go

title: Tin Roof Weather
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Rain on the drain
Count every drop
Too many thoughts
Won’t let me stop

My hands on the sill
My jaw stays tight
The room feels small
Even in daylight

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear it tap-tap-tapping
On the glass outside
And something in my chest
Starts climbing with the tide

[Chorus]
Let it rain, let it rain
Let it pass through me
Let it rain, let it rain
I’m learning how to breathe
When the sky comes down
And the whole world shakes
I won’t drown in the sound
I won’t break

[Verse 2]
Wet shoes by the door
Muddy from before
I try to move on
But it follows more

Like water in walls
Like smoke in the hall
A quiet little storm
That says it all

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear it tap-tap-tapping
On the glass outside
And something in my chest
Starts climbing with the tide

[Chorus]
Let it rain, let it rain
Let it pass through me
Let it rain, let it rain
I’m learning how to breathe
When the sky comes down
And the whole world shakes
I won’t drown in the sound
I won’t break

[Bridge]
If I name the fear
It loses some teeth
If I stay right here
It loosens its grip on me

One slow breath in
One slow breath out
The storm can move
Without me caving in now

[Chorus]
Let it rain, let it rain
Let it pass through me
Let it rain, let it rain
I’m learning how to breathe
When the sky comes down
And the whole world shakes
I won’t drown in the sound
I won’t break

title: Under the Weight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They want a trophy smile
I got a split-hour mind
Every door swings open
Then the door slams hard behind

Fresh shoes on the floor
Old fear in my chest
I signed my name in fire
Now I sleep in a test

[Pre-Chorus]
And the higher I climb
The harder I breathe
But I learned this weight
Was made for me

[Chorus]
Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I rise
Take what it takes, I can
I’m still here, still alive
Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I fight
If the road burns out my hands
I’ll hold on with all my might

[Verse 2]
More eyes at the door now
More calls in the night
More people say my name
Like they own my life

I taste every win
With a little bit of grit
Every “almost broke”
Turned into “I’m built from it”

[Pre-Chorus]
And the higher I climb
The harder I breathe
But I learned this weight
Was made for me

[Chorus]
Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I rise
Take what it takes, I can
I’m still here, still alive
Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I fight
If the road burns out my hands
I’ll hold on with all my might

[Bridge]
Let it pull, let it press
Let it test my name
Every scar I carry
Says I came to tame the flame

I’ve been bent, I’ve been bruised
Still I’m moving through
What was meant to break me
Made me stronger in the view

[Final Chorus]
Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I rise
Take what it takes, I can
I’m still here, still alive
Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I fight
If the road burns out my hands
I’ll hold on with all my might

Under the weight, I stand
Under the weight, I rise
I was made for the push
I was built to survive

title: LET LOVE BE LOUDER
lyrics:
[Intro: low piano, distant crowd noise, heartbeat kick]

[Whispered Voices]
Fear.
Anger.
Blame.
Again.

[Pause]

[Lead, softly]
What if we answered differently?

[Verse 1: restrained vocal]

We’ve learned to sharpen every word
Before the other side is heard
We’ve learned to turn a wounded face
Into another thing to hate

We carry old frustrations
Like medals from a war
Then wonder why the room gets colder
Every time we keep the score

[Backing Vocals]
Who hurt who?
Who struck first?
Who deserves
To hurt the worst?

[Lead]
Somebody has to break the rhythm
Before the rhythm breaks us all

[Pre-Chorus: strings rising]

Forgiveness doesn’t call the damage small
Tolerance doesn’t mean agreeing at all

Love is not surrender
Mercy isn’t weak

Sometimes strength is choosing
Not to become the thing you seek to beat

[Chorus: full band, massive choir]

LET LOVE BE LOUDER THAN FEAR

LET FORGIVENESS OUTLIVE THE YEARS

LET TOLERANCE STAND
WHERE THE ANGER ONCE STOOD

LET US ANSWER THE WORST
WITH SOMETHING BETTER AND GOOD

When hate says “enemy”
Let compassion say “human”

When frustration says “strike”
Let understanding move in

[Choir]
LOVE!
FORGIVE!
LET LIVE!

[Lead]
Let love be louder than fear

[Verse 2: driving drums]

I’ve been wrong
You’ve been wrong
We’ve both carried damage along

We’ve said things
Built walls
Watched our better instincts fall

But nobody is only
Their most terrible day

And nobody becomes better
When we give them no other way

[Backing Vocals]
Open the door
Loosen the chain

[Lead]
Justice can remember
Without worshipping the pain

[Pre-Chorus]

We can draw a boundary
Without learning how to hate

We can name the harm
Without making vengeance fate

We can disagree
And still leave dignity intact

A future needs a bridge
More than another counterattack

[Chorus]

LET LOVE BE LOUDER THAN FEAR

LET FORGIVENESS OUTLIVE THE YEARS

LET TOLERANCE STAND
WHERE THE ANGER ONCE STOOD

LET US ANSWER THE WORST
WITH SOMETHING BETTER AND GOOD

When hate says “enemy”
Let compassion say “human”

When frustration says “burn it down”
Let patience start rebuilding

[Choir]
LOVE!
FORGIVE!
LET LIVE!

[Bridge: drums drop, piano and choir]

[Spoken-Sung]

This isn’t pretending
there is no cruelty.

This isn’t smiling
while somebody causes harm.

It’s refusing to give cruelty
another home inside your heart.

[Soft Choir]
Another home…

[Lead]
Fear wants multiplication

One wound becomes two
Two become ten

Hatred wants inheritance
Passed from parent
To child
To friend

But forgiveness can interrupt it

Tolerance can stop the spread

And love can look at history
And say—

[Music cuts]

“It ends with me instead.”

[Huge drum fill]

[Final Chorus: key change]

LET LOVE BE LOUDER THAN FEAR

LET THE HATE LOSE POWER HERE

LET FORGIVENESS RISE
LIKE THE MORNING THROUGH THE NIGHT

LET TOLERANCE KEEP
EVERY DIFFERENCE FROM A FIGHT

When fear builds borders
Let kindness cross through

When anger says “destroy them”
Let courage ask “who?”

[Choir]
WHO ARE THEY?
WHO ARE WE?

[Lead]
People trying
To be free

[All Vocals]
LOVE!
FORGIVE!
LET LIVE!

LET LOVE BE LOUDER THAN FEAR!

[Final Refrain: stomping drums, crowd chant]

More mercy!

[Choir]
LESS REVENGE!

[Lead]
More listening!

[Choir]
LESS DEFENSE!

[Lead]
More patience!

[Choir]
LESS CONTEMPT!

[Lead]
More chances
To begin again!

[Choir]
BEGIN AGAIN!
BEGIN AGAIN!

[Outro: piano, soft choir]

[Lead]
We may never agree on everything

[Choir]
That’s all right

[Lead]
We may carry scars forever

[Choir]
Hold them light

[Lead]
But if tomorrow has a chance

It starts when we decide—

[Pause]

Fear doesn’t get
The final word.

[Soft Choir]
Love does.

[Final orchestral chord]

title: THE MACHINE LEARNS HUNGER
lyrics:
[Intro: distant wind, faint radio static, one military snare]

[Old Radio Voice]
For security.
For honor.
For peace.

[Pause]

[Low Piano]

[Whispered Choir]
They always say peace.

[Verse 1: sparse piano, restrained vocal]

A mother folds a uniform
And smooths the shoulders twice
A father says, “Come home again”
As if the words were dice

A train pulls out beneath the flags
The brass band plays too loud
Young faces disappear behind
A cheering, waving crowd

They’ve drawn the maps
They’ve named the threat
They’ve told us what is true

The enemy is monstrous
And the righteous side is you

[Backing Vocals, distant]
March
March
March

[Lead]
Nobody photographs the future
When the banners still look new

[Pre-Chorus: low strings rising]

First comes the speech
Then comes the drum
Then every complicated question
Gets reduced to who must run

Who must kill
Who must die
Who deserves the burning sky

[Chorus: massive, slow]

WAR MAKES GRAVES
AND GRAVES MAKE GHOSTS

GHOSTS MAKE STORIES
WE REMEMBER MOST

A child beneath the rubble
Learns a name to blame

Twenty years from now
We act surprised
When he remembers all the same

WAR BEGETS WAR
WHEN PAIN BECOMES INHERITED

Every bomb can build tomorrow’s enemy
Before tomorrow has begun

[Instrumental: artillery-like drums, low brass]

[Verse 2: marching rhythm]

The first explosion has no politics
To the body underneath

It doesn’t ask your ideology
Before it steals your teeth

A hospital without a ceiling
A school without a wall
A wedding photograph beneath
The concrete in the hall

Somebody screams for water
Somebody calls a name
Somebody wakes tomorrow
And will never be the same

[Backing Choir]
Collateral
Collateral
Collateral

[Lead, bitterly]
A tidy word
For someone else’s dead

A clean abstraction
Spoken far away
From where the children bled

[Pre-Chorus]

Every side has photographs
They never will forget

Every side has funerals
That turn sorrow into debt

Every side can point behind
And say, “Look what they did”

And every generation learns
The reasons it was given

[Chorus]

WAR MAKES GRAVES
AND GRAVES MAKE GHOSTS

GHOSTS MAKE STORIES
WE REMEMBER MOST

A daughter sees her father’s coat
Still hanging by the door

Tell her twenty years from now
That vengeance doesn’t matter anymore

WAR BEGETS WAR
WHEN MEMORY BECOMES A WEAPON

Yesterday keeps loading rifles
For a battle still unborn

[Break: silence, distant ringing]

[Spoken Vocal]

A missile doesn’t only destroy a building.

It creates a witness.

A witness becomes a memory.

A memory becomes a story.

A story becomes identity.

Identity becomes grievance.

Grievance waits.

[Low drum]

Sometimes for decades.

[Verse 3: industrial rhythm begins]

Then factories learn the rhythm
Of the contracts and demand

Machines designed for killing
Become payroll across the land

A senator finds jobs
Inside another fighter wing

A district needs the spending
So the assembly lines can sing

An engineer has children
A machinist has a home
A company has forecasts
That assume the weapons flow

And suddenly the question
Isn’t only, “Should we fight?”

It’s also what goes dark
If peace arrives tomorrow night

[Backing Vocals, mechanical]
Payroll
Contract
Quarter
Growth

[Lead]
The machine learns hunger
And the hunger learns to vote

[Pre-Chorus: percussion becomes factory-like]

When livelihoods depend
On building instruments of war

Peace becomes disruptive
To the balance sheet and floor

New threats keep budgets growing
Old threats keep programs alive

And someone somewhere always benefits
If fear survives

[Chorus: harsher]

THE MACHINE LEARNS HUNGER
THE MACHINE MUST EAT

IT NEEDS ANOTHER ENEMY
TO JUSTIFY THE FLEET

Another generation
Another procurement plan

Another map explaining
Why the danger’s close at hand

WAR FEEDS WAR
WHEN WAR BECOMES AN INDUSTRY

And industries don’t wake one morning
Dreaming how to disappear

[Instrumental Break: mechanical synth, snare, distorted guitar]

[Verse 4: faster spoken-sung cadence]

Build a base
Build another
Ship the weapons
Choose a brother

Fund a faction
Train a force
Change the government
Change the course

Today’s ally
Tomorrow’s threat
Yesterday’s weapon
We haven’t forgotten yet

Arm them now
Because we need them
Fight them later
When we fear them

[Backing Vocals]
Again
Again
Again
Again

[Lead]
The future enemy
May already know our guns

Because somebody once decided
He was useful to someone

[Music abruptly drops]

And every intervention
Leaves something unresolved

A border
A militia
A vacuum
A grievance

A weapon
A debt
A promise
A corpse

[Drums return]

Then years later
We call the consequence
A crisis without cause

[Chorus]

WAR MAKES ENEMIES
ENEMIES MAKE FEAR

FEAR MAKES BUDGETS
THAT RETURN EVERY YEAR

Yesterday’s solution
Can become tomorrow’s war

And every door we kick apart
Can build another locked door

WAR BEGETS WAR
WHEN POWER HAS NO MEMORY

We keep planting fields of anger
Then act shocked by what they grow

[Bridge: mournful strings, no

title: MORE HEARTS THAN HOURS
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Spoken, intimate]
The heart can make room.

The calendar is less generous.

[Verse 1: piano and light strings]

I love the way one person laughs
The way another always asks
If I got home
If I ate
If I need a little space

I love the ones who call at midnight
The ones who sit with me in daylight
The ones who know the oldest scars
And those I’ve only just begun to know

[Backing Vocals, soft]
So many rooms
So many lights

[Lead]
And somehow all of them feel bright

[Pre-Chorus]

But every yes
Creates a no
Somewhere else I meant to go

And every hand I choose to hold
Leaves another hand out in the cold

[Chorus: full band blooms]

I’VE GOT MORE HEARTS THAN HOURS
MORE LOVE THAN TIME

So many beautiful people
I want to keep inside my life

And I don’t want your light diminished
Because I need a night alone

I don’t want space to sound like distance
Or silence to sound like gone

I’m trying to love you
Without disappearing too

[Verse 2: steady drums enter]

I learned that care can turn to panic
When every moment feels demanded

Reply right now
Stay a bit
Prove that nothing here has shifted

And I understand the fear behind it
Because I feel it in myself

That if affection changes shape
Maybe love is leaving on the shelf

[Backing Vocals]
Hold me
See me
Choose me
Stay

[Lead]
How do you reassure a heart
Without giving all your days away?

[Pre-Chorus]

Love is not a ranking board
But time can make it look that way

One dinner missed
One message late
And suddenly a heart may say

“Am I less?”

[Pause]

No.

But I understand
Why it can feel that way

[Chorus]

I’VE GOT MORE HEARTS THAN HOURS
MORE LOVE THAN TIME

So many beautiful people
I want to keep inside my life

And I don’t want your light diminished
Because I need a night alone

I don’t want space to sound like distance
Or silence to sound like gone

I’m trying to love you
Without disappearing too

[Bridge: drums drop, piano only]

Maybe loving well
Means telling the truth

Before exhaustion starts to speak for you

Maybe saying
“I need tonight”

Is kinder than arriving
With nothing left inside

Maybe nobody wins
If I give until I’m hollow

Then wake up with no tenderness
Remaining for tomorrow

[String swell]

I want to show up whole

Not perfect

Not endlessly available

Whole

[Verse 3: hopeful build]

So I’ll make the plans
And miss some too

I’ll send the message
Say “I love you”

I’ll guard the quiet
Keep the door

Open enough to love some more

I’ll trust that people who know my heart
Won’t count affection like a chart

And when somebody needs more care
We’ll name it honestly right there

[Backing Vocals]
No guessing
No score
No keeping count

[Lead]
Love can stretch
But people burn out

[Final Chorus: huge key change]

I’VE GOT MORE HEARTS THAN HOURS
MORE LOVE THAN TIME

But maybe loving beautifully
Means learning how to draw the lines

Not walls
Not locks
Not disappearing

Just enough room to breathe

So when I say
“I need some space”

Please don’t hear
“You matter less to me”

[Choir]
You matter
You matter
You matter still

[Lead]
And I matter too

[All Vocals]
LOVE HAS ROOM FOR BOTH TO BE TRUE

[Final Refrain: music gradually pulls back]

I can love you deeply
And still go home

I can miss you terribly
And need to be alone

I can care for many people
Without measuring who is more

The heart can be a house
With many windows

And still need
One quiet room

[Outro: piano and soft choir]

[Soft Vocal]
More hearts than hours

More love than time

[Whispered Choir]
Make room
Make room

[Lead]
For everyone I love

And some…

for mine

[Final unresolved chord]

title: LEAVE ROOM FOR ME
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant room ambience]

[Spoken, calm]
A free world is not built
only by refusing chains.

It is built
by refusing to become one.

[Verse 1: intimate vocal]

You don’t have to think like me
You don’t have to pray my way
You don’t have to love my choices
Or approve of what I say

You can tell me I am foolish
I can tell you you are wrong
Then we both can leave the table
Without dragging chains along

[Backing Vocals]
Let it breathe
Let it breathe

[Lead]
Freedom needs a little space
For people we don’t understand

[Pre-Chorus]

Kindness isn’t weakness
Tolerance isn’t surrender

It is choosing not to dominate
When disagreement burns like ember

[Chorus: full band enters]

LEAVE ROOM FOR ME
AND I’LL LEAVE ROOM FOR YOU

We can live different lives
Without forcing either view

Speak your mind
Build your world
Trade your work
Love who you choose

A free society begins
When we refuse to make each other lose

[Verse 2: brighter rhythm]

A stranger brings a different song
A neighbor sees the world all wrong

Someone dresses
Someone speaks
In ways that make the crowd critique

But peace is not agreement
It is something harder still

It is living beside difference
Without replacing it with will

[Backing Vocals]
No fist
No threat
No command

[Lead]
Persuasion needs an open hand

[Pre-Chorus]

You can argue
You can boycott
You can criticize the road

But coercion turns conviction
Into somebody else’s load

[Chorus]

LEAVE ROOM FOR ME
AND I’LL LEAVE ROOM FOR YOU

We can live different lives
Without forcing either view

Speak your mind
Build your world
Trade your work
Love who you choose

A free society begins
When we refuse to make each other lose

[Bridge: drums drop, piano and strings]

[Spoken-Sung]

There will always be someone
Who irritates you.

Someone whose choices
Make no sense.

Someone whose words
Make your blood rise.

[Pause]

Freedom is easy
when everyone behaves
the way you would.

[Low strings rise]

The test comes
when they don’t.

[Verse 3: slow build]

So practice mercy in the small things
Let the stranger keep their name

Don’t make every disagreement
Into evidence of shame

Leave some exits
Leave some silence
Leave some room to walk away

Not every difference needs a winner
Not every conflict needs a cage

[Backing Vocals]
Choose kindness
Choose restraint

[Lead]
Power doesn’t have to answer
Every human complaint

[Final Chorus: key change, huge choir]

LEAVE ROOM FOR ME
AND I’LL LEAVE ROOM FOR YOU

Let a thousand peaceful lives
Take a thousand different routes

Build by consent
Speak without fear
Help without command

A freer world is built
By people willing
Not to rule each other’s hands

[Choir]
Kindness!
Tolerance!
Restraint!
Choice!

[Lead]
Let persuasion have a voice

[Choir]
Trade freely!
Live freely!
Care freely!

[All Vocals]
AND NEVER CALL IT FREEDOM
WHEN IT HAS TO COME BY FORCE

[Final Refrain]

You don’t have to love my life
To let me live it

You don’t have to share my dream
To let me give it

You don’t have to call me right
To treat me like I’m free

[Music drops]

And I owe
the very same
to thee

[Outro: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]
Be kind when you can

Be tolerant when it’s hard

Use force as little as possible

[Pause]

And leave the world
with more room
than you found it

[Final chord]

title: Hot Wind Halo
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Towel on the tile
You tilt your head and grin
Steam on the mirror
Little storm begins

Wet ends dripping down
Your hands know what to do
One more pass, one more pass
I’m staring at you

[Pre-Chorus]
Lift it high
Let it fly
Fingers in the gold
Turn that tired morning
Into something bold

[Chorus]
Blow it out
Blow it out
Hot wind halo
Blow it out
Blow it out
Let the whole room glow
Spin me round
Spin me round
Like a wild tornado
Blow it out
Blow it out
Hot wind halo

[Verse 2]
Pins on the counter
Brush in your left hand
You shake out the layers
Like you’re in a band

Ends get lighter
The dark turns bright
Every little strand
Catches fire in the light

[Pre-Chorus]
Lift it high
Let it fly
Hear that final hum
All that morning chaos
Gone and then done

[Chorus]
Blow it out
Blow it out
Hot wind halo
Blow it out
Blow it out
Let the whole room glow
Spin me round
Spin me round
Like a wild tornado
Blow it out
Blow it out
Hot wind halo

[Bridge]
[Break]
Slow it down
Then snap it back
One last sweep
One last attack
You laugh like
You know you won
And the day starts
Now, not some

[Final Chorus]
Blow it out
Blow it out
Hot wind halo
Blow it out
Blow it out
Let the whole room glow
Spin me round
Spin me round
Like a wild tornado
Blow it out
Blow it out
Hot wind halo

title: THE ARITHMETIC OF HEARTS
lyrics:
[Intro: delicate piano, distant strings]

[Spoken, softly]
They taught us love
like there was only so much to go around.

[Pause]

What a peculiar economy.

[Verse 1: intimate vocal]

We learned to draw our little lines
Around the people we called mine
This chair is yours
That door is closed
These are the feelings we’ve exposed

Don’t stand too near
Don’t care too much
Be careful where you place your touch

As though affection had a tank
And every kindness drained the bank

[Backing Vocals]
Mine
Yours
His
Hers

[Lead]
Everybody keeping books
On things that never learned accounting

[Pre-Chorus]

If I laugh with you
Does someone lose?

If I hold a friend
What did I use?

If my heart grows wider
Tell me why

We treat each open window
Like goodbye

[Chorus: drums bloom, wide harmonies]

LOVE ISN’T GOLD
BURIED UNDERGROUND

IT DOESN’T GET SMALLER
WHEN THERE’S MORE OF IT AROUND

I can cherish you
And care for them

And neither light
Has got to dim

Maybe hearts aren’t little kingdoms
Built for one flag flying above

Maybe nobody has to own
The territories of love

[Verse 2: playful bass enters]

We have treaties for affection
Customs posts for every friend

Forms explaining which connection
May continue, where, and when

“This one’s harmless”
“That’s suspicious”
“Why’d you smile at them like that?”

We’ve turned tenderness to contraband
And jealousy into a tax

[Backing Vocals, mock-official]
Declare your feelings!
State their value!
Anything to report?

[Lead]
Yes, officer

I accidentally cared about
Another human being

[Music stop]

Terribly sorry.

[Pre-Chorus]

Some boundaries keep us safe
And they deserve respect

But sometimes fear wears boundaries
Like medals on its chest

There’s a difference between choosing
What you need to feel secure

And believing every human bond
Makes another bond less pure

[Chorus]

LOVE ISN’T GOLD
BURIED UNDERGROUND

IT DOESN’T GET SMALLER
WHEN THERE’S MORE OF IT AROUND

I can cherish you
And care for them

And neither light
Has got to dim

Maybe hearts aren’t little kingdoms
Built for one flag flying above

Maybe nobody has to own
The territories of love

[Instrumental Break: piano and guitar exchanging gentle phrases]

[Bridge: strings, no drums]

Think of everyone you almost knew

Because somebody might misunderstand

Every friendship kept at arm’s length
Every unextended hand

Every person who could’ve mattered
But the rules said, “Not too near”

Every beautiful connection
We surrendered out of fear

[Pause]

What if love behaves like music?

[Guitar harmonic]

One melody begins another
Without the first one disappearing

What if every human closeness
Doesn’t need a ranking?

Doesn’t need permission?

Doesn’t need to threaten
Something already dear?

[Drums begin building]

[Verse 3]

You are not less precious
Because others make me smile

I am not abandoning you
Because I walk another mile

Trust is not surveillance
Love is not a chain

And nobody becomes safer
By pretending hearts are tame

We can choose our promises
We can say what we require

We can honor every boundary
Without putting walls around desire

[Final Chorus: huge key change]

LOVE ISN’T GOLD
THERE’S NO FINAL VEIN

NO LAST DROP OF KINDNESS
NO MONOPOLY ON PAIN

Let affection multiply
Let honest words replace the spies

Let every relationship become
What those inside it freely choose

[Choir]
Not possession!

[Lead]
Connection

[Choir]
Not permission!

[Lead]
Conversation

[Choir]
Not scarcity!

[Lead]
Abundance

[All Vocals]
NOT EVERY LOVE
HAS TO COMPETE
WITH EVERY OTHER LOVE

[Final Refrain: instruments slowly fall away]

Maybe I can love you deeply

Without asking you
To close every door

Maybe you can choose me freely

And freedom makes it mean
A little more

[Soft Choir]
A little more

[Lead]
There are billions of us
Passing briefly through this place

Why make the heart a fortress

When it could become
A meeting space?

[Outro: piano only]

[Spoken]

People aren’t property.

Neither is affection.

[Pause]

Love doesn’t have to be scarce
to be precious.

[Final warm chord]

title: Flag in the Rain
lyrics:
[Intro: single piano chord, distant crowd murmur]

[Spoken]
They’ll hand you a costume.

They’ll tell you it fits.

[Pause]

You are allowed to say no.

[Drums enter]

[Verse 1]

They drew the lines before you came
Put little boxes by your name
Told you which colors you should wear
How loud to laugh, how much to care

They’ll say,
“Be sensible”
“Don’t stand out”
“Lower your voice”
“Control your doubt”

But some hearts simply won’t behave
Like decorations in a cage

[Backing Vocals]
Too bright!
Too strange!
Too much!

[Lead]
Good.

[Pre-Chorus]

Here’s to the ones who heard the rules
And asked who gave them all the tools

Here’s to the ones who took the map
Turned it over
Drew another path

[Chorus: huge guitars and choir]

CHOOSE YOUR OWN NAME
LIKE A FLAG IN THE RAIN

LET THEM STARE
LET THEM TALK
LET THEM CALL YOU INSANE

If the world builds a doorway
Too narrow for your frame

Don’t cut pieces off yourself

[Choir]
WIDEN THE FRAME!

[Lead]
Here’s to the bold
Here’s to the strange

Here’s to the ones
Who refuse to be changed

Into somebody easier
For somebody else to explain

Wear your own name

[Verse 2: bouncing bass, handclaps]

Here’s to the woman who chose her own road
While everybody handed her another load

Here’s to the man who learned to cry
After years being told that boys stay dry

Here’s to the artist dressed too loud
The quiet kid who leaves the crowd

The lover who loves
The thinker who doubts
The person who finally
Lets themselves out

[Backing Vocals]
There you are!
There you are!

[Lead]
Funny how freedom
Can look like becoming
Who you already are

[Pre-Chorus]

Society loves a tidy shelf
A label underneath yourself

But human beings were never made
To fit perfectly in a display

[Chorus]

CHOOSE YOUR OWN NAME
LIKE A FLAG IN THE RAIN

LET THEM STARE
LET THEM TALK
LET THEM CALL YOU INSANE

If the world builds a doorway
Too narrow for your frame

Don’t cut pieces off yourself

[Choir]
WIDEN THE FRAME!

[Instrumental Break: triumphant guitar solo]

[Handclaps]

[Choir]
Too loud!
Too soft!
Too weird!
Too free!

[Lead, laughing]
Sounds perfect to me.

[Bridge: music drops to piano and strings]

It isn’t easy being honest
When honesty has a price

When family turns to silence
When strangers aren’t so nice

When every room has expectations
Waiting quietly at the door

And being true to who you are
Means losing what you had before

[Pause]

So here’s to every trembling hand
That still reached for its own life

Every voice that said
“This is who I am”

Even when the room went quiet

[Strings swell]

That isn’t vanity

That isn’t selfish pride

Sometimes being yourself
Is simply refusing

To disappear inside

[Drums explode back in]

[Final Chorus: key change]

CHOOSE YOUR OWN NAME
LET IT RING THROUGH THE HALL

YOU WERE NEVER BORN
TO BE ACCEPTABLE TO ALL

Let them measure
Let them judge
Let them build another wall

A life lived as somebody else

[Choir]
ISN’T YOUR LIFE AT ALL!

[Lead]
Here’s to the fierce
Here’s to the shy

Here’s to the ones
Who finally stopped asking why

They had to become smaller
Just to make somebody comfortable nearby

[Choir]
Stand tall!
Stand strange!
Stand true!

[Lead]
There is only one life
That belongs to you

[Final Refrain]

Wear the clothes
Love the love
Speak the words
Dream the dream

Choose the road
Change your mind
Become whoever you mean

[Choir rising]
Not their version
Not their plan
Not the person
They demand

[Lead]
Let the world meet you
Without disguise

[Music drops]

And if they don’t understand…

[Pause]

At least they met
Your actual eyes

[Outro: piano and soft choir]

[Soft Vocal]

title: ROOM FOR ALL OF US
lyrics:
ROOM FOR ALL OF US

[Intro: scattered voices, tuning orchestra, soft piano]

[Voice 1, distant]

[Voice 2]
So do I.

[Voice 3]
Good.

[Drums enter slowly]

[Verse 1: restrained, thoughtful]

One makes toys

To build
To trade
To try

Everyone comply

LET A MILLION DIFFERENCES LIVE

You don’t have to love my choices
To let me choose what I can give

Trade your bread
Trade your song
Trade your strange idea all night long

When nobody has to rule us all

We learn how much
We have to offer one another

[Post-Chorus: bright guitar riff]

[Choir]
Different!
Together!

[Lead]
Not identical

[Choir]
Together!

[Verse 2: driving bass]

The baker doesn’t need to know
The miner’s politics below

The coder doesn’t need to pray
The way the farmer does each day

A price can carry what we need
Without a sermon or a creed

You bring something
I bring mine

Voluntary exchange
Can cross the line

[Backing Vocals]
You know something
I don’t know

[Lead]
That’s how scattered knowledge grows

[Pre-Chorus]

Every trade can say

“I value what you’ve made”

Without requiring
Either side to be remade

And every peaceful bargain made

Turns difference
Into mutual gain

[Chorus]

MAKE ROOM FOR ALL OF US

LET A MILLION DIFFERENCES LIVE

You don’t have to share my worldview
To have something great to give

Trade your labor
Trade your art
Let cooperation quietly start

When nobody has to rule us all

We discover how
Our differences can serve each other

[Instrumental Break: piano and guitar exchanging melodies]

[Piano Phrase]

[Guitar Response]

[Trumpet joins]

[Spoken, amused]
See?

Nobody had to play the same instrument.

[Bridge: music darkens]

But fear will always make the pitch:

“They’re strange
They’re wrong
They’re getting rich”

“They live unlike you”
“They speak too loud”

“They don’t belong
Inside this crowd”

[Low Choir]
Make them stop
Make them bend
Make them live
The way we intend

[Lead]
That’s how tolerance disappears

Not all at once

But inch by inch
Through cultivated fear

[Drums drop out]

[Lead, softly]

Tolerance isn’t saying
Everything is good.

It isn’t surrender.

It isn’t silence.

It’s saying:

“I may oppose what you believe…

And still reject the urge
To own your life.”

[Orchestra swells]

[Verse 3: hopeful]

Let people argue
Let people leave

Let them persuade
Let them believe

Let communities form and change
Let peaceful lives remain strange

Let bad ideas face better speech
Let truth be tested within reach

Give people exits
Give people choice

Give minorities space
To keep a voice

[Backing Vocals]
Live and let live

[Lead]
Wherever peace allows

[Pre-Chorus]

Pluralism is messy
Freedom often is

But uniformity gets frightening
When someone decides what uniform is

[Final Chorus: key change, massive]

MAKE ROOM FOR ALL OF US

FOR THE MANY WAYS TO LIVE

Free exchange turns strangers
Into partners with something to give

Tolerance keeps power
From making every disagreement war

Pluralism keeps doors open

So tomorrow
Can contain something more

[Choir]
Speak freely!

[Lead]
And answer speech with speech

[Choir]
Trade freely!

[Lead]
And let cooperation reach

[Choir]
Live freely!

[Lead]
While respecting others too

[All Vocals]
A BETTER WORLD
DOESN’T NEED
EVERYBODY
TO AGREE WITH YOU

[Final Refrain: triumphant]

Different faiths
Different homes

Different books
Different tones

Different markets
Different art

Different answers
Different starts

[Choir building]
Room for disagreement
Room for surprise

Room for experiments
Nobody designed

[Lead]

One approved point of view

It should be millions of people

Trying peaceful things

And seeing
What proves true

[Outro: piano, voices returning]

[Voice 1]
I still disagree.

[Voice 2]
Me too.

[Pause]

[Voice 3]
Coffee?

[Soft laughter]

[Lead, quietly]
That’s civilization.

[Final orchestral chord]

Long line, long line
You always find me first

At the burger spot

[Chorus]
Long line, long line
