title: THE DAYS AHEAD
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant tape hiss]

[Spoken, intimate]
I used to think
the best day of my life
had already happened.

[Pause]

What a strange thing
to decide so early.

[Verse 1: piano only]

I remember rooms that disappeared
Faces I can still see clear
Summer nights that felt like gold
Promises I thought I’d always hold

There were mornings I would live again
There were nights I thought would never end
Little victories, private scars
Tiny worlds beneath enormous stars

[Strings enter softly]

And I used to hold those memories
Like evidence of who I’d been

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters]

But memory isn’t prophecy
And yesterday can’t tell me when

The next great door will open
Or the next hard rain begins

[Chorus: full drums, wide guitars]

MY BEST DAYS HAVEN’T HAPPENED YET
MY WORST DAYS MAY BE WAITING TOO

There are loves I haven’t stumbled into
There are losses I don’t yet know how to lose

There are songs I’ve never heard
There are names I’ve never said

So I’ll treasure every road behind me

But I won’t live there instead

[Post-Chorus: backing vocals]

[Choir]
Not finished!
Not finished!

[Lead]
Not even close

[Verse 2: steady groove]

I remember being twenty-something
Certain I knew everything

Every ending felt eternal
Every heartbreak wore a crown like a king

Now I smile at old disasters
Some became the roads I needed most

Some mistakes became my teachers
Some goodbyes became a ghost

[Backing Vocals, soft]
Keep them
Thank them
Let them go

[Lead]
Every version of me carried
Something forward I didn’t know

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe wisdom isn’t knowing
How the story ought to end

Maybe wisdom is appreciating
Every chapter while it bends

[Chorus]

MY BEST DAYS HAVEN’T HAPPENED YET
MY WORST DAYS MAY BE WAITING TOO

There are cities I haven’t woken in
There are people who will change my point of view

There are tears I haven’t earned
There are laughs still up ahead

So I’ll love every life I’ve already lived

But I won’t live there instead

[Instrumental Break: soaring guitar melody]

[Piano answers]

[Guitar rises]

[Drums drop out]

[Bridge: intimate vocal, strings underneath]

Maybe there will come a morning
That makes every morning pale

Maybe there will come a winter
When I swear that I have failed

Maybe someone I don’t know yet
Will become impossible to lose

Maybe I’ll become somebody
That today I couldn’t choose

[Pause]

That’s the terrifying beauty

[Heartbeat kick enters]

Nothing’s finished
Nothing’s known

Every year removes a certainty

And somehow makes the world more open

[Build: toms, strings, rising synth]

[Lead]
So here’s to all the foolish nights

[Backing Choir]
We survived!

[Lead]
Here’s to every wrong and right

[Choir]
Still alive!

[Lead]
Here’s to everyone I loved

And every person I became

I wouldn’t burn a single chapter

Just because I turned the page

[Final Chorus: huge key change]

MY BEST DAYS HAVEN’T HAPPENED YET
MY WORST DAYS HAVEN’T EITHER

There are storms still gathering somewhere
There are sunsets I will watch in better weather

I will break
I will mend
I will lose
I will begin

And I’ll carry every beautiful mistake
Into whatever comes again

[Choir]
Keep going!
Keep going!

[Lead]
There’s more than what I’ve seen

[Choir]
Keep going!
Keep going!

[Lead]
There’s more than what I’ve been

[Final Refrain: music pulls back]

I loved the days behind me

Even the ones that hurt

They taught my hands what holding means
They taught my heart its worth

But somewhere past tomorrow
There’s a moment I’ll call mine

And I haven’t met the person yet
Who’ll be living it inside

[Outro: piano only]

[Soft Vocal]

The best day of my life?

[Pause]

Ask me when it’s over.

[Final unresolved chord]

[Whispered Choir]
Not finished yet.

title: THE SIGNAL IN THE PRICE
lyrics:
[Intro: ticking percussion, pulsing synth bass]

[Spoken Vocal]
One more unit.
One more buyer.
One more seller.

What is it worth…

right now?

[Verse 1]

A farmer wakes before the dawn
A factory switches engines on
A trucker takes another load
A shopkeeper watches down the road

None of them can see the whole
No single hand controls the role
But every choice begins to speak
Through what is plenty, what is scarce this week

[Pre-Chorus]

One more barrel
One more chair
One more hour
One more share

At the edge where choices meet
There’s a signal underneath

[Chorus]

THE MARGINAL PRICE
IS TALKING TONIGHT

Whispering scarcity
Left and right

Buyers say want
Sellers say cost
Somewhere between them
The message gets crossed

Raise it when something
Is harder to find
Lower it when plenty
Is waiting in line

No conductor
No central device

Millions coordinate
Through the signal in the price

[Verse 2]

Coffee fails in distant rain
The harvest shrinks across the plain
Nobody needs a grand decree
The higher price says, “Use carefully”

Another farmer sees the gain
Plants a little more next spring
Consumers shift, producers move
A thousand plans begin to groove

[Backing Vocals]
Save some
Make more
Substitute
Explore

[Lead]
The number isn’t just a bill
It’s information moving still

[Pre-Chorus]

At the margin
Choice by choice
Every trade becomes a voice

What is valued?
What is rare?
Where should labor travel there?

[Chorus]

THE MARGINAL PRICE
IS TALKING TONIGHT

Whispering scarcity
Left and right

Buyers say want
Sellers say cost
Somewhere between them
The message gets crossed

Raise it when something
Is harder to find
Lower it when plenty
Is waiting in line

No conductor
No central device

Millions coordinate
Through the signal in the price

[Bridge: half-time, darker]

But suppose somebody hates the sound

Says, “That number must come down”

Draws a line across the page
And orders price into a cage

[Low synth enters]

If the ceiling falls below
What buyers want and sellers know

Demand keeps shouting
Supply pulls back

And suddenly shelves
Begin to crack

[Backing Vocals]
Shortage
Waiting
Queues
Rationing

[Lead]
The signal was muted
But scarcity stayed

The number was altered
The cost wasn’t erased

[Verse 3: heavier drums]

Or push the price above the trade
And unwanted goods begin to stay

Surplus grows behind the wall
Too much produced, not enough call

You can change the posted sign
You cannot cancel space and time

You can forbid the market’s voice
But resources still demand a choice

[Pre-Chorus]

Someone still decides
Who waits
Who receives
Who pays

If money cannot clear the line
Then favors, queues, or luck decide

[Chorus: bigger]

THE MARGINAL PRICE
WAS TRYING TO SAY

Something has changed
Adjust today

When you distort it
The message grows weak
And people start searching
For other ways to speak

Black markets
Waiting lists
Connections and time

Costs don’t disappear
Because you outlaw the sign

The economy still has to ration somehow

The only question is
Who decides it now?

[Instrumental Break: jagged guitar and synth]

[Spoken Breakdown]

A price is not a moral verdict.

It does not say
what someone deserves.

It does not say
what something ought to mean.

It says—

[Pause]

At this moment,
given these choices,
this is where another buyer
meets another seller.

[Drums build]

[Verse 4]

Prices rise and people curse
Sometimes markets work much worse

Power can distort the trade
Fraud can poison what is paid

Monopoly, barriers, hidden costs
External damage, trust that’s lost

A market needs rules that keep it clear
Property, contracts, competition here

[Backing Vocals]
Information
Competition
Accountability

[Lead]
A signal works when people can respond
And the rules don’t rig the song

[Final Chorus: triumphant]

LET THE PRICE SPEAK
BUT KNOW WHAT IT MEANS

It’s a coordination signal
Not a king or a creed

At the margin
Plans collide
Knowledge scattered far and wide

Producers listen
Consumers choose
Every adjustment carries news

When scarcity changes
Let the signal arise

Fix the broken conditions
Don’t just break the price

Because millions of people
With different designs

Can somehow move together
Through the signals in the lines

[Final Refrain]

One more worker
One more good

One more question:
“Should we?”

One more answer
Formed in trade

From all the choices
People made

[Soft Choir]
At the margin
At the margin

[Lead]
That’s where tomorrow gets supplied

[Outro: ticking rhythm slows]

[Spoken Vocal]

You can silence the number.

[Pause]

But you cannot silence scarcity.

[Final synth pulse]

Listen to the price.

[End]

title: CARRY THE FIRE
lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, distant synth pulse]

[Verse 1]

We built with copper, glass, and wire
Learned to catch a little fire
Every failure left a mark
Every wrong turn lit the dark

Punch cards, terminals, blinking screens
Tiny steps and giant dreams
Every tool we thought would last
Became a lesson from the past

[Pre-Chorus]

We don’t have to worship yesterday
We don’t have to throw it all away

Take what worked
Remember why
Then build the next thing twice as high

[Chorus]

CARRY THE FIRE
INTO THE NEW

Keep what we learned
And change what we do

Look to the future
Eyes open wide

History’s a compass
Not a place to hide

CARRY THE FIRE
LET THE OLD LIGHT THE WAY

Tomorrow isn’t coming
It’s beginning today

[Verse 2]

The mainframe gave us systems scale
The web taught information how to sail
Open source unlocked the gate
Clouds taught compute to migrate

Now models reason, agents act
Machines can search, compose, react
But every shiny leap ahead
Still needs the wisdom of the dead

[Backing Vocals]
Remember the bugs
Remember the breaks
Remember the cost
Of repeating mistakes

[Pre-Chorus]

New technology can change the game
But human nature stays much the same

Ask who benefits
Ask who pays
Build with care for coming days

[Chorus]

CARRY THE FIRE
INTO THE NEW

Keep what we learned
And change what we do

Look to the future
Eyes open wide

History’s a compass
Not a place to hide

CARRY THE FIRE
LET THE OLD LIGHT THE WAY

Tomorrow isn’t coming
It’s beginning today

[Bridge: music drops to piano and synth]

Don’t fear the machine
Understand the machine

Don’t worship the machine
Command the machine

Don’t close every door
Because one room burned before

Learn why it burned
Then build a better door

[Drums building]

Every generation gets a choice
Silence the future
Or give it a voice

But progress without memory
Can make the same mistakes at speed

So bring the scars
Bring the maps
Bring every lesson from collapse

Then take the wheel
And drive ahead

The future needs the living
Not the dead

[Final Chorus: huge]

CARRY THE FIRE
INTO THE NEW

Honor the builders
Then build something new

Keep asking questions
Keep changing your mind

Leave broken assumptions
A century behind

CARRY THE FIRE
LET CURIOSITY LEAD

Build what empowers
Build what we need

Not fear of tomorrow
Not chains to the past

Take every lesson
Then move forward fast

[Final Refrain]

We are not starting over

We are starting from here

With a thousand years behind us
And another drawing near

So open the window
Turn on the light

Take what history taught us

And build tomorrow right

[Outro: synth pulse fading]

[Soft Vocal]

Remember.

Imagine.

Build.

[Final chord]

title: THE ICEBERG OPEN LAKEHOUSE
lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing synth, distant guitar harmonics]

[Spoken Vocal]
Open storage.
Open tables.
Open catalogs.

[Drums enter]

Build the lakehouse open.

[Verse 1]

Once we had the warehouse walls
Then the data lake grew tall
Files were cheap and scale was wide
But structure struggled with the tide

Then the lakehouse changed the game
Open storage, tables, names
Analytics meeting data lakes
Without the walls that lock creates

[Backing Vocals]
Open files
Open tables
Open choice

[Lead]
Let every engine have a voice

[Pre-Chorus]

Separate the storage from the compute
Separate the data from the tool

Let the architecture stay composable
Let the format write the rules

[Chorus: full band]

THIS IS THE OPEN LAKEHOUSE
DATA WITHOUT THE CHAINS

Open formats underneath it
Different engines on the same terrain

Keep the tables interoperable
Keep the architecture free

Build around the open standards
And choose the tools you need

[Post-Chorus]

Open Lakehouse!
Open Lakehouse!

One data layer
Many possibilities

[Verse 2: stronger rhythm]

Apache Iceberg draws the map
For enormous tables on the lake

Snapshots track the state through time
Schema changes stay in line

Partition evolution
Hidden from the query above

Transactions across the table
Built for engines that we love

Spark can read it
Flink can stream it
Dremio can query fast

Engines come and engines change
But the table format lasts

[Pre-Chorus]

Metadata gives the table meaning
Snapshots make the history clear

Files below can keep on scaling
While the table stays coherent here

[Chorus]

THIS IS THE OPEN LAKEHOUSE
DATA WITHOUT THE CHAINS

Apache Iceberg underneath it
Different engines on the same terrain

Keep the tables interoperable
Keep the architecture free

Build around the open standards
And choose the tools you need

[Instrumental Break: synth arpeggio and guitar]

[Spoken Breakdown]

But a table needs a name.

A name needs a catalog.

And a catalog becomes the meeting point.

[Sub bass hit]

Enter Polaris.

[Verse 3]

Apache Polaris stands between
The engines and the tables they can see

Cataloging the Iceberg world
With governance and interoperability

Names and namespaces
Access rules
Credentials moving where they should

A catalog that speaks the language
Of an ecosystem built for good

[Backing Vocals]
Iceberg below
Polaris above

[Lead]
Open interfaces connect the stuff

[Backing Vocals]
Storage!
Tables!
Catalog!
Compute!

[Lead]
Each one open
Each one you can choose

[Bridge: half-time, cinematic]

The Open Lakehouse isn’t one product
It isn’t one vendor’s machine

It’s an architecture made of standards
With replaceable pieces in between

Object storage holds the data
Iceberg organizes the state

Polaris helps engines discover it
While open interfaces integrate

And when tomorrow brings a better engine
You shouldn’t rebuild the ground

The data stays
The tables stay
The ecosystem turns around

[Build]

Open means choice

Open means portable

Open means interoperable

Open means the architecture belongs to you

[Final Chorus: huge]

BUILD THE OPEN LAKEHOUSE
LET THE DATA MOVE

APACHE ICEBERG FOR THE TABLES
POLARIS FOR THE CATALOG TOO

Many engines
One foundation
Open standards underneath

Build the architecture for tomorrow
Without surrendering the keys

[Choir]

ICEBERG!
POLARIS!
OPEN LAKEHOUSE!

[Lead]
Learn the format
Learn the stack

Understand the architecture
Then bring that knowledge back

[Final CTA: music drops to driving piano and drums]

Want to learn the Iceberg Lakehouse?

Visit—

[Choir]
ICEBERGLAKEHOUSE.COM!

[Lead]
Want the wider world of lakehouse architecture?

[Choir]
DATALAKEHOUSEHUB.COM!

[Lead]
And if you want to go deeper
From the concepts to the code

Check out the books by Alex Merced
And take the longer road

[Massive final build]

[All Vocals]

BOOKS DOT ALEXMERCED DOT COM!

Learn the tables
Learn the catalog
Learn the architecture underneath

Build it open

Build it portable

Build the lakehouse free

[Outro: fading synth]

[Soft Vocal]
Open storage

Open tables

Open catalogs

Open choice

[Whispered Choir]
IcebergLakehouse.com

DataLakehouseHub.com

Books.alexmerced.com

[Final guitar chord]

title: THE HOLE STILL KNOWS MY NAME
lyrics:
THE HOLE STILL KNOWS MY NAME

[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Verse 1: intimate, almost conversational]

I like the way a kindness lands
So lightly in another’s hands
A coffee bought, a door held wide
A little warmth against the tide

I like to catch somebody’s eyes
Just when they’re trying not to cry
To say the thing they needed said
To leave a little light instead

[Soft strings enter]

And when they smile
Something in me lifts

For half a second
Everything fits

[Pre-Chorus]

I give because it feels like air
I give because I want to care
I give because the world gets cold
And someone’s got to make it warm

[Chorus: drums and strings swell]

But the hole still knows my name
Even when the room is full of love

Even when somebody holds me close
And tells me I am enough

I believe them
God, I do

I feel the kindness coming through

But somewhere underneath the flame
The hole still knows my name

[Verse 2: fuller arrangement]

I love it when they think of me
A message sent at half past three
A hand upon my shoulder when
I didn’t know I needed one again

I keep those moments like small charms
Proof the world has gentle arms
And every time somebody stays
I think perhaps this time it fades

[Backing Vocal, soft]
Maybe now
Maybe now

[Lead]
But happiness can fill the room
And emptiness still finds the gloom

[Pre-Chorus]

It isn’t that the love feels false
It isn’t that I miss it all
I taste the sweetness
Feel it bloom

And still there’s one unfilled room

[Chorus]

The hole still knows my name
Even when the room is full of love

Even when somebody holds me close
And tells me I am enough

I believe them
God, I do

I feel the kindness coming through

But somewhere underneath the flame
The hole still knows my name

[Instrumental Break: piano melody, restrained guitar swells]

[Bridge: drums drop out]

Maybe I’m a house with open doors
Giving shelter from the storm

Maybe everybody leaves a flower
But the basement stays unborn

Maybe kindness isn’t meant to fix me
Maybe love is not repair

Maybe some things don’t stop hurting
Just because somebody cares

[Pause]

And maybe that can still be beautiful

[Strings rise]

Maybe meaning isn’t cure

Maybe being held inside the darkness
Still matters when the dark endures

[Final Chorus: huge, emotional]

SO THE HOLE STILL KNOWS MY NAME
AND THE ROOM IS STILL FULL OF LOVE

Someone takes my shaking hand
And somehow that is still enough

Not enough to make me whole
Not enough to fill the space

But enough to make me want to stay
And put some kindness in its place

[Choir]
Give it away
Let it return

[Lead]
Even if some corners never learn

[Choir]
Give it away
Let it remain

[Lead]
Love does not have to erase the pain

[Final Refrain: instruments pull back]

The hole still knows my name

But so do you

[Soft backing vocals]
So do you
So do you

[Lead]
And tonight

Maybe that’s enough
To get me through

[Outro: piano only]

I like the way a kindness lands
So lightly in another’s hands

[Long pause]

Maybe tomorrow
I’ll give another one

[Final unresolved piano chord]

title: Paper And Paint
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I lay my trouble down
On paper by the sink
Black ink on a blue-lined page
Helps me finally think

I cut the noise in half
With scissors, glue, and thread
A small clean room inside
Where my storm can't stay for long

[Pre-Chorus]
When my hands get busy
My chest unties
The mess gets shape
The ache gets light

[Chorus]
Paint my heart calm
Paint my heart calm
I can breathe again
When I make something

Paint my heart calm
Paint my heart calm
(oh-oh)
I come back to me
When I make something

[Verse 2]
I shape the clay by hand
Till the edges learn my name
A crooked little bowl
Still holds the same rain

I strum a broken chord
Until it turns to gold
Each honest little line
Keeps the dark from taking hold

[Pre-Chorus]
When my hands get busy
My chest unties
The mess gets shape
The ache gets light

[Chorus]
Paint my heart calm
Paint my heart calm
I can breathe again
When I make something

Paint my heart calm
Paint my heart calm
(oh-oh)
I come back to me
When I make something

[Bridge]
So let me sew the split
Let me carve the ache
Let me turn my fear
Into a thing I can make

No perfect masterpiece
Just a place to rest
A little flame in me
I can keep when I confess

[Final Chorus]
Paint my heart calm
Paint my heart calm
I can breathe again
When I make something

Paint my heart calm
Paint my heart calm
(oh-oh)
I come back to me
When I make something

title: Hands Full Empty
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Room full of faces, mine feels small
You say my name, I hear it all
Hands on my shoulders, kind and near
Still there's a quiet I keep right here

Laughing around me, warm and loud
I stand in the middle of the crowd
Every smile lands, every voice is real
But nothing quite reaches the way I feel

[Pre-Chorus]
I got a hundred reasons
To be grateful tonight
Still the dark in me
Won't open up to light
I keep on trying
To let it in
But when the door shuts
I'm alone again

[Chorus]
Hands full, empty
Held, but empty
So much love here
Still I feel empty
Say my name, stay close
Don't let go, don't let go
Hands full, empty
I need more than I show (more than I show)

[Verse 2]
Tea gone cold on the table edge
Text after text, but I don't reply yet
Everybody knows how to make me smile
Nobody sees me fading for a while

I wear my good face, wear it well
But I know the shape of my own shell
If love is a river, I'm standing near
Water all around me, still can't drink here

[Pre-Chorus]
I got a hundred reasons
To be grateful tonight
Still the dark in me
Won't open up to light
I keep on trying
To let it in
But when the door shuts
I'm alone again

[Chorus]
Hands full, empty
Held, but empty
So much love here
Still I feel empty
Say my name, stay close
Don't let go, don't let go
Hands full, empty
I need more than I show (more than I show)

[Bridge]
Maybe I don't need fixing
Maybe I need to be seen
Not as the one who's fine
But the one in between
Let me lean for a second
Let me not pretend
Love can fill the room
And still not reach my skin

[Chorus]
Hands full, empty
Held, but empty
So much love here
Still I feel empty
Say my name, stay close
Don't let go, don't let go
Hands full, empty
I need more than I show (more than I show)

title: Cracked Lunch Tray
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned to smile on cue
When the room went cold
Kept my hands in my sleeves
Kept my stories old

Names stuck like gum
On the bottom of my shoe
I was ten years deep
In a bruise they never knew

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I flinch at a laugh
That sounds too sharp
I build little walls
In the shape of my heart

But I see it now
What they left behind
Not a flaw in my soul
Just a wound in time

[Chorus]
I am not broken
I am becoming
I am not broken
I’m just unlearning

All those holes they cut
They do not own me
I am not broken
I am becoming

[Verse 2]
I say “it’s fine” too fast
Then I hide for days
I overread the room
Like it owes me a way

I people-please, then disappear
Leave the door half-closed
I joke before I trust
That’s the armor I was sold

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I flinch at a laugh
That sounds too sharp
I build little walls
In the shape of my heart

But I see it now
What they left behind
Not a flaw in my soul
Just a wound in time

[Chorus]
I am not broken
I am becoming
I am not broken
I’m just unlearning

All those holes they cut
They do not own me
I am not broken
I am becoming

[Bridge]
If I go quiet, stay
I’m still in the room
If I pull away, it’s fear
Not the truth

I’m gathering up the parts
They tried to erase
Little by little now
I give myself a name

[Final Chorus]
I am not broken
I am becoming
I am not broken
I’m just unlearning

All those holes they cut
They do not own me
I am not broken
I am becoming

I am not broken
I am becoming
(coming back, coming back)
I am not broken
I’m finally home in me

title: Burn the Maps
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I watched the days go by
Like coins through a hole
Kept every dream on hold
Telling myself, "later"

But the mirror kept the score
On the lines I wore
Said if I wanted more
I'd have to reach for it

[Pre-Chorus]
So I sold my easy life
For a shot at something real
Took the long way home
To find what I can feel

[Chorus]
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
To know I really tried
(Really tried)
If it takes all I have
I’m still standing here
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive

[Verse 2]
I lost some friends to time
Lost sleep, lost pride
Had to let some old truths die
On the floor behind me

Every road had thorns
Every win had scars
Still I kept my hands on the wheel
And my eyes on what’s in me

[Pre-Chorus]
No, I won’t stay small
Just to make it through the night
I’d rather burn my plans
Than never touch the light

[Chorus]
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
To know I really tried
(Really tried)
If it takes all I have
I’m still standing here
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive

[Bridge]
Let it hurt
Let it change me
Let the empty days
Go break me open

I was made
For the reaching
Not for folding up
At the first hard moment

[Final Chorus]
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
I’ll pay the price
I’ll pay the price
To know I really tried
(Really tried)
If it takes all I have
I’m still standing here
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive
(Feels alive)
I’ll pay the price
For a life that feels alive

title: Listening Late
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I heard your words
Then let them pass
A nod, a smile
And nothing back
You kept the door
I kept the air
You were right there
And I was nowhere

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the silence
Hits like rain
I replay
Your name again

[Chorus]
I wish I listened
I wish I stayed
I wish I called you
Before the days ran late
I wish I listened
To what you gave
You held me steady
And I drifted away
(I drifted away)

[Verse 2]
Your texts came in
Like steady rain
I saved them all
Then missed the lane
You asked me how
I said "I'm good"
When you needed me
I should've stood

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the silence
Hits like rain
I replay
Your name again

[Chorus]
I wish I listened
I wish I stayed
I wish I called you
Before the days ran late
I wish I listened
To what you gave
You held me steady
And I drifted away
(I drifted away)

[Bridge]
If I could turn
One mile back
I'd answer sooner
I'd hold your hand
I'd make the time
I'd do it right
I'd be the friend
I was that night

[Final Chorus]
I wish I listened
I wish I stayed
I wish I called you
Before the days ran late
I wish I listened
To what you gave
You held me steady
And I drifted away
I drifted away
(I drifted away)

title: Could Have Been Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I missed the signs you sent
Left them on the table
Said I had time to change
Like time was mine to keep

I fed the easy lie
Told myself “tomorrow”
Now I count the doors I closed
And all the keys I kept

[Pre-Chorus]
If I had turned around
If I had stayed awake
If I had said the truth
Before it was too late

[Chorus]
I could have been better
I could have been more
(too late, too late)
I could have been better
Right down to the core
(too late, too late)

And now I hold the ghost
Of who I thought I'd be
I could have been better
I could have been me

[Verse 2]
I wore the same old hurt
Like it was protection
Kept my hands in my pockets
Kept my heart in chains

You asked me for my best
I gave you my excuses
Now the room feels full of me
And none of it's the same

[Pre-Chorus]
If I had faced the mirror
If I had said my name
If I had done the hard thing
Before it turned to shame

[Chorus]
I could have been better
I could have been more
(too late, too late)
I could have been better
Right down to the core
(too late, too late)

And now I hold the ghost
Of who I thought I'd be
I could have been better
I could have been me

[Bridge]
What if I was brave
When it still was small?
What if I could forgive
The boy behind it all?

I still hear that version
Knocking at my door
Not asking for perfection
Just to try once more

[Final Chorus]
I could have been better
I could have been more
(too late, too late)
I could have been better
Right down to the core
(too late, too late)

And if I can't go back
I'll still begin with me
I could have been better
But I can still be free

title: Open Hands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to grip so tight
Till my knuckles turned white
Chasing every loose thread
In the dark of my mind

I kept score in the rain
Counted salt in my pain
But the wound did not move
When I pulled it in vain

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you came like a slow tide
Said, "You don't have to fight"
All that broken glass
Turns soft in the right light

[Chorus]
Open hands
Let it stay
Open hands
I am safe

I can bend
I can breathe
Open hands
Carry me

[Verse 2]
Now I leave room for grace
On the edge of each day
If the plan falls apart
I still find my way

There is peace in the ache
There is hush in the break
When I stop making war
With the shape that I take

[Pre-Chorus]
Then the fear loosens up
Like a knot in the rain
What I lost in the storm
Comes back as calm again

[Chorus]
Open hands
Let it stay
Open hands
I am safe

I can bend
I can breathe
Open hands
Carry me

[Bridge]
I was not built to hold
Every weight, every name
Some things bloom when released
Some things heal when untamed

So I lay it all down
Let the river receive
What I cannot control
Is still enough for me

[Chorus]
Open hands
Let it stay
Open hands
I am safe

I can bend
I can breathe
Open hands
Carry me

title: THE UNIVERSE WON’T MIND
lyrics:
[Intro: jaunty piano]

[Spoken]
Ladies and gentlemen…

I have terrible news.

[Pause]

None of us are getting out of this alive.

[Bright brass hit]

So shall we dance?

[Verse 1: bouncing piano and bass]

I spent a Tuesday worrying
About a Thursday afternoon
I made a list of future catastrophes
And alphabetized them by noon

I checked the mirror for significance
I checked my pulse for fate
Then missed the bus while wondering
If existence could be late

[Backing Vocals]
Tick-tock!
Think-think!
Very impressive!

[Lead]
I had the weight of all creation
Balanced neatly on my head

Then a pigeon stole my sandwich

[Pause]

And the universe continued anyway

[Pre-Chorus]

So loosen up the necktie
Kick the prophecy downstairs
Half the things you’re frightened of
Haven’t even happened anywhere

And if tomorrow brings disaster

[Backing Vocal]
What then?

[Lead]
We’ll complain about it when it’s there

[Chorus: huge singalong]

DON’T TAKE IT SO SERIOUSLY
THE UNIVERSE WON’T MIND

You’re a temporary miracle
With extraordinarily limited time

Dance badly in the kitchen
Wear the trousers you adore

Nobody at the end will say

[Backing Choir]
“HE SHOULD HAVE WORRIED MORE!”

[Lead]
Laugh too loudly
Love too much
Order something strange tonight

Don’t take it so seriously

[Choir]
You’ll never get out alive!

[Verse 2: guitar joins, playful groove]

There was a banker at the seaside
Trying to optimize the sand
He had quarterly projections
And a clipboard in his hand

He shouted at the ocean
“You’re exceeding our forecast!”

The ocean gave no comment

[Splash sound]

And removed his shoes quite fast

[Backing Vocals]
Terrible management!
No respect for shareholders!

[Lead]
Meanwhile children built a kingdom
That survived eleven minutes

And they seemed considerably happier
Than the gentleman who audited it

[Pre-Chorus]

You can measure every heartbeat
You can schedule every kiss
But life has an amusing habit
Of refusing spreadsheets like this

[Music stop]

[Lead]
There will always be a typo

[Backing Vocal]
Somewhere.

[Lead]
In the grand synopsis

[Chorus]

DON’T TAKE IT SO SERIOUSLY
THE UNIVERSE WON’T MIND

You’re a temporary miracle
With extraordinarily limited time

Sing loudly in the shower
Take the scenic route once more

Nobody at the end will say

[Choir]
“HE SHOULD HAVE WORRIED MORE!”

[Lead]
Lose the argument
Keep the friend
Let the stupid joke survive

Don’t take it so seriously

[Choir]
You’ll never get out alive!

[Instrumental Break: absurdly cheerful saxophone solo]

[Backing Vocals]
Ba-da-ba!
Ba-da-ba!
Existential crisis!

[Saxophone flourish]

[Spoken]
Very tasteful.

[Bridge: music becomes dreamy, slower]

One day your name will be a story
One day your house belongs to rain
One day all your grand embarrassments
Will inconvenience no one again

The stars will never mention
That you stumbled through a speech

Mars won’t file a memorandum
Because you wore two different socks last week

[String swell]

So perhaps the great objective
Is considerably less grand

Maybe life is mostly learning
When to hold…

And when to let go of the plan

[Drums build]

[Lead]
And occasionally—

[Choir]
Order dessert!

[Final Chorus: key change]

DON’T TAKE IT SO SERIOUSLY
THE UNIVERSE WON’T MIND

You’re a glorious little accident
On borrowed cosmic time

Call your mother
Kiss your lover
Take your shoes off on the floor

Nobody at the end will say

[Massive Choir]
“THEY SHOULD HAVE WORRIED MORE!”

[Lead]
Make mistakes
Change your mind
Take the long way when you drive

Don’t take it so seriously

You’ll never get out—

[Music cuts]

[Spoken]
Well…

Technically.

[Full band explosion]

[Choir]
ALIVE!

[Outro: piano and handclaps]

[Lead]
The planets keep on spinning

[Backing Vocals]
Spin, spin, spin!

[Lead]
Whether you’re prepared or not

You get one astonishing ticket

So enjoy the bloody plot

[Slowing piano]

And when you catch yourself believing
Every problem is divine

Just remember—

[Whispered Choir]
The universe won’t mind.

[Final piano flourish]

[Spoken]
Dessert?

[End]

title: ROSE BY ANY OTHER NAME
lyrics:
[Intro: grand piano flourish]

[Spoken, playfully]
Ladies, gentlemen…

[Backing Vocal]
And everybody magnificent in between!

[Guitar sting]

[Verse 1: jaunty piano, sly vocal]

I met a rose in a railway bar
Wearing moonlight like a movie star
She said, “Darling, don’t inspect the seed
Just tell me if you like the flower you see”

Well, I nearly spilled my little glass
She laughed and let the moment pass
Said, “History’s such an awful bore
Are you courting me or keeping score?”

[Piano run]

I said—

[Backing Vocals]
Ooooh!

[Lead]
Why would I interrogate the dawn
About what color night it started from?

[Pre-Chorus: drums enter]

The moon has worn a thousand faces
The sea has changed a thousand places
But darling, when you take my arm

[Backing Vocal]
Alarm! Alarm!

[Lead, laughing]
That’s the only transformation causing harm

[Chorus: enormous harmonies]

A ROSE IS A ROSE WHEN IT’S KISSING MY CHEEK
A STAR IS A STAR WHETHER BOLD OR UNIQUE

You can tell me about yesterday
If yesterday insists

But I’m rather more concerned, my love

[Pause]

With the architecture of your kiss

[Backing Choir]
Kiss! Kiss! Kiss!

[Lead]
Call it fate
Call it flair
Call it cosmic underwear

[Guitar flourish]

Whatever road brought you here tonight
Darling, you arrived just right

[Verse 2: bouncing bass, cabaret feel]

There was a tailor on Mercury Street
Who swore every soul had matching feet
He measured everybody heel to toe
Then fainted when the universe said “No”

[Saxophone squeal]

So I bought myself a crooked shoe
Painted one red and the other blue
And danced with you beneath the sign:

“NO REFUNDS ON THE GRAND DESIGN”

[Backing Vocals, theatrical]
Oh, scandal!
Oh, horror!
Oh, somebody fetch the mayor!

[Lead]
Tell him love has rearranged the furniture
And frankly I don’t care

[Pre-Chorus]

The butterfly won’t show its files
The comet doesn’t justify its miles
And nobody asks the champagne grape

[Whispered Backing Vocal]
What were you before?

[Lead]
Before they celebrate

[Chorus]

A ROSE IS A ROSE WHEN IT’S KISSING MY CHEEK
A STAR IS A STAR WHETHER BOLD OR UNIQUE

You can tell me about yesterday
If yesterday insists

But I’m rather more concerned, my love
With the architecture of your kiss

[Operatic Backing Vocals]
Blueprint!
Lipstick!
Mystery!
Bliss!

[Lead]
I’ve never fallen for a birth certificate

[Guitar hit]

But I have fallen hard for this

[Instrumental Break: piano and guitar trading increasingly ridiculous flourishes]

[Piano solo]

[Guitar answer]

[Piano faster]

[Guitar faster]

[Saxophone barges in]

[Spoken]
Oh, now you’re just showing off.

[Bridge: slow, dreamy, celestial synths]

Suppose the stars could change their names
Would heaven burn with lesser flames?

Suppose the river changed its course
Would anybody sue the source?

Suppose a caterpillar said
“I’ve reconsidered wings instead”

Would you stand beneath the summer sky
And shout—

[Backing Choir, pompously]
“EXPLAIN YOURSELF, BUTTERFLY!”

[Silence]

[Lead, softly]
I wouldn’t.

[String swell]

I’d watch her fly.

[Huge drum entrance]

[Verse 3: triumphant]

So wear the dress
Or wear the suit
Wear the crown
Or wear the boots

Change the key
Rewrite the part
The orchestra still knows the heart

[Backing Vocals]
Ba-da-da-da!

[Lead]
Yesterday can keep its photographs
I’ve got tonight and all your laughs

And if the world demands a chart

[Backing Choir]
A chart!

[Lead]
I’ll draw one arrow to my heart

[Final Chorus: key change, massive choir]

A ROSE IS A ROSE WHEN IT’S KISSING MY CHEEK
A STAR IS A STAR WHETHER GENTLE OR FREAK

Let the historians argue
Let philosophers insist

I’m conducting my research, darling

[Pause]

On the architecture of your kiss

[Choir]
THE ARCHITECTURE!

[Lead]
Columns of laughter

[Choir]
THE ARCHITECTURE!

[Lead]
Windows of bliss

[Choir]
THE ARCHITECTURE!

[Lead]
An unnecessarily elaborate staircase—

[Music stops]

Leading directly…

To this.

[Kiss sound]

[Explosive guitar chord]

[Final Refrain]

You can change the costume
You can change the scene
You can change the name upon the old marquee

But when the spotlight finds you
Standing next to me

[Choir rising]
Who you are
Who you are
Who you are

[Lead]
Is the woman that I see

[Outro: slowing piano, layered vocals]

Rose by any other name

[Backing Vocals]
Still a rose

[Lead]
Star by any other sky

[Backing Vocals]
Still it glows

[Lead]
Love by any winding road

[Soft Choir]
Still arrives…

[Final whispered vocal]
And darling…

You look marvelous.

[Grand piano crash]

[End]

title: THE PEOPLE NEXT DOOR
lyrics:
[Intro: lonely piano, faint analog synth, distant street noise]

[Verse 1: intimate, conversational]

There’s a woman at the window
Counting headlights in the rain
There’s a man across the hallway
Who has learned to hide his name

There are whispers in the papers
There are faces on the screen
Someone says the town is changing
Someone says what that must mean

And the people at the podium
With their fingers in the air
Say the danger’s getting closer

[Pause]

So we’d better learn to stare

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, tension rising]

At the stranger on the corner
At the family down the street
At the voice that sounds unusual
At the person that we meet

While the hands behind the curtain
Keep repeating something old

[Backing Vocals, whispered]
Be afraid
Be afraid
Be afraid

[Lead]
Fear is easier to govern
Than a people uncontrolled

[Chorus: full band, dramatic strings]

They want us frightened of the people next door
So we never see the people upstairs

They give us enemies to watch on the floor
While they quietly move all the chairs

Keep us angry
Keep us small
Give us somebody else to blame it all upon

If everybody fears everybody
Nobody notices who has the power

[Instrumental Turn: glam guitar riff, saxophone answer]

[Verse 2]

There’s a camera in the station
There’s a slogan on the wall
There’s a man who promises safety
If we only give him all

All the questions
All the borders
All the names he needs to know

Who is loyal
Who is dangerous
Who is welcome
Who must go

And the crowd begins applauding
Because terror makes a sound
Like a thousand frightened heartbeats
When authority comes round

[Pre-Chorus]

First they tell you who to worry about
Then they tell you where to stand
Then they tell you every sacrifice
Is part of some great plan

[Backing Vocals]
For your safety
For your safety

[Lead Vocal, bitterly]
Such a beautiful command

[Chorus]

They want us frightened of the people next door
So we never see the people upstairs

They give us enemies to watch on the floor
While they quietly move all the chairs

Keep us angry
Keep us small
Give us somebody else to blame it all upon

If everybody fears everybody
Nobody notices who has the power

[Bridge: music drops to piano and low synth drone]

[Spoken-Sung]

Fear has excellent manners

It knocks before it enters

It says it only needs the hallway
Then the kitchen
Then your bedroom
Then your name

[Orchestral swell]

And every frightened generation
Swears this time is not the same

[Drums enter, slow and massive]

They say:

Your neighbor wants your future

Your neighbor wants your bread

Your neighbor wants your children

Your neighbor wants you dead

[Choir, increasingly chaotic]
Them
Them
Them
Them

[Lead Vocal]
And somewhere in a quiet room

Someone counts the votes instead

[Instrumental Break: distorted guitar, saxophone, dissonant piano]

[Verse 3: more hopeful, restrained]

But I spoke with the man beside me
And he wasn’t what they said

He worries about his daughter
He has trouble getting ahead

And the woman they called dangerous
Makes coffee before dawn

She laughs exactly like my mother
When her favorite song comes on

Maybe that is why they warn us
Never look each other in the eyes

Because fear survives on distance
And power survives on lies

[Pre-Chorus: music brightens]

So come out onto the pavement
Leave the curtains open wide

There are millions we were taught to fear

[Pause]

Who were frightened on the other side

[Final Chorus: huge, soaring, layered vocals]

DON’T BE FRIGHTENED OF THE PEOPLE NEXT DOOR
LOOK A LITTLE HIGHER UP THE STAIRS

DON’T TAKE THE ENEMY THEY HAND YOU ANYMORE
ASK WHO PROFITS WHEN EVERYBODY’S SCARED

Keep us talking
Keep us close
Make it harder to divide us into ghosts

If everybody knows somebody
It gets much harder to manufacture monsters

[Choir]
Much harder
Much harder

[Lead]
To manufacture monsters

[Final refrain: key change]

They need a border inside your mind
They need a villain you can find
They need your neighbor turned into a sign

So you never ask

[Music cuts]

Who drew the line?

[Outro: piano, saxophone, distant choir]

[Soft Vocal]

There’s a woman at the window
There’s a man across the hall

Maybe neither one was dangerous

Maybe fear…

[Pause]

Was dangerous to us all

[Final piano chord]

title: FREE ENOUGH TO LOVE
lyrics:
[Intro: quiet piano, distant heartbeat percussion]

Everybody wants a better world

The trouble starts

When we decide everybody else
Has to build it our way

[Verse 1]

I believe you own your conscience
I believe you own your name

I believe your life belongs to you
Not some politician’s claim

You can pray or you can question
You can wander, you can stay

You can build a different future
Than the one I’d choose today

I don’t have to understand you
To defend your right to be

Because freedom isn’t freedom
If it only looks like me

[Beat enters]

And I’ve heard a thousand speeches
About enemies and sides

But fear has built more prisons
Than compassion ever tried

[Pre-Chorus]

So before we write another law
To make the whole world right

Maybe we should learn
To live beside each other first tonight

[Chorus]

I want a world free enough to love

Free enough to disagree

Free enough to build a life
You never have to justify to me

Let people move
Let people speak

Let people trade
Let people dream

And when we’re scared of one another
Let’s not hand somebody power in between

I want liberty with open arms

Not another iron glove

I want a world that needs less force

Because we’re free enough to love

[Verse 2]

Every ban begins with someone
Saying, “This will keep you safe”

Then demand goes underground
And danger gladly takes its place

Build a wall around a problem
Watch the problem find a door

You can outlaw every symptom
Without knowing what it’s for

And a thousand miles from Washington
Someone knows what they require

Better than a room of strangers
Drawing maps beside a fire

Prices carry little messages
No ministry can see

Millions making tiny choices

That become an economy

[Pre-Chorus]

No one holds the whole equation

No one sees the whole terrain

So I’m careful with the people
Who say they should run the game

[Chorus]

I want a world free enough to love

Free enough to disagree

Free enough to build a life
You never have to justify to me

Let people move
Let people speak

Let people trade
Let people dream

And when we’re scared of one another
Let’s not hand somebody power in between

I want liberty with open arms

Not another iron glove

I want a world that needs less force

Because we’re free enough to love

[Bridge: beat drops, intimate vocal]

But freedom isn’t isolation

And compassion isn’t law

There are people who need neighbors
When their whole damn world has fallen off

There are children who need mentors

There are strangers who need hands

There are problems no amendment
Ever taught us how to understand

Community is not coercion

Kindness doesn’t need command

You can catch somebody falling
Without chaining where they stand

[Build]

Maybe if we knew each other

Maybe if we broke some bread

Maybe fewer frightened people
Would demand more walls instead

Maybe every act of mercy

Every friendship across lines

Makes another little argument

For leaving force behind

[Verse 3: stronger beat]

Let the immigrant seek tomorrow

Let the worker name their price

Let the builder build more houses

Let the dreamer roll the dice

Let the speaker say what bothers you

Then answer with your own

Let consenting people make a life

The state does not need to own

And when somebody causes damage

Liberty still has a line

Your freedom ends where you can force
The cost of yours onto mine

No kings
No saints
No perfect plans

No party gets my soul

Just people making choices

And accepting what they owe

[Breakdown]

Left says
“Give us power
We will use it for the good”

Right says
“Give us power
We will use it like we should”

I’ve read enough of history

To know how that one goes

Power always finds a reason

Why it cannot let you go

[Beat returns]

So no

I’m not asking for a ruler
Who agrees with me today

Because tomorrow someone different
Gets the very same machinery

I would rather build a culture

Where we rarely need the key

Than spend every generation

Fighting who controls captivity

[Final Chorus: huge]

I want a world free enough to love!

Free enough to disagree!

Where your life is yours
And mine is mine

And both can still meet peacefully

Let people move!

Let people speak!

Let people trade!

Let people dream!

Build a thousand different futures

Let no one demand they all agree

[Choir]

FREE ENOUGH TO LOVE!

[Lead]

Give me pluralism over purity

Forgiveness over spite

Give me neighbors who can argue

Then still share a drink at night

Give me markets
Give me charity

Give me families
Give me friends

Give me every voluntary way

That human beings make amends

[Key Change]

Because the smallest government

Starts somewhere deeper than a vote

It starts when fear no longer has

Its fingers wrapped around our throats

When disagreement isn’t hatred

When difference isn’t war

When helping someone doesn’t mean

We have to own them anymore

[Final Build]

I want liberty

Not loneliness

Responsibility

Not control

Individual lives

In communities

title: MY NAME IS ALEX
lyrics:
[Intro: sparse beat, piano, distant crowd noise]

My name is Alex

I’ve been a few things

Probably gonna be a few more

[Beat drops]

[Verse 1]

Born with a question
Been chasing it since
How does the world work?
How do we make sense?

From a kid making games
With a screen and a dream
To the radio booth
Learning how to build a scene

Marketing, music
New York nights
Teaching people money
Trying to get the numbers right

Politics taught me
Everybody sees
A different kind of future
From a different set of needs

Then I found code
And the whole thing clicked

You can imagine a world

Then build that shit

[Pre-Chorus]

I never had one lane
Never wanted one role

Every new obsession
Put another window in my soul

So when somebody asks me
“What exactly do you do?”

I laugh

Books on the shelf

Open tables

Parquet in the files
Arrow moving fast

Building systems meant to last

I’ve stood on the stage

Dremio on the badge
Developer Relations

[Chorus]

My name is Alex

I write
I build
I teach
I speak

Books on the shelf
Code on the screen

Stories and songs

Scroll down

[Verse 3: warmer, more melodic]

I write about machines

Write about intelligence
Then question how we use it

Economics
Philosophy
Fiction after two

Sometimes the best way to find yourself
Is making something new

I make music because logic
Cannot say everything

Some thoughts need a paragraph

Some need strings

Some need distorted guitars
Some need rhyme

Some questions need a lifetime

[Build]

I’ve changed careers
Changed cities
Changed my mind

Left old versions of myself
A couple exits behind

But I don’t see contradiction
When I look across the years

I see curiosity

Refusing to disappear

[Beat intensifies]

[Verse 4]

Sixty-five books
And I’m still taking notes

Still filling little documents
With unfinished quotes

Still opening repositories
Just to see what I can make

Still convinced a crazy idea
Is sometimes worth the chase

Pangolin
Iceframe
Tools nobody asked for

Sometimes building the doorway
Comes before the demand for the door

AI agents
Graphs
Open specifications

I like taking scattered pieces
And finding their relations

Maybe that’s the thread
Running through the whole career

Take something complicated

Make the picture clear

[Pre-Chorus]

And no
I don’t know where it ends

That might be my favorite part

You don’t need the whole map

When curiosity can start

[Final Chorus: huge]

My name is Alex

I write
I build
I teach
I speak

And I’m still getting excited
Every seven days a week

Books on the shelf
Code on the screen

Trying to make tomorrow
A little more open than it’s been

Data and agents
Stories and songs

My name is Alex

[Break]

Technology empowers

[Group vocals]
EMPOWERS!

Creativity liberates

[Group vocals]

And optimism says

So give me another problem

Build it

Break it

Learn

Teach it

Share it

[Final Chorus: choir]

MY NAME IS ALEX!

I write!
I build!
I teach!
I speak!

I’ll probably find another thing
By the end of the week!

[Choir]

WRITE IT!
BUILD IT!

title: Fork in the Road
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I got two boots
on different lines
One says stay low
one says go climb

My bag is packed
my keys are cold
I keep one hand
on what I know

[Pre-Chorus]
Tell me which door
has my name
Which little turn
won't break my frame

I keep looking
for a sign

splits in time

[Chorus]
Which way now
which way now
I stand at the fork
and I don't know how

Which way now
which way now

will I still come out?

[Verse 2]
Mom says be safe
Dad says be bold

at different roads

one fit the blues

to trust tonight

which way now

which way now

one straight line

title: Wide Awake Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The fan makes circles on the wall
My sheets are tangled in the hall
I flip my pillow, count the cracks
Your name keeps coming right back
The glass is cold against my hand
I watch the water in the pan

[Pre-Chorus]
I close my eyes, but nothing lands
The dark just stays a step away
My pulse is tapping in my throat
Like it knows something I can’t say

[Chorus]
Wide awake again
Wide awake again
I keep turning and turning
Wide awake again
Wide awake again
Till the morning starts burning

[Verse 2]
The clock keeps chewing every minute
My room feels bigger when I’m in it
One shirt on the chair, half-lit, still
A phone face-down, a windowsill
I try to breathe, I try to stay
But every thought pulls me away

[Pre-Chorus]
I close my eyes, but nothing lands
The dark just stays a step away
My pulse is tapping in my throat
Like it knows something I can’t say

[Chorus]
Wide awake again
Wide awake again
I keep turning and turning
Wide awake again
Wide awake again
Till the morning starts burning

[Bridge]
Maybe I’m haunted by your goodbye
Maybe I’m just too tired to cry
If I could trade this restless skin
I’d let the night let me in

[Chorus]
Wide awake again
Wide awake again
I keep turning and turning
Wide awake again
Wide awake again
Till the morning starts burning

title: King of the Table
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learn the rules in five
Then I read them twice
You set out the tiles
I’m already rolling dice

I smile like I’m nice
While I steal your best route
You say it’s just a game
I say that’s what it’s about

I count your little hands
I watch your face go red
You reach for one more card
I’ve got three moves ahead

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t tell me take it easy
Don’t say it’s just for fun
I can hear the victory
Loading in my tongue

[Chorus]
I gotta win, gotta win
I can’t sit still
I take the crown, take the crown
I always will
I want the last little laugh
When the timer’s done
I gotta win, gotta win
I’m no. one

[Verse 2]
You drew the lucky card
I drew a better plan
You built a tiny bridge
I burned it with my hand

I hoard the little points
Like gold in a tin
If there’s a shortcut near me
I’m taking it again

I keep the score in my head
Even when we’re through
At dinner I remember
That you owed me two

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t tell me to relax
Don’t say it isn’t deep
My face stays sweet and calm
My ego’s in the lead

[Chorus]
I gotta win, gotta win
I can’t sit still
I take the crown, take the crown
I always will
I want the last little laugh
When the timer’s done
I gotta win, gotta win
I’m no. one

[Bridge]
I swear I’m not a villain
I just hate to lose
If the box is on the table
I will not choose

I’m kind in every other way
I help you with your coat
But put a game in front of me
And I’m sharpening my vote

[Final Chorus]
I gotta win, gotta win
I can’t sit still
I take the crown, take the crown
I always will
I want the last little laugh
When the timer’s done
I gotta win, gotta win
I’m no. one

I gotta win, gotta win
That’s my fevered prayer
You can keep the afterparty
I’ll be over there

title: Pixel Dust Memory
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I blow on the cart like a charm
Dust in the tray, cold in my palm
Red light blinked like a dare
Little green screen, I was there

Thumb on the button, eyes wide
Mom called once from the hall outside
I said, “one more,” then five more times
Lost in the world of blocky lines

[Pre-Chorus]
Back then, it felt so huge
A tiny room, a giant mood
One life left and I still ran
Straight through the same old land

[Chorus]
Take me back, take me back
To the glow in the black
Press start, then I’m gone
I was young, I was on

Take me back, take me back
To the sound of the crack
One more try, one more life
I still feel that thrill tonight

[Verse 2]
Cartridge squeal and a taped-up cord
Saved my name on a worn-out board
Fingers moved before I knew
Every fail made the next one new

That blue sky, that boss fight face
That shaky win, that tiny grace
I wore my time in 8-bit frames
And every loss still knew my name

[Pre-Chorus]
Back then, it felt so huge
A tiny room, a giant mood
One life left and I still ran
Straight through the same old land

[Chorus]
Take me back, take me back
To the glow in the black
Press start, then I’m gone
I was young, I was on

Take me back, take me back
To the sound of the crack
One more try, one more life
I still feel that thrill tonight

[Bridge]
Now the box is on a shelf
But I can’t quite help myself
When that title screen comes through
I’m twelve years old and aiming true

[Final Chorus]
Take me back, take me back
To the glow in the black
Press start, then I’m gone
I was young, I was on

Take me back, take me back
To the sound of the crack
One more try, one more life
I still feel that thrill tonight

title: OPEN THE STACK
lyrics:
OPEN THE STACK

[Intro: distant modular synth pulse, machine hum, sparse piano notes]

[Whispered Vocoder]
Not a suite.

[Pause]

A stack.

[Low sub-bass enters]

Not one model.
Not one cloud.
Not one hand upon the switch.

[Digital riser]

Open the stack.

[Verse 1: restrained vocal, tight electronic drums]

Give the agent something real to know
Not another prompt that comes and goes
Facts with roots and meaning underneath
Memory built on something we can keep

Arrow moving through the memory
Parquet holding history
Iceberg gives the tables time
Polaris draws the governance line

[Background Vocals: whispered, alternating channels]
Ground it
Name it
Share it
Own it

[Pre-Chorus: drums building, guitars slowly entering]

Before the model starts to speak
Before the agent starts to reach
Give intelligence a place to stand
Open data underneath its hands

[Chorus: huge drums, wide guitars, stacked vocals]

OPEN THE STACK
LET THE AGENTS RUN

Open foundations
Choice for everyone

SWAP OUT THE MODEL
KEEP THE WORK ALIVE

No single vendor
Gets to own the mind

[Choir]
Replaceable
Inspectable
Portable by design

[Lead Vocal]
Open components
Explicit lines

[All Vocals]
OWN THE ARCHITECTURE
KEEP THE OPTIONS ALIVE

[Post-Chorus: synth hook]

Open!
Open!
Open the stack!

[Glitch Vocal]
Stack, stack, stack, stack

[Verse 2: bass-driven, quicker vocal cadence]

Now intelligence enters the frame
Choose the engine for the game
Big or small, remote or near
Route by price, by task, by tier

Open weights when we need control
Provider APIs when they fit the role
Local models at the edge
Routers standing at the ledge

No sacred model
No golden cage
Tomorrow’s winner
Can replace today’s

[Pre-Chorus: rising tension]

Capability will always change
The architecture should remain
Models come and models go
Keep the contract, change the flow

[Chorus: larger than first]

OPEN THE STACK
LET THE AGENTS RUN

Open foundations
Choice for everyone

SWAP OUT THE MODEL
KEEP THE WORK ALIVE

No single vendor
Gets to own the mind

[Choir]
Replaceable
Inspectable
Portable by design

[Lead Vocal]
Open components
Explicit lines

[All Vocals]
OWN THE ARCHITECTURE
KEEP THE OPTIONS ALIVE

[Instrumental Break: distorted synth solo trading phrases with electric guitar]

[Drum fill]

[Verse 3: aggressive rhythm, almost half-rapped]

Intent needs execution
Execution needs a frame
Something has to hold the tools
Something has to run the game

OpenCode at the terminal
Pi can take another road
MagAgent builds
Loro governs
Hermes carries down the load

Brokers route the work between them
Harnesses can come and leave
The runtime is replaceable
That is how the system breathes

[Backing Vocals]
Swap it!
Move it!
Fork it!
Prove it!

[Break: instruments abruptly cut]

[Spoken Vocal over heartbeat kick]

The agent is not the harness.

The harness is not the model.

The model is not the platform.

[Long pause]

The platform…

[Sub drop]

…is the contract between them.

[Build: snare rolls, synth arpeggio accelerates]

[Verse 4: bright, urgent delivery]

Skills should travel with the worker
Tools should speak a common tongue
Context shouldn’t die imprisoned
When another runtime comes

M-C-P connects the capability
Agent Skills package what we know
O-A-P can hold identity
So the agent has somewhere to go

A-G-S maps the graph of action
Nodes and edges, work in flight
A-A-I-S keeps human judgment
At the boundaries of machine might

[Choir, rhythmic]
Skills!
Context!
Profiles!
Graphs!

Tools!
Approvals!
Open paths!

[Pre-Chorus: half-time, cinematic]

Can I move it?

YES.

Can I see it?

YES.

Can I bound what it can do?

YES.

Can I trace the path it followed
When the answer passes through?

[Silence]

YES.

[Final Chorus: full stadium arrangement, choir, cymbal crashes]

OPEN THE STACK
LET THE AGENTS RUN

Open foundations
Choice for everyone

SWAP OUT THE MODEL
KEEP THE WORK ALIVE

No single vendor
Gets to own the mind

[Choir]
REPLACEABLE!

[Lead]
When technology moves

[Choir]
INSPECTABLE!

[Lead]
Know what it will do

[Choir]
PORTABLE!

[Lead]
Take the work with you

[Choir]
BOUNDED!

[Lead]
Authority made clear

[Choir]
GROUNDED!

[Lead]
Truth beneath the gears

[Choir]
AUDITABLE!

[Lead]
Every step appears

[All Vocals]
OPEN COMPONENTS
EXPLICIT CONTRACTS
OPERATIONAL FREEDOM
YEAR AFTER YEAR

[Key Change: final chorus rises]

BUILD FROM THE DATA
DEFINE EVERY SEAM

COMPOSE THE RUNTIME
DON’T SURRENDER THE DREAM

OBSERVE AND EVOLVE IT
REPLACE WHAT YOU NEED

OPEN ISN’T A LICENSE

[Music drops except vocals]

OPEN…

IS…

ARCHITECTURE.

[Final explosive hit]

[Outro: synth arpeggio gradually decomposes into individual notes]

[Soft Vocal]
The platform is a stack…

[Whispered Choir]
Not a suite.

[Soft Vocal]
Own the architecture…

[Choir fading]
Keep the options…

Keep the options…

Keep the options…

Open Agentic Platform.
