title: LET IT GO, LET IT GROW
lyrics:
[Intro: mellow keys, vinyl crackle, restrained beat]

Yeah

Some things stay heavy
Only because we keep carrying them

Some names stay loud
Only because we keep saying them in our head

Forgiveness ain’t forgetting

It’s freedom

[Verse 1]

I used to keep a record
Every wrong, every slight
Every word that hit different
Every sleepless night

Had a courtroom in my mind
And I played every role
Judge, jury, witness
Still losing control

Thought anger made me stronger
Thought revenge made me whole
But the fire I was feeding
Was just burning my soul

You can win every argument
Still lose your peace
You can hold onto the grudge
While your happiness leaves

So I had to ask myself
What am I protecting?
A wound from the past
Or a future I’m neglecting?

I can name what you did
I can say it was wrong
And still choose not to drag it
Every place that I’m going

[Hook]

Let it go
Let it grow

You don’t have to carry
What somebody did years ago

Let it breathe
Let it leave

Forgiveness ain’t weakness
It’s choosing to be free

We all fall
We all break

We all got some damage
And some damage that we make

So forgive
When you can

Give somebody room
To become a better human again

[Verse 2]

I’m not saying trust everybody
That would be a lie

Some bridges need distance
Some doors need goodbye

Forgiveness doesn’t mean
You invite them back inside

You can wish somebody healing
From the other side

That’s power

To stop needing them to suffer
To stop feeding all the poison
Just to prove that you were tougher

Because pain gets inherited
If nobody ends the chain

One person drops the weapon
Now the future starts to change

Think of every apology
You hoped somebody heard

Every stupid thing you did
Every careless word

Would you want one bad decision
To define your whole name?

Then maybe we can offer
Other people the same

Not excuses

Not pretending

Not erasing what occurred

Just refusing to make hatred
The last and final word

[Hook]

Let it go
Let it grow

You don’t have to carry
What somebody did years ago

Let it breathe
Let it leave

Forgiveness ain’t weakness
It’s choosing to be free

We all fall
We all break

We all got some damage
And some damage that we make

So forgive
When you can

Give somebody room
To become a better human again

[Bridge: beat drops, spoken flow]

And maybe the hardest one

Is the face in the mirror

For every chance you wasted
Every time you disappeared

Every person you disappointed
Every promise you broke

Every moment you knew better
But still chose what you chose

You can learn without living
With your hands around your throat

Guilt can teach the lesson

Then you gotta let it go

You are more than your worst day

They are more than theirs too

Maybe mercy is the bravest thing
A wounded heart can do

[Beat returns harder]

[Verse 3]

Imagine if we practiced it
Before the anger spread

Before one careless sentence
Turned to ten years left unsaid

Before families became strangers
Before friends became names

Before pride made us prisoners
Inside somebody else’s mistake

Somebody has to be first
Somebody lowers the shield

Somebody says, “Yeah, you hurt me
But I still want us to heal”

Maybe they don’t deserve it

Maybe that’s not the point

Mercy was never valuable
Because it was easy to deploy

It takes strength to remember
Without living in the past

To acknowledge what was broken
Without making broken last

We can’t rewrite yesterday

But tomorrow’s still unwritten

And sometimes the first sentence is

“I forgive you”

[Final Hook: layered vocals]

Let it go
Let it grow

You don’t have to carry
What somebody did years ago

Let it breathe
Let it leave

Forgiveness ain’t weakness
It’s choosing to be free

We all fall
We all break

We all need some mercy
For the choices that we make

So forgive
When you can

Not because they earned it

Because peace deserves a chance

[Outro]

Forgive them

Forgive yourself

Keep the lesson

Drop the weight

And keep moving

title: STEP BY STEP
lyrics:
[Intro: distant marching drums]

One step
Then another

One breath
Then another

The road is long

Good

So are we

[Verse 1]

We started with a picture
No one else could clearly see

Just a line across the distance
And a place we meant to be

There were voices from the sidelines
There were reasons we could stop

But the mountain never moved for us

So we started toward the top

[Pre-Chorus]

Boots on the ground
Eyes on the rise

No looking down
No compromise

We don’t need the road to open

We’ll make one as we go

[Chorus]

March on
March on

Toward the fire
Toward the dawn

Step by step
And mile by mile

We carry every trial

March on
March on

Let the tired become strong

We didn’t come this far
To almost win

We came to triumph

[Post-Chorus]

Hey!
Hey!

Forward!

Hey!
Hey!

Forward!

[Verse 2]

There were nights we lost direction
There were days we lost our nerve

There were moments when the finish
Felt like more than we deserved

But a goal is not a promise
It’s a challenge you accept

And the distance only disappears
Because somebody takes the next step

[Pre-Chorus]

Feet in the dust
Hands to the sky

Fall if we must
Get up and rise

Every scar becomes a marker

Saying we were here before

[Chorus]

March on
March on

Toward the fire
Toward the dawn

Step by step
And mile by mile

We carry every trial

March on
March on

Let the tired become strong

We didn’t come this far
To almost win

We came to triumph

[Bridge: drums only, call and response]

When the road gets steep

[Group]
WE CLIMB

When the night gets deep

[Group]
WE SHINE

When they say enough

[Group]
ONE MORE

When we hit the wall

[Group]
BREAK THROUGH

[Build: full band rising]

Not because it’s easy

Not because we know

Not because the world will hand us
Anything we’re owed

We move because the vision
Still burns behind our eyes

And every step that hurt us
Taught us how to rise

[Final Chorus: massive]

March on
March on

Now the horizon’s coming on

Step by step
And mile by mile

We turned the pain to power

March on
March on

Hear the whole world sing along

We didn’t come this far
To almost win

We came to triumph

[Key Change]

Raise the banner

Sound the drums

Look how far
Look what we’ve become

Every failure
Every fall

Built the strength
To take it all

One more step

One more climb

One more push

One more time

Until the dream
We chased so long

Is standing right where we belong

[Final Chant]

Forward!

Forward!

Never stop

Forward!

Forward!

To the top

Forward!

Forward!

Through the storm

Triumph isn’t found

It’s formed

[Outro: marching drums slowing]

One step

Then another

One breath

Then another

[Lead, quietly]

And then

We arrive

title: THE LONG WAY HOME
lyrics:
[Intro: soft acoustic guitar, light piano]

The morning left some silver
On the edges of the street
And the trees were making shadows
That kept moving with my feet

There was coffee through a window
There were sparrows on a wire
There was nothing much important

Which was exactly what I required

[Verse 1]

I passed a house with flowers
Growing wild along the gate
And wondered who had planted them
And whether they still stayed

I watched a man walk slowly
With his dog beside his knee
And thought how many ordinary things
Become a memory

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe life is not a question
With an answer at the end

Maybe it is mostly noticing
What you almost missed again

[Chorus]

So I’ll take the long way home
Let the afternoon unfold

Let the wind rearrange
All the things I thought I knew

I don’t need to solve my life
Before the daylight disappears

I can walk
I can wonder

I can simply be here

[Instrumental: gentle guitar melody]

[Verse 2]

There’s a child drawing circles
With a stick along the ground
There’s a couple at a corner
Laughing at some private sound

There’s a bus I could have taken
There’s a place I have to be

But for once the clock can wait
A little while for me

I have spent so many mornings
Trying to outrun the day

As if getting somewhere faster
Makes the distance mean a thing

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe all the years behind me
Were not roads I chose in vain

Every wrong turn left me standing
Somewhere worth a little rain

[Chorus]

So I’ll take the long way home
Let the afternoon unfold

Let the wind rearrange
All the things I thought I knew

I don’t need to solve my life
Before the daylight disappears

I can walk
I can wonder

I can simply be here

[Bridge: stripped down, piano and voice]

I think about the people
I have loved and let go by

The ones I should have called more
The ones still by my side

I think about ambition
And the things I said I’d do

How some of them still matter

And some I simply outgrew

[Pause]

There are dreams that need pursuing

There are dreams that need release

There are days for making history

And days for finding peace

[Build: drums enter softly]

Maybe wisdom isn’t knowing
What tomorrow ought to be

Maybe wisdom is remembering

To look up occasionally

[Final Chorus: fuller arrangement]

So I’ll take the long way home
While the evening turns to gold

Watch the windows come alive
As the air begins to cool

I don’t need a grand conclusion
I don’t need the world explained

There is sunlight through the branches

There is pavement after rain

There are people passing by me

There are places left to roam

And sometimes being alive
Is just taking

The long way home

[Outro: soft guitar, footsteps ambience]

One more corner
One more street

One more thought
Beneath my feet

[Lead, softly]

I’ll get there when I do

[Final piano chord]

title: OUT OF LINE
lyrics:
[Intro]

I never learned to walk in straight lines
Never cared to color inside
Never had much use for the blueprint
If the blueprint said how to live my life

I took the long road
I took the strange route
Turned left when everyone said right

And if that makes me difficult
Then difficult fits me just fine

[Pre-Chorus]

I’m not here to match the pattern
I’m not here to disappear

If I’m too much for the room
Then I’ll make the room bigger from here

[Chorus]

I’m out of line
And I like it that way

I’m out of step
But I’m moving anyway

Raise your hands
If you never fit the mold

Raise your voice
If you’d rather make your own

We don’t need permission
We don’t need a sign

We were never born
To fall in line

[Post-Chorus]

Hey!
Hey!
Hey!

Out of line!

Hey!
Hey!
Hey!

And doing just fine!

[Verse 2]

I’ve been called too loud
Too weird
Too restless

Too many ideas
Too little restraint

I’ve been told to pick a lane
So many times
I started building highways instead

I don’t want the safest answer
I don’t want the standard plan

I’d rather fail as who I am
Than win as someone else’s man

[Pre-Chorus]

I’m not here to match the pattern
I’m not shrinking down tonight

If the world says
“Choose the usual”

I’m choosing something else on sight

[Chorus]

I’m out of line
And I like it that way

I’m out of step
But I’m moving anyway

Raise your hands
If you never fit the mold

Raise your voice
If you’d rather make your own

We don’t need permission
We don’t need a sign

We were never born
To fall in line

[Breakdown]

Let them stare

Let them talk

Let them wonder
Why you walk

Like the road belongs to you

Let them laugh

Let them doubt

That just means
You found a route

They were too afraid to choose

[Build]

Different isn’t broken

Strange isn’t wrong

You don’t owe the world
A smaller version
Just to get along

[Final Chorus]

I’m out of line
And I like it that way

I’m out of step
But I’m moving anyway

Raise your hands
If you never fit the mold

Raise your voice
If you’d rather make your own

We don’t need permission
We don’t need a sign

We were never born
To fall in line

[Key Change]

No!

We don’t bend
Just to blend

We don’t quit
Just to fit

We don’t trade
What makes us strange

For a little bit of praise

If they say
“That’s not how it’s done”

Good

Then watch us do it anyway

[Final Chant]

Out of line!

Out of line!

Out of line!

And doing just fine!

Out of line!

Out of line!

Original by design!

[Outro]

I never learned to walk in straight lines

And I hope I never do

title: Lives Through The Window
lyrics:
[Intro: solitary grand piano, elegant and spacious]

There’s a woman on a balcony
In a city I can’t name
She’s watering red flowers
While a tram rolls through the rain

There’s a waiter stacking glasses
There’s a child chasing birds
There’s a man beneath an awning
Reading someone else’s words

And for half a second
From the backseat of a car

I can almost see the life
Where I never traveled far

[Strings enter softly]

But the light turns green
And there we go

Another world
I’ll never know

[Chorus: sweeping orchestra, full drums]

Oh, look at all the lives I could have lived

Behind every door
On every street
In every little town

A different name
A different love
A different way of settling down

And isn’t it wonderful
To know they’re out there still?

A million lives I’ll never have

And one magnificent life I will

[Instrumental: piano flourish]

[Verse 2]

I drank coffee in a station
Where I couldn’t read the signs
Watched two strangers kiss goodbye
Like they were running out of time

Bought a postcard from a woman
Who laughed when I mispronounced
The name of some cathedral
That I never figured out

There were bicycles in alleyways
And laundry overhead

And every open window
Held a story being read

[Pre-Chorus: rising strings]

Who would I have been here?

Who would I have loved?

Would I know these cobblestones
Like the lines upon my palms?

[Chorus: larger]

Oh, look at all the lives I could have lived

Above the bakery
Beside the sea
Behind that painted door

Maybe I’d have had three children
Maybe I’d have wanted more

Maybe I’d complain about the weather
Maybe I’d know every hill

A million lives I’ll never have

And one magnificent life I will

[Orchestral interlude: strings and piano climbing]

[Verse 3: playful, theatrical]

Paris says I could be tragic

Tokyo says stay awake

Rome insists I need more wine

New York says I’m already late

Some little town I passed at midnight
Said nothing much at all

Just one yellow kitchen window

And a bicycle by the wall

[Music suddenly quiet]

And somehow that one frightened me

More than monuments or kings

Because somebody was living there

Among completely ordinary things

[Soft piano]

A life with cups and birthdays

Bills and neighbors
Keys and doors

A universe as infinite

As mine

And just as yours

[Bridge: intimate vocal, restrained orchestra]

Perhaps there is no perfect place

No city meant for me

Perhaps the point is passing through

And seeing what I see

To borrow someone’s morning

To walk somebody’s street

To hear a language I don’t know

And still understand the beat

[Drums begin building]

Every face becomes a doorway

Every doorway says

You could

And every train departing whispers

You still should

[Explosive orchestral transition]

[Final Chorus: huge, theatrical]

Oh, look at all the lives I could have lived!

I could have sold the flowers
I could have sailed the bay

I could have known that old man’s name
And passed his shop each day

I could have kissed somebody
Underneath a foreign moon

I could have called this somewhere home

If I had gotten here more soon

[Choir enters]

But look at all the lives I get to see!

Through taxi glass
And railway cars
And tables by the sea

A thousand little universes
Briefly opening for me

[Key Change]

So give me one more airport

One more unfamiliar street

One more stranger with a story

One more country at my feet

Give me mountains
Give me markets

Give me places without names

Let me lose myself completely

And return myself again

[Orchestra reaches peak]

Because I don’t need every life

To know how rich they are

Sometimes you only need a window

From a train

Or from a car

[Break: piano alone]

[Lead, softly]

And somewhere tonight

Someone is looking through a window

Wondering what it would be like

To be me

[Final orchestral swell]

[Outro]

So wave goodbye

And let it go

There’s another world

Down every road

[Backing vocals fading]
Every road
Every road

[Lead]

And I want to see
As many as I can

[Final piano chord]

title: THE WHOLE DAMN SHOW
lyrics:
[Intro: grand piano, sparse and reflective]

I kept a list of every failure
Like a ledger in my coat
Every bridge I burned too quickly
Every word I wish I never spoke

I kept trophies for the victories
Polished bright enough to blind
As if proving I had conquered
Could erase the times I fell behind

[Soft bass enters]

But the scars and the applause
Both belong to the same skin

And I’m tired of choosing
Which parts of me get in

[Pre-Chorus: drums begin to rise]

So bring the lights up
Open every door

I’ve been editing my life
I don’t want to anymore

[Chorus: full band, huge harmonies]

Give me the whole damn show
The highs, the lows
The nights I lost control

Give me every wrong turn
Every bridge I burned
Every lesson that I learned

I’ll take the glory
I’ll take the blame
I’ll wear them both beneath my name

If this is all the time I get
I’m not spending it on regret

[Backing vocals: “No regret! No regret!”]

Give me the whole damn show

[Instrumental flourish: piano and guitar]

[Verse 2: jaunty glam-rock groove]

I have loved the wrong occasions
Trusted people I should not
Said goodbye before I meant it
Stayed too long when I should’ve walked

I have stumbled into fortune
I have squandered perfect days
I have stood beneath the spotlight
And still wondered who deserved the praise

[Half-time]

I was cruel when I was frightened
I was brave when no one knew
I have been a contradiction
And every contradiction’s true

[Pre-Chorus: theatrical build]

I won’t carve myself to pieces
Just to fit a cleaner frame

Every beautiful disaster
Still answers to my name

[Chorus: bigger]

Give me the whole damn show
The highs, the lows
The nights I lost control

Give me every wrong turn
Every bridge I burned
Every lesson that I learned

I’ll take the glory
I’ll take the blame
I’ll wear them both beneath my name

If this is all the time I get
I’m not spending it on regret

[Choir: “Let it go! Let it go!”]

Give me the whole damn show

[Instrumental Break: flamboyant guitar solo over pounding piano]

[Bridge: stripped down, intimate vocal]

There is no version waiting
Where I never made mistakes

No perfect road behind me
No life I should replace

There’s only this collection
Of the things I chose and missed

The people that I loved enough
To leave fingerprints on this

[Single piano chord]

And maybe I was foolish
Maybe I was right

Maybe both can live together
In a single life

[Build: drums returning slowly]

I don’t need forgiveness
From the person I might have been

I just need another morning

And the nerve to start again

[Explosive transition]

[Final Chorus: massive operatic arrangement]

Give me the whole damn show
The fire, the snow
The places I still want to go

Give me every heartbreak
Every risk I take
Every promise I might break

I’ll take the laughter
I’ll take the tears
I’ll take the weight of all these years

I’ll kiss the future on the mouth
And see what all this life’s about

[Choir: “Live it now! Live it now!”]

Give me the whole damn show

[Key Change]

I want the mornings
I want the nights

I want the foolish city lights

I want the dancing
I want the rain

I want to fall in love again

I want the failures
I want the wins

I want the trouble that begins

When you stop asking life for proof

And finally let yourself cut loose

[Break: silence]

[Lead vocal, almost spoken]

I was never meant to be flawless

I was meant to be here

[Final crescendo]

So turn it up!

[Choir]
TURN IT UP!

[Lead]
Raise the curtain!

[Choir]
RAISE IT UP!

[Lead]
If the ending comes tomorrow

Then tonight I’m showing up!

[Huge guitar chord]

[Outro: piano, choir, handclaps]

The good, the bad
The strange, the true

Every road that brought me through

[Backing vocals fading]
The whole damn show
The whole damn show

[Lead, quietly]

I wouldn’t trade it

[Final piano chord]

title: THE MIRROR LOVES ME BACK
lyrics:
[Intro: solitary grand piano, distant room reverb]

I bought another mirror
Just to see if I had changed
Hung it where the morning light
Could flatter every angle of my face

I practiced looking humble
I perfected looking hurt
Learned exactly when to lower my eyes
And make sincerity look unrehearsed

[Soft bass enters]

Oh, what a charming little monster
With such impeccable taste
Building monuments to kindness
With my name across the base

[Pre-Chorus: drums begin climbing]

And I know
I know
I know what I’m doing

At least some of the time

[Chorus: full band, huge stacked harmonies]

I want to be good
But I want to be adored
I want to feed the hungry
Then hear them chanting for an encore

I want to give my love away
With a spotlight on the act
Is it generosity
If I need the whole world looking back?

[Backing vocals: “Looking back! Looking back!”]

Oh, I want to be good
God, I want to be good
Even when the mirror loves me back

[Instrumental flourish: piano run, guitar harmonics]

[Verse 2: jaunty cabaret rhythm]

I have sampled every pleasure
Like a king afraid to die
Wine and velvet, rooms with views
And strangers telling beautiful lies

I can turn desire to doctrine
Make indulgence sound profound
Call my appetite “experience”
While another bottle makes the rounds

[Half-time]

I give advice on moderation
From a table set for ten
Tell myself that knowing my hypocrisy
Means I’m somehow free of it

[Pre-Chorus: theatrical vocal build]

But I know
I know
I know that isn’t true

Self-awareness isn’t virtue
If awareness is all you do

[Chorus: larger, choir harmonies]

I want to be good
But I want to be adored
I want to save the drowning
And have my portrait on the shore

I want to lift somebody up
Without measuring the height
Without wondering if everyone
Has noticed I was right

[Backing vocals: “Was he right? Was he right?”]

Oh, I want to be good
God, I want to be good
Even when I make myself the light

[Post-Chorus: guitars drop out, voices only]

[Layered vocals]
Do you love them?
Or being loved?

Do you help them?
Or need to be enough?

Would you do it
If nobody ever knew?

[Lead, quietly]
I don’t know

But I want to

[Instrumental Break: theatrical guitar solo over descending piano chords]

[Bridge: slow, intimate]

There are people I have cherished
There are people I have used
There are times I gave completely
There are gifts that were disguised as dues

There were apologies I offered
Just to stop myself from shame
There were wounds I helped to bandage
Then secretly remembered who they’d blame

[Music nearly stops]

Maybe goodness isn’t purity
Maybe nobody gets clean
Maybe every act of mercy
Has a little ego hiding in between

[Single piano chord]

But if a selfish heart can choose
To leave somebody less alone

Maybe that is somewhere
I can start

[Build: heartbeat kick drum]

Maybe goodness is a practice
Not a halo
Not a throne

[Explosive transition]

[Final Chorus: massive operatic arrangement]

I want to be good
And yes, I want to be adored
I want the velvet and the roses
I want heaven keeping score

But I can carry someone’s burden
Even while I crave applause
I can learn to love the person
More than loving being loved

[Choir: “Love them more! Love them more!”]

I can close the door behind me
I can give without a plaque
I can leave a little kindness
Where no praise can follow back

[Key change]

And I want to be good
Not perfect, just good
When nobody is watching what I do

I want to be good
When there’s nothing there to prove
When the room has lost its audience
And I still choose what is true

[Break: silence]

[Quiet lead vocal]

And tomorrow
When the mirror asks me
Who I think I am

I’ll say

[Final crescendo]

Someone trying!

[Choir]
TRYING!

[Lead]
Someone failing!

[Choir]
FAILING!

[Lead]
Someone vain enough to love himself

But learning how to love somebody else!

[Huge guitar chord]

[Outro: piano and layered vocals fading]

The mirror loves me back
The mirror loves me back

[Whispered harmony]
But it doesn’t have to be
The only one I love

[Final piano chord]

title: First Light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning on my window
New paint on the wall
Old weight on my shoulders
Starting to fall

I left the dark behind me
Step by step, I found
A tiny spark was waiting
Buried underground

[Pre-Chorus]
And I can feel it now
Something turning round
The air is different somehow
When your name comes down

[Chorus]
First light, first light
Pull me through the night
First light, first light
Everything feels right
I’m breathing again
I’m here again
First light, first light
Lead me to the sun

[Verse 2]
Bare feet on the sidewalk
Rain still in the street
But every broken memory
Moves a little beat

I don’t need forever
I just need today
One small door opens
And the fear gives way

[Pre-Chorus]
And I can feel it now
Something turning round
The air is different somehow
When your name comes down

[Chorus]
First light, first light
Pull me through the night
First light, first light
Everything feels right
I’m breathing again
I’m here again
First light, first light
Lead me to the sun

[Bridge]
If hope was a little flame
I’d hold it in my hand
Let it shake, let it blaze
Let it teach me how to stand

[Chorus]
First light, first light
Pull me through the night
First light, first light
Everything feels right
I’m breathing again
I’m here again
First light, first light
Lead me to the sun

title: Tin Roof Weather
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning on the sill
A gray stain on the glass
The kettle never quite
Gets all the way to bright

I watch the alley drain
It carries little leaves
And something in my chest
Won't wash out with the week

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep the door shut
Like it might keep me whole
But the air comes in cold
And I feel it in my bones

[Chorus]
This is what rain feels like
Heavy in my hands
This is what rain feels like
Running through the cracks
This is what rain feels like
When you can't explain
This is what rain feels like
My own name in the drain

[Verse 2]
Your blue cup by the sink
Still holds the lip of dawn
I set it face down
Like the day was gone

The porch light blinks once
On the soaked back step
And every little drop
Feels like what I couldn't say

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep the door shut
Like it might keep me whole
But the air comes in cold
And I feel it in my bones

[Chorus]
This is what rain feels like
Heavy in my hands
This is what rain feels like
Running through the cracks
This is what rain feels like
When you can't explain
This is what rain feels like
My own name in the drain

[Bridge]
If I stand still enough
I can hear it say
Nothing stays in place
Nothing goes away

[Chorus]
This is what rain feels like
Heavy in my hands
This is what rain feels like
Running through the cracks
This is what rain feels like
When you can't explain
This is what rain feels like
My own name in the drain

title: Mirror Habit
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I catch my face in the spoon
and I see the panic first
I know the shape of my moods
before I can name the hurt

I read the room too fast
like a card trick gone wrong
I can smell my own excuse
while I’m still singing along

[Pre-Chorus]
That’s the gift
and the bruise
I see the crack
before the truth

[Chorus]
I know myself too well
I know myself too well
It saves me from the fall
then makes the fall feel real

I know myself too well
I know myself too well
I’m hard to fool, hard to hold
harder still to heal

[Verse 2]
I can hear the lie in my laugh
when I say I’m fine
I can spot my favorite trap
and still step right in line

I replay every text
every pause, every stare
turn a small mistake
into a loaded prayer

[Pre-Chorus]
That’s the cost
of the light
You see too much
to sleep at night

[Chorus]
I know myself too well
I know myself too well
It saves me from the fall
then makes the fall feel real

I know myself too well
I know myself too well
I’m hard to fool, hard to hold
harder still to heal

[Bridge]
Still, I’d rather know
than live half-blind
Rather face my faults
than call them mine

If I can name the storm
I can ride it through
Self-aware, self-worn
but I’m still me too

[Final Chorus]
I know myself too well
I know myself too well
It saves me from the fall
then makes the fall feel real

I know myself too well
I know myself too well
I’m learning how to bend
without breaking into pieces

title: Table For Nobody
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left my phone on charge
Barely made a list
Took the long way downtown
Just for the hell of it

No one asking where
No one keeping score
I wore my lucky shoes
And let them hit the floor

[Pre-Chorus]
Tonight can be a maybe
Tonight can roll along
I don't need a reason
To stay out all night long

[Chorus]
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that
No plans, no plans
Tell the whole world I’m back
One more song
One more laugh
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that

[Verse 2]
Met you by the bar
With a grin and a drink
Talked about nothing much
Till the edges sank

Taxi windows down
Wind in our hair
We were wide awake
Like we had nowhere to be anywhere

[Pre-Chorus]
Tonight can be a maybe
Tonight can roll along
I don't need a reason
To stay out all night long

[Chorus]
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that
No plans, no plans
Tell the whole world I’m back
One more song
One more laugh
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that

[Bridge]
Let the clock run wild
Let the morning wait
I’ve been booked and busy
This feels like a change

So pour one more
Let the good times land
I don’t need tomorrow
I just need your hand

[Final Chorus]
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that
No plans, no plans
Tell the whole world I’m back
One more song
One more laugh
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that

No plans, no plans
Till the sky turns back
No plans, no plans
And I like it like that

title: Not Okay Today
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - Piano Only]
You don’t got to smile
For everybody else
You can set it down
You can be a mess

[full band kicks in post-hardcore interlude]

Some days hit hard
Like a metal door
You can lock it up
You don’t owe more

[Pre-Chorus - Group Chant, Metal build up]
Take a breath, babe
Let it shake
You are not a fault
You are not a mistake

[Chorus]
It’s okay
To not be okay
You can break
And still stay

[this part is guttural screams joining melodic vocals]
It’s okay
To not be okay
I’ll sit here

[Verse 2]
There’s a crack in the cup
Still it holds the tea
There’s a bruise on your heart
That you do not need to hide from me

Let the heavy days
Come and go
You can move real slow
You can say, “I know”

[Pre-Chorus]
Take a breath, babe
Let it shake
You are not a fault
You are not a mistake

[Chorus]
It’s okay
To not be okay
You can break
And still stay

It’s okay
To not be okay

[calm of only piano and trumpets]

[punk breakdown]

[Bridge]
No need to earn
Your own救ing
No need to wear
A perfect thing

If the tears come down
Let them fall
You don’t have to be
Strong through it all

[Final Chorus - group chant with choir]
It’s okay
To not be okay
You can break
And still stay

It’s okay
To not be okay
I’ll sit here
While the storm rolls away

It’s okay
To not be okay
You’re still you
Even on the hard days

title: Let Them Bloom
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You don't have to fit
in my hands
I can hold your name
without a plan

Wear your colors loud
let them show
I don't need to map
the way you grow

[Pre-Chorus]
Take your time
take the whole road
I can love you
and let you go

[Chorus]
Be you, be you
I love that, I do
Be you, be you
that's the best part of you
Take your shape
take your space
I won't ask you
to change your face
Be you, be you
I love that, I do

[Verse 2]
If you need the room
I'll step back
If you need the sun
I'll share that

If you need to fall
on your own
I'll be right here
when you come home

[Pre-Chorus]
Take your time
take the whole road
I can love you
and let you go

[Chorus]
Be you, be you

Be you, be you
that's the best part of you
Take your shape
take your space
I won't ask you
to change your face
Be you, be you
I love that, I do

[Bridge]
I don't want a copy
I want your heart
I want the wild
and the awkward parts

The quiet truth
the brave and new
Every piece of you
gets to be you

[Chorus]
Be you, be you
I love that, I do
Be you, be you
that's the best part of you
Take your shape
take your space
I won't ask you
to change your face
Be you, be you
I love that, I do

title: Peanut Butter Halo
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wear my socks mismatched
On purpose, babe
I laugh at the wrong times
And I still get paid
Got a heart like a porch light
Open and brave
I make room at the table
For the odd little shapes

[Pre-Chorus]
If I trip, I dance it off
If you frown, I stay soft
I got glitter in my pockets
And a grin that won’t stop

[Chorus]
Weird is my way
Kind is my name
I don’t fit the mold
I just bring the flame
Weird is my way
Kind is my name
Come as you are
I’ll do the same

I talk to stray dogs
Like they know my name
I keep a spare umbrella
For a friend in the rain
I’ve got a laugh like a hiccup
A face full of light
And if you feel out of place
Baby, you’re right on time

If I trip, I dance it off
If you frown, I stay soft

Weird is my way
Kind is my name
I don’t fit the mold

Weird is my way

Let the polished ones stare

I’m the snap in the screen

[Final Chorus]
Weird is my way
Kind is my name
I don’t fit the mold
I just bring the flame
Weird is my way
Kind is my name
Come as you are
I’ll do the same
Weird is my way
Kind is my name
Come as you are
I’ll do the same

title: Counting My Blessings
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I woke up slow
Sun on the plate
Clean clothes folded
Food on my plate

My name in your phone
Good news in the mail
House full of laughter
Still I feel pale

[Pre-Chorus]
What do I do
With a full, full hand?
Why does my heart
Still not understand?

I got the keys
I got the door
But something in me
Keeps asking for more

[Chorus]
Why am I blue?
When I have it all
I count my blessings
And still I fall

Why am I blue?
When I should feel small
I count my blessings
And still I fall

[Verse 2]
Mama called early
Said baby, eat well
Your granddad's old watch
Still works like a spell

A friend sent a photo
All of us there
Smiles in the frame
Like we had no care

[Pre-Chorus]
What do I do
With a full, full hand?
Why does my heart
Still not understand?

I got the light
I got the floor
But something in me
Keeps asking for more

[Chorus]
Why am I blue?
When I have it all
I count my blessings
And still I fall

Why am I blue?
When I should feel small
I count my blessings
And still I fall

[Bridge]
Maybe my heart
Just wants to kneel
Even in gold
It forgets what's real

So let me cry
